entries.matn_en: When you recite a surah that contains a prostration, and between the prostration and its end there is one or two verses—such as Bani Isra'il, al-A'raf, al-Najm, and Idha al-Sama' Unshaqqat—you have a choice: if you wish, you may bow with it and that will suffice you, or if you wish, you may prostrate with it, then stand and recite something else, then bow. But if you connect it with another surah, you must prostrate with it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 25
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا كَانَتِ السَّجْدَةُ وَسَطَ السُّورَةِ، فَلَا بُدَّ مِنْ أَنَّ تَسْجُدَ بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: When the prostration is in the middle of the surah, you must prostrate for it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 25
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَرَّسَ هُوَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ، فَلَمْ يُوقِظْهُمْ إِلَّا حَرُّ الشَّمْسِ، فَقَامُوا، فَأَمَرَ بِلَالًا فَأَذَّنَ، ثُمَّ أَوْتَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ، ثُمَّ تَأَخَّرُوا عَنْ مُعَرَّسِهِمْ حِينَ اسْتَيْقَظُوا، فَصَلَّوْا رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِلَالًا فَأَقَامَ الصَّلَاةَ، فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, and his companions camped for the night; only the sun’s heat woke them. They got up, and he ordered Bilal to call the adhan. The Prophet and his companions then performed Witr. After that, once awake, they moved away from their campsite and prayed two rak‘ahs. He then ordered Bilal to give the iqama, and the Messenger of God led the people in prayer.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 25
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصِيبُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، ثُمَّ يَنَامُ وَلَا يَمَسُّ مَاءً حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ، فَإِمَّا أَنْ يَعُودَ، وَإِمَّا أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ishaq from al-Aswad from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, would be intimate with his wives, then sleep without touching water until he woke up—either to resume intimacy or to perform ghusl.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 25
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَنَامُ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ، أَوْ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ، وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: كَانَ يُقَالُ: «لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ أَقْطَعَ لِمَاءِ الرَّجُلِ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ وَالنَّوْمِ، وَذَلِكَ لِيُعْلَمَ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَنَامُونَ وَهُمْ جُنُبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the man who sleeps while in a state of ritual impurity or without ablution. Ibrahim said It used to be said, "Nothing cuts off a man’s semen more than urination and sleep, and that is so it may be known that they used to sleep while in a state of ritual impurity."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 25
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه لَمَّا قَدِمَ مِنَ أَرْضِ الْحَبَشَةِ سَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ. قَالَ: «وَمَا ذَاكَ؟» . قَالَ: سَلَّمْتُ، فَلَمْ تَرُدَّ عَلَيَّ قَالَ: «إِنَّ فِي الصَّلَاةِ شُغْلًا عَنْ رَدِّ السَّلَامِ» . فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ السَّلَامَ مِنْ يَوْمَئِذٍ
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that when Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, returned from the land of Abyssinia, he greeted the Messenger of God, ﷺ, while he was praying, but he did not return the greeting. When the Prophet, ﷺ, finished, he said I seek refuge in God from His anger. The Prophet asked: What is that? He said: I greeted you, but you did not return it. The Prophet said: Prayer keeps one too occupied to return the greeting. From that day on, he never returned the greeting.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 25
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، قَالَ " أَلَيْسَ يَقُولُ إِذَا تَشَهَّدَ: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ؟ فَقَدْ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the man who gives salam to another while he is in prayer. He said Does he not say when he recites the tashahhud: "Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of God"? So he has already returned the salam to him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 26
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابَهُ كَانُوا يَرُدُّونَ السَّلَامَ عَلَى مَنْ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ، فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي، فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَوَجَدَ الرَّجُلُ فِي نَفْسِهِ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَاهُ، فَقَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِ اللَّهِ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ، كُنْتَ تَرُدُّ عَلَى مَنْ سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ، فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْكَ فَلَمْ تَرُدَّ عَلَيَّ. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ فِي الصَّلَاةِ لَشُغْلًا عَنْ رَدِّ السَّلَامِ» . فَتَرَكَ الرَّدَّ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, and his companions used to return the greeting to those who greeted them while they were in prayer. One day, a man came and greeted the Prophet, ﷺ, while he was praying, but he did not return the greeting. The man felt uneasy about this. When the Prophet, ﷺ, finished his prayer, the man approached him and said I seek refuge in God and His Messenger from His wrath. You used to return the greeting to those who greeted you, but when I greeted you, you did not return it. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said: Prayer is too engrossing to return the greeting. So he abandoned returning the greeting.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 26
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ صَلَّى لِغَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ فِي يَوْمٍ غَيْمٍ، أَجْزَأَ عَنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim who said
entries.matn_en: Whoever prays in a direction other than the qiblah on a cloudy day, that prayer suffices for him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 26
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُخْرِجُ إِلَيْهَا رَأْسَهُ وَهُوَ مُعْتَكِفٌ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ، فَتَغْسِلُهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ» .
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, would extend his head to her while he was in seclusion in the mosque, and she would wash it while she was menstruating.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 26
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father who said Hisham b. Urwah narrated to me from his father, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: the same narration.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 26
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ "
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَفُوتُهُ بَعْضُ الصَّلَاةِ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ: إِنَّهُ يَقْرَأُ فِيمَا يَقْضِي "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding the man who misses part of the prayer with the imam: he recites in what he makes up.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 26
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «لَا اعْتِكَافَ إِلَّا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَعْظَمِ، وَلَا يُخْرَجُ إِلَّا لِحَاجَةٍ لَا بُدَّ مِنْهَا. يَعْنِي الْبَوْلَ وَالْغَائِطَ»
entries.isnad_en: Narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: who said: “There is no i‘tikaf except in the main mosque, and one may leave only for an unavoidable need—namely, urination or defecation.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 26
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ مَسْجِدًا قَدْ صُلِّيَ فِيهِ، فَابْدَأْ بِالْمَكْتُوبَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifah narrated from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said
entries.matn_en: When you enter a mosque in which prayer has already been offered, begin with the obligatory prayer.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 27
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ فِي السَّفِينَةِ، قَالَ: «صَلِّ قَائِمًا، تَيَمَّمِ الْقِبْلَةَ، فَإِنْ لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ فَقَاعِدًا، تَيَمَّمِ الْقِبْلَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding prayer on a ship: "Pray standing, face the qiblah. If you are unable, then pray seated, face the qiblah."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 27
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يَقْرَأُ سُورَةً فِي مَكْتُوبَةٍ وَلَا نَافِلَةٍ، إِلَّا قَرَأَ بَعْدَهَا: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ «لِمَ تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ؟» فَقَالَ: إِنِّي أُحِبُّهَا. فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَبَّكَ بِحُبِّكَ إِيَّاهَا»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Awn b. Abdillah, from a man among the Companions of the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that he would not recite any surah in an obligatory or voluntary prayer without reciting after it: Say, He is God, the One. This was mentioned to the Prophet, ﷺ, and he said , "Why do you do that?" The man said, "I love it." So he said, "God has indeed loved you because of your love for it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 27
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي
entries.matn_ar: " الْحُبْلَى تَرَى الدَّمَ فِي حَبَلِهَا وَعِنْدَ الطَّلْقِ: إِنَّهَا تَتَوَضَّأُ وَتُصَلِّي حَتَّى تَلِدَ، وَمَا صَنَعَتِ الْحُبْلَى مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding a pregnant woman who sees blood during pregnancy or at the onset of labor: “She performs ablution and prays until she gives birth. Whatever a pregnant woman does falls within the one-third.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 27
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ صَلَّى بِهِمْ، فَسَمِعَ صَوْتَ صَبِيٍّ فِي صَفِّ النِّسَاءِ، فَأَخَفَّ الصَّلَاةَ وَأَكْمَلَ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قِيلَ لَهُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قُصِرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ؟ قَالَ «وَمَا ذَاكَ؟» قَالُوا: خَفَّفْتَ. قَالَ: «قَدْ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ صَبِيٍّ فِي صَفِّ النِّسَاءِ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنَّ أُخَفِّفَ حَتَّى تَنْصَرِفَ أُمُّهُ إِلَى صَبِيِّهَا لَا يَشْغَلُهَا، فَمَنْ أَمَّ قَوْمًا فَلْيُخَفِّفْ بِهِمْ، وَلْيُكْمِلْ، فَإِنَّ فِيهِمُ الْكَبِيرَ وَالْمَرِيضَ وَالضَّعِيفَ وَذَا الْحَاجَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Yahya b. Abdullah, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, led them in prayer. He heard the sound of a child in the women’s row, so he shortened the prayer and completed it. When he finished, it was said to him: O Messenger of God, was the prayer shortened? He said: What is that? They said: You shortened it. He said: I heard the sound of a child in the women’s row, and I wished to shorten it so that his mother could attend to her child without being distracted. Whoever leads a people in prayer should shorten it for them and complete it, for among them are the elderly, the sick, the weak, and those with needs.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 28
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ زَاذَانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ مَعْبَدٍ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ بَيْنَمَا هُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ إِذْ أَقْبَلَ أَعْمَى يُرِيدُ الصَّلَاةَ، فَوَقَعَ فِي زُبْيَةٍ، فَاسْتَضْحَكَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ حَتَّى قَهْقَهَ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ «مَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ قَهْقَهَ فَلْيُعِدِ الْوُضُوءَ وَالصَّلَاةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Mansur b. Zadhan from al-Hasan from Ma'bad, ؓ, from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that while he was in prayer, a blind man who wanted to pray approached and fell into a pit. Some of the people laughed until they guffawed. When the Prophet, ﷺ, finished, he said "Whoever among you has guffawed must renew his ablution and prayer."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 28
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يُصَلِّي أَحَدٌ عَنْ أَحَدٍ، وَلَا يَصُومُ أَحَدٌ عَنْ أَحَدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: No one prays on behalf of another, and no one fasts on behalf of another.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 28
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، فَقُلْتُ: أَزِيدُ فِي الْأَرْبَعِ قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ؟ فَقَالَ لِي: «بَلْ طَوِّلْهُنَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad that he said
entries.matn_en: I asked Ibrahim, and I said, "Should I add to the four before the noon prayer?" So he said to me, "Rather, lengthen them."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 28
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الزَّرَّادِ، عَنْ تَمَّامٍ ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ «مَا لِي أَرَاكُمْ قُلْحًا، اسْتَاكُوا، فَلَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لَأَمَرْتُهُمْ بِالسِّوَاكِ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ali Abu al-Hasan al-Zarrad from Tammam, from Ja'far b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that some Companions of the Messenger of God, ﷺ, came to him. He said: “Why do I see your teeth stained? Use the toothstick. Were it not that I would burden my community, I would command them to use the toothstick before every prayer.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 29
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَمَّ أَصْحَابَهُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ، فَلَمْ يَقْرَأْ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْهَا حَتَّى انْصَرَفَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ: مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ؟ قَالَ: «وَمَا فَعَلْتُ؟» قَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: «رَحَّلْتُ عِيرًا الْعَشِيَّةَ، فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أُرَحِّلُهَا مُنَقِّلَةً مُنَقِّلَةً، حَتَّى أَوْرَدْتُهَا الشَّامَ، فَأَعَادَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَأَعَادَ أَصْحَابُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that Umar, ؓ, led his companions in Maghrib but recited nothing in any rak‘ah. When he finished, some of his companions asked, “What kept you from reciting?” He asked, “What did I do?” They replied, “You did not recite.” He said: “This evening I drove a caravan, and kept driving it from one stage to the next until I brought it to Syria.” He then repeated the prayer, and his companions repeated it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 29
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ
entries.matn_ar: " أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُشَدِّدُ فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ، وَيَقُولُ: بِفِيهِ الْحَجَرُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Alqamah b. Qays
entries.matn_en: that he used to be strict about reciting behind the imam and would say, "Put a stone in his mouth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 29
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «لَيْسَ عَلَى الْإِمَاءِ قِنَاعٌ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، وَلَا فِي غَيْرِهَا» . كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَتَقَنَّعْنَ، يَتَشَبَّهْنَ بِالْحَرَائِرِ
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said
entries.matn_en: "Slave women do not have to wear a veil in prayer or otherwise." He disliked that they cover their heads, imitating free women.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 29
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَمَّ أَصْحَابَهُ فِي الْفَجْرِ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ إِذَا هُوَ بِأَثَرِ جَنَابَةٍ فِي ثَوْبِهِ أَوْ فَخِذَيْهِ بَعْدَ مَا طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَقَالَ «لَقَدْ أَنْكَرْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا مُذْ خَالَطْنَا الرِّيفَ. فَاغْتَسَلَ» وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: وَلَمْ يَبْلُغْنَا أَنَّ أَصْحَابَهُ أَعَادُوا، وَلَا أَنَّهُمْ لَمْ يُعِيدُوا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, led his companions in Fajr. When he finished, after sunrise he found a trace of major ritual impurity (janabah) on his garment or thighs. He said: “We have found ourselves changed since we began mixing with country folk.” So he performed ghusl. Ibrahim added: “We have not learned whether his companions repeated the prayer or did not repeat it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 29
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي " الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ: إِنَّهُ يُعِيدُ هُوَ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said regarding a man who prays without ablution:
entries.matn_en: regarding the man who prays without ablution: "He must repeat the prayer, and so must those who prayed with him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا فَسَدَتْ صَلَاةُ الْإِمَامِ؛ فَسَدَتْ صَلَاةُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifah narrated from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: When the prayer of the imam becomes invalid, the prayer of those behind him also becomes invalid.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ بِمَكَّةَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ «يَا أَهْلَ مَكَّةَ إِنَّا قَوْمُ سَفَرٍ، فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَلَدِ فَلْيُكْمِلْ» . فَأَكْمَلَ أَهْلُ الْبَلَدِ
entries.isnad_en: Narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, prayed the Zuhr prayer in Mecca as two rak'ahs. When he finished, he said "O people of Mecca, we are travelers. Whoever among you is a resident of this city should complete it." So the residents of the city completed their prayer.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُسَافِرِ يَدْخُلُ فِي صَلَاةِ مُقِيمٍ، قَالَ: «يُتِمُّ الصَّلَاةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding the traveler who joins the prayer of a resident: "He completes the prayer."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنه صَلَّى بِمِنًى أَرْبَعًا، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه فَاسْتَرْجَعَ، ثُمَّ تَهَيَّأَ لِلصَّلَاةِ مَعَ عُثْمَانَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ: أَتُصَلِّي مَعَهُ وَقَدِ اسْتَرْجَعْتَ؟ قَالَ: «الْخِلَافُ شَرٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Uthman, ؓ, prayed four rak'ahs at Mina. This reached Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, so he said , "Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un," then he prepared to pray with Uthman. Some of his companions said to him, "Will you pray with him after you said, 'Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un'?" He replied, "Disagreement is evil."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُغَطِّيَ الرَّجُلُ فَاهُ وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ الْمَرْأَةُ وَهِيَ مُتَنَقِّبَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that
entries.matn_en: that he disapproved of a man covering his mouth during prayer and disapproved of a woman praying while wearing a face veil.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَسْمَعُ قِرَاءَةَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه بِاللَّيْلِ فِي بَيْتِهِ، وَابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ فِي بَيْتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Muhammad b. Amr
entries.matn_en: that he used to hear the recitation of Ibn Mas'ud at night in his house while Ibn Mas'ud was in his own house.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: " أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانَ يُصَلِّي إِلَى جَنْبِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه، فَسَمِعَهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: {رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا} [طه: 114] ، فَعَلِمَ الرَّجُلُ أَنَّهُ فِي طه "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that a man was praying beside Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, and heard him say, “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.” The man realized that Ibn Mas‘ud was reciting from Surah Ta-Ha.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا صَلَّى الرَّجُلُ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَصَلَ إِلَيْهَا أُخْرَى، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ فِي صَلَاةِ الْقَوْمِ، فَإِذَا صَلَّى مَعَهُمْ ثِنْتَيْنِ وَتَشَهَّدَ سَلَّمَ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ شِمَالِهِ، وَصَلَّى مَعَهُمْ مَا بَقِيَ، وَيَجْعَلُهَا سُبْحَةً»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said
entries.matn_en: that he said: “If a man has prayed one rak‘ah and then the iqama is called, he should add another rak‘ah to it and then join the congregation. After praying two rak‘ahs with them and reciting the tashahhud, he should give the salutation to his right and left, then pray with them what remains, making it a voluntary prayer.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 30
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي ذَلِكَ :
entries.matn_ar: «يُضِيفُ إِلَيْهَا أُخْرَى، ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ وَيَجْعَلُهَا سُبْحَةً وَيَدْخُلُ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ، وَيَجْعَلُهَا الْفَرِيضَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from ‘Amir that he said regarding that [Qur’an 31]: "
entries.matn_en: “He should add another rak‘ah to it, then give the salutation and make it a voluntary prayer; then he should join the congregation and make that the obligatory prayer.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 31
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ الْفَرِيضَةَ فِي بَيْتِكَ، ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتَ مَعَ الْقَوْمِ، فَاجْعَلْهَا نَافِلَةً؛ فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا الْفَرِيضَةَ، وَلَا تُطِيعُكَ الْحَفَظَةُ فَيَجْعَلُونَهَا الْفَرِيضَةَ، وَقَدْ صَلَّيْتَ الْفَرِيضَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: If you have prayed the obligatory prayer in your home, then pray with the congregation, make it a voluntary prayer, for you cannot make it the obligatory one, nor will the recording angels obey you to make it the obligatory prayer, since you have already prayed the obligatory prayer.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 31
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «صَلَاةُ الْقَاعِدِ نِصْفُ صَلَاةِ الْقَائِمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa‘id ibn Jubayr that he said
entries.matn_en: The prayer of the one sitting is half the prayer of the one standing.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 31
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ:
entries.matn_ar: «تَقْعُدُ فِي صَلَاتِهَا كَيْفَ شَاءَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said regarding the woman:
entries.matn_en: "She sits in her prayer however she wishes."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 31
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ وَسَلَّمَ، فَكَأَنَّمَا هُوَ عَلَى الرَّضْفِ حَتَّى يَنْحَرِفَ»
entries.isnad_en: On the authority of his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from Abu Bakr, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that when he finished his prayer and gave the salutation, it was as if he were on hot coals until he turned away.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 31
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا كَانَتْ فِي رِجْلِكَ الْيُسْرَى قُرْحَةٌ فَلَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ تَقْعُدَ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ، قَعَدْتَ عَلَى يَمِينِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: If there is an ulcer on your left foot and you cannot sit on your left side, then sit on your right side.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 31
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ "
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدَةَ: إِنَّهَا لَا تَقْضِيهَا؛ لِأَنَّهَا تَدَعُ مَا هُوَ أَوْجَبُ مِنْهَا، الصَّلَاةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifah narrated from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding a menstruating woman who hears the prostration verse: "She does not make it up, because she leaves what is more obligatory than it—the prescribed prayer."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 31
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «سَوُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ، سَوُّوا مَنَاكِبَكُمْ، تَرَاصُّوا، لَتَرَاصُنَّ أَوْ لَيَخَلَّلَنَّكُمْ كَأَوْلَادِ الْحَذَفِ، يَعْنِي الشَّيْطَانَ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى مُقِيمِي الصُّفُوفِ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he used to say: “Straighten your rows, align your shoulders, and close up the gaps. Stand close together, or Satan will slip between you like the young al-Hadhaf sheep. God and His angels bless those who keep the rows straight.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 32
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «يَؤُمُّ الْقَوْمَ أَقْرَؤُهُمْ لِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ كَانُوا فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ سَوَاءً فَأَقْدَمُهُمْ هِجْرَةً، فَإِنْ كَانُوا فِي الْهِجْرَةِ سَوَاءً فَأَقْدَمُهُمْ سِنًّا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: The one who leads the people in prayer is the most proficient of them in reciting the Book of God. If they are equal in recitation, then the one who emigrated first. If they are equal in emigration, then the eldest among them.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 32
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا قَهْقَهَ الرَّجُلُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ أَعَادَ الْوُضُوءَ وَالصَّلَاةَ، وَإِذَا تَبَسَّمَ أَوْ كَشَّرَ مَضَى عَلَى صَلَاتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: When a man laughs out loud in prayer, he must repeat his ablution and his prayer. But if he smiles or grimaces, he may continue his prayer.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 32
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْعَطُوفِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ، قَالَ: «مَا كُلُّكُمْ يَجِدُ ثَوْبَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father said Abu al-Atuf narrated to me from al-Zuhri from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib from Abu Hurayrah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, was asked about prayer in a single garment. He said: "Not all of you can find two garments."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 33
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضَعَ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ لَأْمَتَهُ، فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ، فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فِي جَفْنَةٍ فِيهَا أَثَرُ عَجِينٍ، فَاغْتَسَلَ وَصَلَّى أَرْبَعًا أَوْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ مُتَوَشِّحًا بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Harith b. Abd al-Rahman from Abu Salih from Umm Hani’ ؓ
entries.matn_en: that on the day of the conquest of Mecca the Prophet, ﷺ, took off his armor and asked for water. It was brought in a large bowl with traces of dough in it. He performed ghusl and prayed four—or two—rak‘ahs in a single garment draped around him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 33
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما أَمَّ قَوْمًا فِي بَيْتِهِ فِي ثَوْبٍ قَدْ خَالَفَ بَيْنَ طَرَفَيْهِ، وَإِلَى جَنْبِهِ مِشْجَبٌ عَلَيْهِ ثِيَابٌ، لَوْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَ مِنْهُ ثَوْبًا لَفَعَلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that Jabir b. Abdillah, ؓ, led a people in prayer in his house wearing a single garment whose ends he had crossed over, and beside him was a clothes rack with garments on it; had he wished to take a garment from it, he could have done so.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 33
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «السَّيْفُ وَالْقَوْسُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الرِّدَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: The sword and the bow are like the garment.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 33
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ «جَابِرًا رضي الله عنه أَمَّهُمْ فِي قَمِيصٍ صَفِيقٍ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ غَيْرُهُ» . وَلَا أُرَاهُ أَرَادَ إِلَّا لِيُرِيَنَا أَنَّهُ لَا بَأْسَ بِالصَّلَاةِ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ata b. Yasar
entries.matn_en: that Jabir, ؓ, led them in prayer wearing a thick shirt and nothing else. I do not think he intended anything except to show us that there is no harm in praying in a single garment.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 33
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ حُذَيْفَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ خَرَجَ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ، فَبَصُرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَشَى إِلَى جَنْبِهِ، فَذَهَبَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ، فَبَاعَدَهَا حُذَيْفَةُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَا لَكَ؟» قَالَ: إِنِّي جُنُبٌ. قَالَ: «ادْنُ، إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ لَيْسَ بِنَجَسٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that Hudhayfah, ؓ, went out while in a state of major ritual impurity. The Prophet, ﷺ, saw him and walked beside him. The Prophet, ﷺ, went to place his hand on him, but Hudhayfah moved away. The Prophet, ﷺ, said to him, "What is the matter with you?" He said, "I am in a state of major ritual impurity." He said, "Come near, for the Muslim is not impure."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 34
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا: «نَاوِلِينِي الْخُمْرَةَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ» . فَقَالَتْ: إِنِّي حَائِضٌ. فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ حَيْضَتَكِ لَيْسَتْ بِيَدِكِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Aisha, ؓ, who said
entries.matn_en: The Prophet, ﷺ, said to her, "Hand me the mat from the mosque." She said, "I am menstruating." He said, "Your menstruation is not in your hand."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 34
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي «الرَّجُلِ يَدْخُلُ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ، وَهُوَ لَا يَنْوِي صَلَاةَ الْإِمَامِ، فَصَلَاةُ الْإِمَامِ تَامَّةٌ، وَيَسْتَقْبِلُ الرَّجُلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding "the man who joins the Imam while not intending the Imam’s prayer: the Imam’s prayer is complete, and the man must restart his prayer."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 34
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ ثَمَانِيَ رَكَعَاتٍ، وَيُوتِرُ بِثَلَاثٍ، وَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, used to pray after the final 'Isha prayer until Fajr—eight rak'ahs in between—and perform Witr with three rak'ahs, and pray the two rak'ahs of Fajr.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 34
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ وَبَلَغَنِي عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي «الرَّجُلِ يَؤُمُّ الْقَوْمَ وَهُوَ يَنْظُرُ فِي الْمُصْحَفِ إِنَّهُ يَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ» ، وَقَالَ: «كَفِعْلِ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father who said It reached me from Ibn Abbas, ؓ, that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding "a man leading the people in prayer while looking into the Mushaf: It is disliked," and he said: "It is like the practice of the People of the Book."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 34
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ «عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه مَرَّ بِرَجُلٍ يُتَابِعُ بَيْنَ السُّجُودِ، فَكَرِهَ ذَلِكَ أَوْ نَهَاهُ» . وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: بَلَغَنِي ذَلِكَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that Umar, ؓ, passed a man who was performing prostrations one after another. Umar disapproved of this or forbade him. Abu Hanifah said: “This has reached me from the Prophet, ﷺ.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 35
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مَرَّ بِأَبِي ذَرٍّ رضي الله عنه وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي صَلَاةً وَجِيزَةً خَفِيفَةً يُكْثِرُ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ: أَنْتَ صَاحِبُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتُصَلِّي هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ؟ فَقَالَ: أَلَمْ أُتِمَّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ؟ قَالَ: بَلَى. قَالَ: فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ سَجَدَ لِلَّهِ سَجْدَةً رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً فِي الْجَنَّةِ، فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أُرْفَعَ دَرَجَاتٍ، أَوْ تُكْتَبَ لِي دَرَجَاتٌ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that a man passed by Abu Dharr (ؓ) while he was praying a brief, light prayer, frequently bowing and prostrating. When he finished, the man said to him, "You are a companion of the Prophet (ﷺ), yet you pray this prayer?" Abu Dharr replied, "Did I not complete the bowing and prostration?" The man said, "Yes." Abu Dharr said, "I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: 'Whoever prostrates to God in a prostration, God raises him a degree in Paradise by it.' So I loved to be raised in degrees or to have degrees written for me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 35
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ عَدَّ الْآيِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he disapproved of counting verses in prayer.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 35
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: «تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا، وَتَغْتَسِلُ إِذَا مَضَتْ أَيَّامُهَا، وَتَغْتَسِلُ فِي آخِرِ وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ فَتُصَلِّيهَا، ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ فِي أَوَّلِ وَقْتِهَا، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ فِي آخِرِ وَقْتِ الْمَغْرِبِ فَتُصَلِّيهَا، وَتُصَلِّي الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ فِي أَوَّلِ وَقْتِهَا، وَتَغْتَسِلُ لِلْفَجْرِ وَتُصَلِّي»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: regarding the woman experiencing istihadah: She leaves off prayer during the days of her menstrual cycle, then bathes when those days have passed. She bathes at the end of the time for Dhuhr and prays it, then prays Asr at the beginning of its time. Then she bathes at the end of the time for Maghrib and prays it, then prays Isha at the beginning of its time, and bathes for Fajr and prays it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 35
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَوَّلَ مَا جَالَسْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما، إِذْ جَاءَهُ كِتَابٌ مِنَ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ: إِنِّي قَدِ اسْتُحِضْتُ فَلَا يَنْقَطِعُ عَنِّي الدَّمُ. قَالَ سَعِيدٌ: فَقَرَأْتُهُ، فَقَالَ لِي: هَلْ قَرَأْتَهُ قَبْلَهَا؟ فَقُلْتُ: لَا. فَقَالَ: لَقَدْ أَعْجَبَتْنِي قِرَاءَتُكَ لَهُ، فَشَغَلَنِي ذَلِكَ عَنْ فَهْمِهِ. قَالَ: أَعِدْ عَلَيَّ. فَأَعَدْتُ عَلَيْهِ. قَالَ: فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهَا: «تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ فِي أَيَّامِ أَقْرَائِهَا، فَإِذَا مَضَتِ اغْتَسَلَتْ، ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ» . قَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: بِذَلِكَ كَانَ حَمَّادٌ يَأْخُذُ، وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَأَرَى أَنْ تَتَوَضَّأَ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَلَا تَغْتَسِلُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr who said
entries.matn_en: who said: “The first time I sat with Ibn Abbas, ؓ, a letter came to him from a Qurashi woman: ‘I am experiencing irregular bleeding, and the blood does not stop.’ Sa‘id said: ‘I read it to him.’ He asked me, ‘Had you read it before?’ I said, ‘No.’ He said, ‘I was impressed by your reading of it, and that distracted me from understanding it. Read it to me again.’ I read it to him again. He then wrote to her: ‘Do not pray during the days of your usual menstrual period. When they have passed, perform ghusl, then perform ghusl for each prayer.’ Abu Hanifah said: ‘Hammad followed this view. I, however, hold that she should perform wudu for each prayer and not perform ghusl.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 35
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ، قَالَ «تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ الَّتِي طَهُرَتْ فِي وَقْتِهَا وَحْدَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the woman who becomes pure before the sun sets: "She makes up only the prayer whose time she became pure in."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 36
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي النُّفَسَاءِ وَالْحَائِضِ: «تَقْتَدِي بِأَيَّامِ نِسَائِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding a woman with postpartum bleeding and a menstruating woman: “She follows the usual menstrual pattern of the women in her family.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 36
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ، قَالَ «تَقْضِيهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the woman who becomes pure during the time of a prayer: "She makes it up."

sections.title_en: Chapter on Forgetfulness

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 36
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ يُصَلِّي، فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَثَلَاثًا صَلَّى أَمْ أَرْبَعًا، فَلْيَتَحَرَّ الصَّوَابَ، فَإِنْ كَانَ أَكْثَرَ رَأْيِهِ أَنَّهُ ثَلَاثٌ، فَلْيُصَلِّ إِلَيْهَا رَابِعَةً، وَإِنْ كَانَ أَكْثَرَ رَأْيِهِ أَنَّهُ أَرْبَعٌ، فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ وَيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ وَيَتَشَهَّدْ وَيُسَلِّمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Abu Wa’il, from Ibn Mas’ud, ؓ, who said
entries.matn_en: When one of you is praying and does not know whether he has prayed three or four rak’ahs, let him seek what is most likely correct. If he is more certain that it was three, let him pray a fourth. If he is more certain that it was four, let him finish, prostrate twice for forgetfulness, recite the tashahhud, and give the salutation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 36
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ " عَلْقَمَةَ صَلَّى خَمْسًا، فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: كَذَاكَ يَا أَعْوَرُ؟ - لِرَجُلٍ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ - فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ. فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ، ثُمَّ حَدَّثَهُمْ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ صَنَعَ ذَلِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Alqamah prayed five rak‘ahs. Some of the people pointed this out to him. He asked a man among them, “Is that so, one-eyed man?” The man replied, “Yes.” Alqamah then performed the two prostrations of forgetfulness and told them that the Prophet, ﷺ, had done the same.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 36
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ فِي كُلِّ تَطَوُّعٍ أَوْ مَكْتُوبَةٍ، وَقَالَ «إِنَّهُمَا تُصْلِحَانِ مَا أُفْسِدَ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ» . وَيَقُولُ: «أَسْجُدْهُمَا وَهُمَا لَيْسَتَا عَلَيَّ، أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أَتْرُكَهُمَا وَهُمَا عَلَيَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he would perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness in every voluntary or obligatory prayer. He said , "They rectify what has been corrupted in the prayer." And he would say, "Performing them when they are not obligatory upon me is more beloved to me than leaving them when they are obligatory upon me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 36
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِي فِي سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ:
entries.matn_ar: «هُمَا الْمُرْغِمَتَانِ، تُصْلِحَانِ مَا أُفْسِدَ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ، وَيُتَشَهَّدُ فِيهِمَا وَيُسَلَّمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: to me regarding the two prostrations of forgetfulness: “They are the two humbling prostrations; they rectify what was spoiled in the prayer. One recites the tashahhud in them and gives the salutation.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى أَنْ يَقْرَأَ فِي الْأُولَيَيْنِ، قَالَ «يَقْرَأُ فِي الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ، وَعَلَيْهِ سَجْدَتَا السَّهْوِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the man who forgets to recite in the first two rak'ahs: He should recite in the last two rak'ahs, and he must perform two prostrations of forgetfulness.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا شَكَّ الرَّجُلُ فِي الْوُضُوءِ أَوْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ أَوَّلَ مَا لَقِيَ، أَعَادَ الْوُضُوءَ وَالصَّلَاةَ، وَإِذَا كَانَ يَلْقَى ذَلِكَ كَثِيرًا مَضَى عَلَى ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: When a man doubts his ablution or his prayer, and this is the first time he has encountered such doubt, he should repeat the ablution and the prayer. But if he frequently encounters such doubt, he should proceed without repeating.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ فِي السَّهْوِ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا لَقِيتَ ذَلِكَ مِرَارًا تَحَرَّيْتَ الصَّوَابَ، ثُمَّ بَنَيْتَ عَلَى مَا تَرَى أَنَّهُ صَوَابٌ، وَسَجَدْتَ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim who said regarding forgetfulness: "
entries.matn_en: If you encounter that repeatedly, you should strive to determine what is correct, then act upon what you believe to be correct, and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا سَهَوْتَ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ، وَحَفِظَ الْإِمَامُ، فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ سَهْوٌ، وَإِنْ سَهَا وَحَفِظْتَ فَعَلَيْكَ السَّهْوُ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْجُدِ الْإِمَامُ فَلَا تَسْجُدْ، وَكَذَلِكَ إِذَا سَهَا جَمِيعُ مَنْ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ أَوْ سَهَا الْإِمَامُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: who said: “If you forget something while praying behind the imam and the imam remembers correctly, there is no prostration of forgetfulness for you. If the imam forgets while you remember, then the prostration of forgetfulness is due from you. If the imam does not perform the prostration, do not perform it. The same applies if everyone praying with the imam forgets, or if the imam forgets.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ تَغَيَّرَ عَنْ حَالِهِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَقَدْ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّهْوُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: Whoever changes from his state during prayer has made forgetfulness obligatory upon himself.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي سَجْدَةِ السَّهْوِ: «يَتَشَهَّدُ بَعْدَهَا وَيُسَلِّمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding the prostration of forgetfulness: "He recites the tashahhud after it and gives the salutation."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا سَبَقَكَ الْإِمَامُ بِشَيْءٍ وَقَدْ سَهَا فَاسْجُدْ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ قُمْ فَاقْضِ مَا سَبَقَكَ بِهِ، وَإِذَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ فِي أَيَّامِ التَّشْرِيقِ فَلَا تُكَبِّرْ حَتَّى تُقْضَى الصَّلَاةُ، ثُمَّ تُكَبِّرُ بَعْدَ مَا تُسَلِّمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: If the imam precedes you in something and then makes a mistake, prostrate with him. Then stand and complete what he preceded you in. If this occurs during the days of Tashriq, do not say the takbir until the prayer is completed, then say the takbir after you give the salam.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " ثَلَاثَةٌ صَنَعَهُنَّ النَّاسُ: التَّسْلِيمُ فِي سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ، وَفِي الْجِنَازَةِ، وَالتَّكْبِيرُ فِي الْقُنُوتِ فِي الْوِتْرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: "There are three practices that people have introduced: giving salutations in the two prostrations of forgetfulness, giving salutations during the funeral prayer, and saying the takbir in the qunut of the Witr prayer."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَسْبِقُهُ الْحَدَثُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ: إِنَّهُ «يَنْصَرِفُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ، فَإِنْ تَكَلَّمَ اسْتَقْبَلَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمِ اعْتَدَّ بِمَا مَضَى، وَصَلَّى مَا بَقِيَ» . وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: يَتَكَلَّمُ وَيَسْتَقْبِلُ الصَّلَاةَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding a man whose ablution is broken during prayer: “He should leave the prayer and perform ablution. If he speaks, he must start the prayer over; if he does not speak, he may count what he has already prayed and complete what remains.” Ibrahim added: “I prefer that he speak and start the prayer over.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 38
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ أَبِي يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: " أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْدَثَ خَلْفَ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ رضي الله عنه فِي الصَّلَاةِ، فَانْفَتَلَ فَتَوَضَّأَ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ وَهُوَ حَاسِرٌ عَنْ ذِرَاعِهِ، وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: {وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلُوا وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ} [آل عمران: 135] ، فَاعْتَدَّ بِمَا مَضَى، وَصَلَّى مَا بَقِيَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf b. Abi Yusuf narrated to us from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abdul-Malik b. Umayr from Ma'bad b. Subayh
entries.matn_en: that a man from the Companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, broke his ablution while praying behind Uthman b. Affan, ؓ. He left, performed ablution, and returned with his forearm uncovered, reciting: “And they did not persist in what they had done, knowingly” [Qur’an 3:135]. He then counted what he had already prayed and completed what remained.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 38
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا جَلَسَ الرَّجُلُ قَدْرَ التَّشَهُّدِ ثُمَّ أَحْدَثَ، فَقَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلَاتُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: When a man sits for the duration of the tashahhud and then breaks wind, his prayer is complete.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 38
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ رضي الله عنها: «إِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلَاةَ، فَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ وَصَلِّي» حِينَ شَكَتْ إِلَيْهِ: إِنِّي أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلَا أَطْهُرُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Hisham b. Urwah, from his father, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, said to Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh, ؓ: When menstruation begins, leave the prayer, and when it ends, wash the blood from yourself and pray. This was when she complained to him, saying: "I experience irregular bleeding and do not become pure."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 38
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو يُوسُفَ: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «إِذَا ذَهَبَ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِكِ، فَاغْتَسِلِي وَتَوَضَّئِي لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ» . وَبِهِ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ «إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَجْرِي فِي الْإِنْسَانِ مَجْرَى الدَّمِ فِي الْعُرُوقِ، فَإِذَا سَجَدَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَتَاهُ فَنَفَخَ فِي دُبُرِهِ لِيُرِيَهُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَحْدَثَ، فَإِذَا أَحَسَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلَا يَنْصَرِفْ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ صَوْتًا أَوْ يَجِدَ رِيحًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated: Abu Yusuf said Abu Hanifah narrated to me from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: “When your menstrual days have passed, perform ghusl and perform wudu for every prayer.” Yusuf followed this view. Through his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, it is reported that Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, said: “Satan moves through a person as blood moves through the veins. When one of you prostrates, Satan comes and blows at his backside to make him think he has broken his ablution. If one of you senses something of that, let him not leave until he hears a sound or detects an odor.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 38
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا قَعَدَ الرَّجُلُ قَدْرَ التَّشَهُّدِ، فَقَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلَاتُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: When a man sits for the duration of the tashahhud, his prayer is complete.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 39
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «إِذَا تَكَلَّمَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ أَوْ ضَحِكَ فَقَهْقَهَ، فَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْرَ تَشَهُّدٍ، فَصَلَاتُهُ فَاسِدَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who speaks before the salutation or laughs aloud: if he has sat for the duration of the tashahhud, his prayer is invalid.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 39
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «حَتَّى يَقْعُدَ قَدْرَ التَّشَهُّدِ» . يَعْنِي فِي الَّذِي يُحْدِثُ
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he said
entries.matn_en: "Until he sits for the duration of the tashahhud," meaning in the case of one who breaks his ablution.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 39
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ السَّدْلَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he used to disapprove of letting the garment hang loose during prayer.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 39
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «مَرَّ بِرَجُلٍ سَادِلًا رِدَاءَهُ، فَعَطَفَهُ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ali b. al-Aqmar
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, passed by a man who was letting his cloak hang down, so he folded it over him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 39
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «أَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الرَّجُلُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَالْإِمَامُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ، وَهُوَ يَنْوِي عَنْ صَلَاةِ الْإِمَامِ، كَأَنَّهُ مُشَاقٌّ لِلْإِمَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: that he said: “I dislike a man praying in the mosque while the imam is leading prayer, intending to perform the same prayer as the imam; it is as though he were opposing the imam.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 39
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُمْسِكَ الرَّجُلُ الدَّرَاهِمَ الْبِيضَ مَعَهُ وَهُوَ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ إِذَا كَانَتْ فِي صُرَّةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: There is no harm in a man keeping silver dirhams with him while he is not in a state of ablution, if they are in a pouch.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 39
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " لَوْ أَنِّي قُلْتُ: رَأَيْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، وَابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنهما يَسْجُدَانِ فِي: إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ لَقُلْتُ، فَأَمَّا الْيَقِينُ فَأَحَدُهُمَا "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifah narrated from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, who said
entries.matn_en: who said: “If I were to say, ‘I saw Umar b. al-Khattab and Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, prostrating during Idha al-Sama’ Unshaqqat (Surah al-Inshiqaq),’ I would be telling the truth. What I know for certain is that one of them did.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 40
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ لَا يَسْجُدُ فِي ص وَلَا يَسْجُدُ فِي سُورَةِ الْحَجِّ إِلَّا فِي الْأُولَى»
entries.isnad_en: On the authority of his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he "
entries.matn_en: would not prostrate in Sad nor would he prostrate in Surah al-Hajj except in the first one."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 40
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، رَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهُ سَجَدَ فِي ص»
entries.isnad_en: On the authority of his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Abd al-Karim, who raised the hadith to the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that he prostrated in Sad.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 40
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ عَلْقَمَةَ فِي مَحْمَلٍ، فَقَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ، فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ السَّجْدَةَ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَثِبَ، فَقَالَ «ابْنَ أَخِي، الْإِيمَاءُ يُجْزِئُكَ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he was with Alqamah in a litter. He recited the Quran, and when he reached the prostration, he wanted to jump down. So he said , "O nephew, a gesture is sufficient for you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 40
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي فَوْقَ الْمَسْجِدِ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ، وَالْإِمَامُ فِي أَسْفَلَ، أَوْ يُصَلِّي فِي الصَّفِّ وَحْدَهُ: إِنَّهُ «يُجْزِئُهُ ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf, from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said regarding the man who prays on an upper level of the mosque with the imam below, or who prays alone in the row:
entries.matn_en: regarding the man who prays above the mosque with the imam while the imam is below, or prays alone in the row: "That suffices for him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 40
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: " أَنَّهُ أَخَذَ قَمْلَةً وَهُوَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَدَفَنَهَا فِي الْحَصَى، وَقَرَأَ: {أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا} [المرسلات: 26]
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Asim b. Abi al-Najud from Abu Razin from Ibn Masud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he caught a louse while in the mosque, buried it in the gravel, and recited: "Have We not made the earth a container for the living and the dead?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 41
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ خَمْسَ تَرْوِيحَاتٍ فِي رَمَضَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim:
entries.matn_en: “People used to perform five tarwihat (rest periods) in Ramadan.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 41
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَؤُمُّ النِّسَاءَ فِي رَمَضَانَ تَطَوُّعًا، وَتَقُومُ فِي وَسَطِ الصَّفِّ»
entries.isnad_en: On the authority of his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she used to lead women in voluntary prayers during Ramadan, standing in the middle of the row.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 41
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ إِذَا دَخَلَ رَمَضَانَ صَلَّى وَصَامَ، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ الْعَشْرُ الْأَوَاخِرُ شَدَّ الْمِئْزَرَ، وَأَحْيَا اللَّيْلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from someone who narrated to him from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that when Ramadan began, he would pray and fast. When the last ten days came, he would gird himself for worship and spend the night in worship.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 41
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ، قَالَ فِيمَا أَحْسِبُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَا أَشُكُّ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ قَالَ: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، حِينَ يُصْبِحُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، لَمْ تَضُرَّهُ عَقْرَبٌ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، أَوْ حِينَ يُمْسِي لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ عَقْرَبٌ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ "
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from Dhakwan—who said , "As I recall, from Abu Hurayrah, ؓ, from the Prophet, ﷺ, and I do not doubt that he said: '
entries.matn_en: Whoever says, I seek refuge in the perfect words of God from the evil of what He has created, three times in the morning, no scorpion will harm him until the evening. And if he says it in the evening, no scorpion will harm him until the morning.'"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 41
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يَنْصَرِفُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَأَخَّرَ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ؛ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ بِهَا عَشْرُ حَسَنَاتٍ، وَمُحِيَ عَنْهُ بِهَا عَشْرُ سَيِّئَاتٍ، وَرُفِعَ لَهُ بِهَا عَشْرُ دَرَجَاتٍ، وَكَانَ فِي جِوَارِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا حِينَ يَنْصَرِفُ مِنَ الْمَغْرِبِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَحَرَّكَ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ؛ كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifah reported from Abd al-Karim, from the Prophet, ﷺ, that he said
entries.matn_en: Whoever, upon finishing the Fajr prayer before moving from his place, says: "There is no god but God, alone without partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise, He gives life and causes death, and He is ever-living and never dies, in His hand is all good, and He has power over all things," ten times—ten good deeds will be recorded for him, ten sins will be erased from him, and ten degrees will be raised for him. He will be under God’s protection until evening. Whoever says it upon finishing the Maghrib prayer before moving from his place will receive the same.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 42
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ شَيْخٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ قَالَ: {فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ} [الروم: 17] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ؛ لَمْ يَسْبِقْهُ شَيْءٌ كَانَ فِي يَوْمِهِ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا حِينَ يُمْسِي؛ لَمْ يَسْبِقْهُ شَيْءٌ كَانَ فِي لَيْلَتِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from an elder who said
entries.matn_en: Whoever says, "So exalted is God when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning" [Ar-Rum: 17] to the end of the verse three times in the morning, nothing that happens in his day will overtake him. And whoever says it in the evening, nothing that happens in his night will overtake him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 42
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، قَالَ بَلَغَنِي
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ وَهِيَ تُسَبِّحُ بِنَوَاتِهَا، فَقَامَ عَلَيْهَا هُنَيَّةً، ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهَا: «لَقَدْ قُلْتُ كَلِمَاتٍ، لَهُنَّ أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا قُلْتِ» . ثُمَّ أَخْبَرَهَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ زِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, who said: It has reached me that the Messenger of God, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: passed by Umm Salamah while she was glorifying God with her date stones. He stood beside her briefly, then said: “I have said words that outweigh what you have said.” He then told her that he had said: “Glory be to God as many times as His creatures; glory be to God, as heavy as His Throne; glory be to God, as much as the ink of His words.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 43
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ قَالَ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا خَلَقَ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِلْءَ مَا أَحْصَى كِتَابُهُ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَقَالَ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ، قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ النَّاسُ فِي يَوْمِهِمْ إِلَّا مَنْ قَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ، وَمَنْ قَالَهَا حِينَ يُمْسِي، قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ النَّاسُ فِي لَيْلَتِهِمْ إِلَّا مَنْ قَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ "
entries.isnad_en: On the authority of his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad b. Abd al-Rahman b. Sa'd b. Zurarah, from Abu Umamah, ؓ, that the Prophet, ﷺ, said
entries.matn_en: Whoever says: "Glory be to God as much as the number of what He has created, glory be to God filling what He has created, glory be to God as much as the number of what is in the heavens and the earth, glory be to God as much as the number of what His book has recorded, glory be to God filling what His book has recorded, glory be to God as much as the number of everything," and says: "Praise be to God" likewise in the morning, he will have said what the people have said in their day except for one who says the same or more. And whoever says it in the evening, he will have said what the people have said in their night except for one who says the same as him or more.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 43
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ سَمَرَا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ، فَخَرَجَا فَخَرَجَ مَعَهُمَا، فَمَرَّا بِابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ غَضًّا كَمَا أُنْزِلَ، فَلْيَقْرَأْ عَلَى قِرَاءَةِ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ» . وَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ لَهُ: «سَلْ تُعْطَهْ» . فَأَتَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ رضي الله عنهما يُبَشِّرَانِهِ، فَسَبَقَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عُمَرَ فَبَشَّرَهُ، وَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ دَعَا لَهُ، فَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا لَا يَرْتَدُّ، وَنَعِيمًا لَا يَنْفَدُ، وَمُرَافَقَةَ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ فِي أَعْلَى جَنَّةِ الْخُلْدِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that Abu Bakr and Umar sat with the Prophet, ﷺ, one night. They left, and he went out with them. They passed by Ibn Mas'ud while he was reciting, so the Prophet, ﷺ, said "Whoever wishes to recite the Quran as fresh as it was revealed, let him recite according to the recitation of Ibn Umm Abd." And he kept saying to him: "Ask, and you shall be given." Then Abu Bakr and Umar, ؓ, came to him to give him the good news. Abu Bakr outran Umar and gave him the good news, informing him that the Prophet had supplicated for him. So Ibn Mas'ud said: "O God, I ask You for faith that does not revert, bliss that does not end, and the companionship of Your Prophet Muhammad in the highest gardens of eternity."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 43
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «لَا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يُغَطِّيَ الرَّجُلُ رَأْسَهُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: There is no harm in a man covering his head during prayer.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 44
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «مَا زَادَ عَلَى وَاحِدٍ فَهُوَ جَمَاعَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: Whatever exceeds one is a congregation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 44
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " أَمَا إِنَّ لِكُلِّ حَرْفٍ تَلَاهُ تَالٍ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ عَشْرُ حَسَنَاتٍ، أَمَا إِنِّي لَا أَقُولُ: الم، وَلَكِنِ الْأَلِفُ وَاللَّامُ وَالْمِيمُ ثَلَاثُونَ حَسَنَةً "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Asim b. Abi al-Najud, from Abu al-Ahwas, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he said
entries.matn_en: "Indeed, for every letter recited from the Quran, there are ten good deeds. I do not say that Alif Lam Mim is one letter, but rather the Alif, the Lam, and the Mim are thirty good deeds."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 44
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانَ يُقْرِئُهُ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، وَكَانَ أَعْجَمِيًّا، فَجَعَلَ يَقُولُ: {إِنَّ شَجَرَةَ الزَّقُّومِ، طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ} [الدخان: 44] فَجَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَقُولُ: طَعَامُ الْيَتِيمِ، فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ، كُلَّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ: طَعَامُ الْيَتِيمِ فَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: قُلْ: «طَعَامُ الْفَاجِرِ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ: " إِنَّ الْخَطَأَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ لَيْسَ أَنْ تَقُولَ: الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ، الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ، إِنَّمَا الْخَطَأُ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ آيَةَ الرَّحْمَةِ آيَةَ الْعَذَابِ، وَآيَةَ الْعَذَابِ آيَةَ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَأَنْ يُزَادَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَا لَيْسَ فِيهِ "
entries.isnad_en: From his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: A man was reciting to Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, and he was non-Arab. He began saying, "Indeed, the tree of Zaqqum is the food of the sinner," but the man kept saying, "the food of the orphan." Ibn Mas‘ud corrected him, yet every time he still said , "the food of the orphan." So Ibn Mas‘ud said, "Say, 'the food of the wicked.'" Then Ibn Mas‘ud said, "The mistake in the Quran is not saying, 'the Forgiving, the Merciful, the Mighty, the Wise.' Rather, the mistake is reciting a verse of mercy as a verse of punishment, or a verse of punishment as a verse of mercy, and adding to the Book of God what is not in it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 44
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّهُ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ فِي رَكْعَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، وَفِي الثَّانِيَةِ بِقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr
entries.matn_en: that he recited the entire Quran in the Ka'bah in one unit of prayer, and in the second unit with "Say: He is God, the One."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 44
entries.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه كَانَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «حَسِّنُوا الْقُرْآنَ بِأَصْوَاتِكُمْ»
