This is according to the word of God the Exalted: “Let two just men among you judge it” until the end of the verse.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 109
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ بَيْنَا أَنَا جَالِسٌ
entries.matn_ar: عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما إِذْ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ ظَبْيًا وَأَنَا مُحْرِمٌ. فَقَالَ: «فَإِنِّي أَحْكُمُ عَلَيْكَ أَنَا وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ بِشَاةٍ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ، فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَضَيْتُ نُسُكِي إِلَّا الطَّوَافَ، قَالَ: «فَانْطَلِقْ فَطُفْ ثُمَّ ارْجِعْ إِلَيَّ» ، فَرَجَعَ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَدْ طُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ، قَالَ: «فَانْطَلِقْ فَاسْتَقْبِلِ الْعَمَلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Qays, from Abu Bakr b. Abi Musa, who said While I was sitting
entries.matn_en: with Ibn Abbas, ؓ, a man came to him and said, "I hunted a gazelle while I was in the state of ihram." Ibn Abbas said, "I and Abu Bakr judge that you must offer a sheep as expiation." Then another man came to him and said, "I have completed my rites except for the tawaf." He said, "Go and perform the tawaf, then return to me." The man returned and said, "I have performed the tawaf around the House." He said, "Go and resume your actions."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 110
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا حُجَّاجًا
entries.matn_ar: حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا رَبَذَةَ إِذْ رُفِعَ لَنَا خِبَاءٌ، فَقُلْنَا: مَا هَذَا؟ قَالَ: خِبَاءُ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رضي الله عنه، فَأَتَيْنَاهُ فَرَفَعَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ جَانِبَ الْخِبَاءِ فَقَالَ: «مِنْ أَيْنَ أَقْبَلَ الْقَوْمُ؟» قَالَ: فَقُلْنَا مِنَ الْعِرَاقِ. قَالَ: «وَأَيْنَ تُرِيدُونَ؟» قَالَ: قُلْنَا نُرِيدُ الْبَيْتَ. قَالَ: «فَوَاللَّهِ مَا أَخْرَجَكُمْ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ؟» قَالَ: فَحَلَفْنَا لَهُ، فَقَالَ: «إِذَا فَرَغْتُمْ فَاسْتَأْنِفُوا الْعَمَلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad b. Malik, from his father, who said We set out as pilgrims
entries.matn_en: until we reached Rabadhah, where we saw a tent. We asked, “What is this?” They said, “It is the tent of Abu Dharr, ؓ.” We went to him, and he lifted one side of the tent and asked, “Where have you come from?” We said, “Iraq.” He asked, “Where are you headed?” We said, “We intend to go to the House.” He said, “By God, is that the only reason you have set out?” We swore that it was. He said, “When you have finished, resume your work.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 110
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ شَيْخٍ مِنْ بَنِي رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ الْقُرَشِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ «الْحَاجُّ مَغْفُورٌ لَهُ
entries.matn_ar: وَلِمَنِ اسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُ إِلَى انْسِلَاخِ الْمُحَرَّمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from an elder of Banu Rabi'ah, from Mu'awiyah b. Ishaq al-Qurashi, that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said "The pilgrim is forgiven
entries.matn_en: , and so is whoever he seeks forgiveness for, until the end of Muharram."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 110
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَائِذٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْحَاجُّ وَالْمُعْتَمِرُ
entries.matn_ar: وَالْغَازِي فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَفْدُ اللَّهِ دَعَاهُمْ فَأَجَابُوهُ، وَحَقٌّ عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُمْ مَا سَأَلُوا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ibn A'idh from Mujahid from the Prophet, ﷺ, that he said "The pilgrim
entries.matn_en: , the one performing 'umrah, and the warrior in the path of God are the delegation of God. He called them and they answered Him, and it is a right upon God to give them what they ask for."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 111
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ
entries.matn_ar: قَلَائِدَ هَدْيِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَيَبْعَثُ بِهَا وَيُقِيمُ حَلَالًا فِي أَهْلِهِ وَلَا يُحْرِمُ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ» . فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: وَلَكِنْ لَا يَخْرُجُ الَّذِي يُبْعَثُ بِهَا مُقَلَّدَةً يَؤُمُّ الْبَيْتَ إِلَّا مُحْرِمًا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Aisha, ؓ, that she said
entries.matn_en: I used to twist the garlands for the Messenger of God’s sacrificial animals. He would send the animals off while remaining out of ihram with his family; garlanding them did not put him in ihram. Aisha added: “But the person who sets out toward the House with the garlanded animals must do so in ihram.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 111
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ «إِذَا قَلَّدَ الرَّجُلُ
entries.matn_ar: هَدْيَهُ وَهُوَ يَؤُمُّ الْبَيْتَ فَقَدْ أَحْرَمَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim who said When a man designates
entries.matn_en: When a man garlands his sacrificial animal while heading toward the House, he has entered ihram.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 111
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: «اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ» وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ ذُكِرَ عِنْدَهُ مَعْقِلُ بْنُ مُقَرِّنٍ وَمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَذُكِرَ رَجُلٌ بَعَثَ هَدْيًا وَأَحْرَمَ وَهُوَ مُقِيمٌ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, said
entries.matn_en: "O God, do not make me one of those who impose hardship upon themselves." This was because Ma'qil b. Muqarrin and what he had forbidden upon himself were mentioned in his presence, and a man who sent a sacrificial animal and entered ihram while still residing in his home was also mentioned.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 111
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يُحْرِمُ
entries.matn_ar: حَتَّى يُقَلِّدَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said He does not enter ihram
entries.matn_en: until he places the garland (on the sacrificial animal).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 111
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «أَهْدَيْتُ بَدَنَةً
entries.matn_ar: فَهَلَكَتْ، فَاشْتَرَيْتُ هَدْيًا آخَرَ مَكَانَهَا، وَوَجَدْتُ الْأُولَى فَنَحَرْتُهُمَا جَمِيعًا» ، وَقَالَتِ: «الْأُولَى كَانَتْ تُجْزِئُ عَنِّي»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Aisha, ؓ, that she said I had offered a she-camel
entries.matn_en: as a sacrificial animal, but it perished, so I bought another sacrificial animal in its place. Then I found the first one, so I slaughtered them both. She also said: The first one would have sufficed for me.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا أَهْدَى
entries.matn_ar: هَدْيًا تَطَوُّعًا فَعَطِبَ وَنَحَرَهُ وَغَمَسَ نَعْلَهُ فِي دَمِهِ، ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِهَا عَلَى جَنْبِهِ ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ، وَسَأَلَتْ خَالَتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها فَقَالَتْ «أَكْلُهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ تَرْكِهِ لِلسِّبَاعِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Mansur from Ibrahim from Aisha that her husband had offered
entries.matn_en: that her husband had set out a voluntary sacrificial animal, but it became incapacitated. He slaughtered it, dipped his sandal in its blood, struck its side with the sandal, and left it. Her aunt asked Aisha, ؓ, about this. She replied, “I would prefer that it be eaten rather than left for wild beasts.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه قَالَ «تُجْزِئُ عَنْكَ
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا بَلَغْتَ الْمَنْسَكَ، يَعْنِي الْعَرْجَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from a man from Ali, ؓ, who said
entries.matn_en: "It will suffice for you once it reaches the slaughtering place—meaning the lame she-camel.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ «الْبُدْنُ
entries.matn_ar: مِنَ الْبَقَرِ وَالْإِبِلِ، وَالْهَدْيُ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ وَالْبَقَرِ وَالْغَنَمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said "The budn
entries.matn_en: are from cattle and camels, and the hady is from camels, cattle, and sheep."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {فَمَنْ تَعَجَّلَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ} [البقرة: 203] : «بَرِئَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ» {وَمَنْ تَأَخَّرَ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ} [البقرة: 203] : «بَرِئَ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Abdullah b. Mas'ud, ؓ, regarding the saying of God the Exalted
entries.matn_en: : "But whoever hastens to leave in two days, there is no sin on him"—he is free from sin—"and whoever stays on, there is no sin on him"—he is free from sin.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا سُئِلَتْ عَنْ مُحْرِمٍ مَاتَ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ بِهِ؟ قَالَتْ «اصْنَعُوا بِهِ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ بِمَوْتَاكُمْ؛ فَإِنَّهُ حِينَ مَاتَ ذَهَبَ إِحْرَامُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she was asked about a pilgrim who died: what should be done with him? She said Do with him what you do with your dead, for when he died, his state of ihram ended.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 112
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {الْحَجُّ أَشْهُرٌ مَعْلُومَاتٌ} [البقرة: 197] : «شَوَّالٌ، وَذُو الْقِعْدَةِ، وَعَشْرٌ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: regarding the saying of God the Exalted: "Hajj is [during] well-known months" – that they are Shawwal, Dhu al-Qi'dah, and the first ten days of Dhu al-Hijjah.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 112
entries.matn_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {فَمَنْ فَرَضَ فِيهِنَّ الْحَجَّ فَلَا رَفَثَ وَلَا فُسُوقَ وَلَا جِدَالَ فِي الْحَجِّ} [البقرة: 197] قَالَ الرَّفَثُ : الْجِمَاعُ، وَالْفُسُوقُ: الْمَعَاصِي وَالْجِدَالُ قَوْلُكَ: لَا وَاللَّهِ، بَلَى وَاللَّهِ "
entries.matn_en: In the saying of God the Exalted: "Whoever undertakes the duty of Hajj therein, let there be no obscenity, nor wickedness, nor wrangling in the Hajj." [Al-Baqarah: 197], he said "Obscenity" refers to sexual intercourse, "wickedness" refers to sins, and "wrangling" refers to saying, "No, by God," and "Yes, by God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 113
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي جَهْمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ بَعْدَ الْغَدَاةِ أُسْبُوعًا، ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ، فَلَمْ يَرْكَعْ حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَابْيَضَّتْ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Bakr b. Abi Jahm,
entries.matn_en: who said I saw Ibn Umar, ؓ, circumambulate the House after the morning prayer seven times, then he departed and did not pray until the sun had risen and brightened, then he prayed two rak'ahs.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 113
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَجُوزٍ مِنَ الْعَتِيكِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ " لَا بَأْسَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ فِي أَيِّ أَشْهُرِ السَّنَةِ شِئْتَ، مَا خَلَا خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ السَّنَةِ: يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ، وَيَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، وَأَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Yazid Abu Khalid, from an old woman of the Atik tribe, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she said "There is no harm in performing Umrah in any of the months of the year you wish, except for five or four days of the year: the Day of Arafah, the Day of Sacrifice, and the Days of Tashriq."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 114
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، رَأَيْتُكَ تَصْنَعُ أَرْبَعَ خِصَالٍ، قَالَ: «مَا هُنَّ؟» قَالَ: رَأَيْتُكَ حِينَ أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تُحْرِمَ رَكِبْتَ رَاحِلَتَكَ ثُمَّ اسْتَقْبَلْتَ الْقِبْلَةَ فَأَحْرَمَتْ حِينَ انْبَعَثَ بِكَ بَعِيرُكَ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ إِذَا طُفْتَ بِالْبَيْتِ لَمْ تَجُزِ الرُّكْنَ الْيَمَانِيَّ حَتَّى تَسْتَلِمَهُ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ تُلَوِّنُ لِحْيَتَكَ بِالصُّفْرَةِ، وَرَأَيْتُكَ تَوَضَّأُ فِي النِّعَالِ السِّبْتِيَّةِ. فَقَالَ: «إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Ubaydullah b. Umar, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: , ؓ, who said: “A man said to me, ‘Abu Abd al-Rahman, I have seen you do four things.’ I asked, ‘What are they?’ He said, ‘When you intended to enter ihram, I saw you mount your camel and face the qiblah; you entered ihram when your camel set off carrying you. When you circumambulate the House, you do not pass the Yemeni Corner without touching it. I saw you dye your beard yellow, and perform ablution while wearing tanned-leather sandals with the hair removed.’ Ibn Umar replied, ‘I saw the Messenger of God, ﷺ, do all of these things.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 114
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَجُوزٍ مِنَ الْعَتِيكِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ " لَا بَأْسَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ فِي أَيِّ أَشْهُرِ السَّنَةِ، مَا خَلَا خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ أَرْبَعَةَ أَيَّامٍ مِنَ السَّنَةِ: يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ، وَيَوْمَ النَّحْرِ، وَأَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Yazid Abu Khalid, from an old woman of the Atik tribe, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she said "There is no harm in performing Umrah in any of the months of the year, except for five days or four days of the year: the Day of Arafah, the Day of Sacrifice, and the Days of Tashriq."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 114
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَالَ لِلْحَجَرِ: «إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ حَجَرٌ، مِثْلُكَ لَا يَضُرُّ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ، وَلَوْلَا أَنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبَّلَكَ لَمَا قَبَّلْتُكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, said to the Black Stone: "I know that you are a stone, you can neither harm nor benefit. Had I not seen the Messenger of God, ﷺ, kiss you, I would not have kissed you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 115
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنِ اشْتَرَطَ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَشْتَرِطْ سَوَاءٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said "Whoever stipulates a condition and whoever does not stipulate are the same."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 115
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهُمَا مُحْرِمَانِ: «يَمْضِيَانِ فِي وَجْهِهِمَا وَيُهْدِي كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا هَدْيًا حَتَّى يَفْرُغَا، وَعَلَيْهِمَا الْحَجُّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ، وَيَتَفَرَّقَا إِذَا أَحْرَمَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the one who has intercourse with his wife while both are in ihram: "They should continue on their way and each of them must offer a sacrificial animal until they complete their rites. They must also perform Hajj the following year, and they must separate when they enter ihram."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 115
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «إِذَا قَبَّلَ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنْ شَهْوَةٍ أَوْ لَامَسَ؛ فَعَلَيْهِ دَمٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said If a pilgrim in ihram kisses out of desire or touches, he must offer a sacrificial animal.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 115
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَا أَتَيْتُ الرُّكْنَ الْيَمَانِيَّ قَطُّ إِلَّا وَجَدْتُ عِنْدَهُ جِبْرِيلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that he said Whenever I came to the Yemeni Corner, I always found Jibril there.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 115
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَوَّارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَاضِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ مُحْرِمٌ بِالْقَاحَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Sawwar from Abu Hadir from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, was cupped while he was fasting and in a state of ihram at Al-Qahah.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 116
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَزَوَّجَ مَيْمُونَةَ رضي الله عنها وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ بِعُسْفَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, married Maymunah, ؓ, while he was in the state of ihram at Usfan.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 116
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْحَلْقُ أَفْضَلُ لِلرِّجَالِ مِنَ التَّقْصِيرِ، وَالتَّقْصِيرُ أَفْضَلُ لِلنِّسَاءِ مِنَ الْحَلْقِ، وَمَا أَقَلَّتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الْأَخْذِ فَهُوَ أَفْضَلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “For men, shaving the head is better than shortening the hair; for women, shortening is better than shaving. The less hair a woman trims, the better.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 116
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ رَمَلٌ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَلَا سَعْيٌ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “Women do not perform ramal (brisk walking) during tawaf, nor walk briskly during sa‘i between Safa and Marwah.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 116
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو رضي الله عنهما،
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ مَكَّةَ وَبَيْعَ رِبَاعِهَا وَأَخْذَ أُجُورِ بُيُوتِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ubaydullah b. Abi Ziyad, from Abu Najih, from Abdullah b. Amr, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, said "God has made Mecca sacred, and He has forbidden the sale of its real estate and the taking of rent for its houses."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 117
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ «أَنَّ حَوْلَ الْكَعْبَةِ قُبُورَ ثَلَاثِمِائَةِ نَبِيٍّ، وَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَهْرُبْ نَبِيٌّ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ إِلَّا لَاذَ بِهَا مُجَاوِرًا حَتَّى يَمُوتَ بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Salim
entries.matn_en: that it reached him: "Around the Ka'bah are the graves of three hundred prophets, and no prophet fled from his people except that he took refuge near it, residing there until he died."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 117
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْكَعْبَةِ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ» ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: أَرِنِي الْمَكَانَ الَّذِي صَلَّى فِيهِ. قَالَ: فَبَعَثَ مَعِيَ ابْنَهُ، قَالَ: فَكَأَنِّي غَمَصْتُهُ، فَقَالَ: «لَا تَزْدَرِ بِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ صَالِحِ الْمَتَاعِ» ، ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ بِي فَأَرَانِي عِنْدَ الْأُسْطُوَانَةِ الْوُسْطَى تَحْتَ الْجِذْعَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Sa‘id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ‘Umar,
entries.matn_en: who said: “The Prophet, ﷺ, prayed four rak‘ahs inside the Ka‘bah.” I [Sa‘id ibn Jubayr] said to Ibn Umar, “Show me the place where he prayed.” Ibn Umar sent his son with me. It seemed I had looked down on the son, so he said, “Do not underestimate me; I am a valuable asset.” He then led me and showed me the place by the middle pillar, beneath the crossbeam.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 117
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَهُوَ وَجِعٌ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ يَسْتَلِمُ الْأَرْكَانَ بِمِحْجَنِهِ ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ دَعَا عَبَّاسًا فَسَأَلَهُ شَرَابًا، فَقَالَ أَمِنْ شَرَابِ الْخَاصَّةِ أَوْ مِنْ شَرَابِ الْعَامَّةِ؟ قَالَ: «لَا، بَلْ مِنْ شَرَابِ الْعَامَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him from al-Hasan
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, circumambulated the House while ill, riding his mount and touching the corners with his hooked staff. He then prayed two rak‘ahs and called for al-Abbas, asking him for a drink. Al-Abbas asked, “Would you like the drink of the elite or the drink of the common people?” He replied, “No, the drink of the common people.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 118
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَطُوفُ أَنَا وَعِكْرِمَةُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ. قَالَ: وَكُنْتُ أصْعَدُ عَلَى الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ، وَلَا يَصْعَدُ. قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: مَا لَكَ لَا تَصْعَدُ؟ قَالَ: هَكَذَا طَافَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم. فَلَقِيتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: «كَذَبَ الْخَبِيثُ، طَافَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ شَاكٍ بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ يَسْتَلِمُ الْأَرْكَانَ بِمِحْجَنِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad
entries.matn_en: that he said I was performing the circuits between al-Safa and al-Marwah with Ikrimah. He said: I would ascend al-Safa and al-Marwah, but he would not ascend. He said: So I asked him, "Why do you not ascend?" He said, "This is how the Prophet, ﷺ, performed the circuits." Then I met Sa'id ibn Jubayr and asked him about that, and he said, "The wicked one lied. The Prophet, ﷺ, performed the circuits while ill around the House on his mount, touching the corners with his staff."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 118
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُجَامِعُ بَعْدَ مَا يَقِفُ بِعَرَفَاتٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ: «إِنَّ عَلَيْهِ بَدَنَةً، وَيُتِمُّ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ حَجِّهِ، وَحَجُّهُ تَامٌّ» .
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from ‘Ata’ from Ibn ‘Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the man who has intercourse after standing at ‘Arafat but before circumambulating the House: He must offer a camel, complete the remaining rites of his Hajj, and his Hajj is valid.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 118
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَ قَوْلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ سَوَاءً
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa‘id ibn Jubayr from Ibn ‘Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: the same as Ibrahim’s statement exactly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 118
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي مُحْرِمٍ جَامَعَ قَبْلَ عَرَفَةَ أَوْ بَعْدَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَطُوفَ بِالْبَيْتِ: «عَلَيْهِ فِي الْوَجْهَيْنِ جَمِيعًا شَاةٌ شَاةٌ، وَيَقْضِي مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ حَجِّهِ، وَعَلَيْهِ الْحَجُّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a pilgrim who engaged in intercourse before standing at Arafah or after it before circumambulating the House: "In both cases, he must offer a sheep, complete the remaining rites of his pilgrimage, and perform the pilgrimage again the following year."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 118
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، وَمَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِيمَنْ طَافَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ وَلَمْ يَرْمُلْ قَالَ «فَأَجْمَعَا أَنْ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ» وَقَرَأَ عَلَى مَيْمُونٍ فِي قِرَاءَةِ أُبَيٍّ رضي الله عنه: " {إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ} [البقرة: 158] " إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: " أَنْ لَا يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from ‘Ata b. Abi Rabah and Maymun b. Mihran
entries.matn_en: regarding the one who performs the circuits between al-Safa and al-Marwah without trotting: Both agreed that there is nothing upon him. And Maymun recited in the recitation of Ubayy, ؓ: "Indeed, al-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of God" up to His saying: "that he should not perform the circuits between them."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 119
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا لَمْ يُدْرِكْ جَمْعًا فَقَدْ فَاتَهُ الْحَجُّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: : “If someone does not reach Jam‘ (Muzdalifah), he has missed Hajj.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 119
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ بَيْنَمَا عُمَرُ بِجَمْعٍ إِذْ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، إِنِّي قَدِمْتُ السَّاعَةَ وَأَنَا مُهِلٌّ بِالْحَجِّ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: «أَتُهْدَى إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ؟» قَالَ: لَا. فَأَرْسَلَ مَعَهُ رَجُلًا فَقَالَ: «انْطَلِقْ بِهِ إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ وَلْيَقِفْ بِهَا، ثُمَّ الْعَجَلَ عَلَيَّ، فَإِنِّي حَابِسٌ النَّاسَ عَلَيْكَ» . فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه وَقَفَ بِالنَّاسِ، ثُمَّ جَعَلَ يَقُولُ: «هَلْ جَاءَ الرَّجُلُ؟» فَقَالُوا: لَا. فَلَمْ يَزَلْ حَابِسًا النَّاسَ حَتَّى جَاءَ، فَأَفَاضَ وَأَفَاضَ النَّاسُ مَعَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “While Umar was at Jam‘ (Muzdalifah), a man came and said, ‘Commander of the Faithful, I have just arrived, having entered ihram for Hajj.’ Umar asked him, ‘Have you gone to Arafat?’ He said, ‘No.’ Umar sent a man with him and said, ‘Take him to Arafat and have him stand there, then hurry back to me; I am holding the people here for you.’ In the morning Umar stood with the people and kept asking, ‘Has the man arrived?’ They said, ‘No.’ He continued holding the people until the man arrived. Then Umar departed from Muzdalifah, and the people departed with him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 119
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَدِمَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ وَهُوَ مُهِلٌّ بِالْحَجِّ، فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُهِلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ، وَجَعَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَجَّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that a man arrived on the Day of Sacrifice while he was in the state of ihram for Hajj. He commanded him to enter the state of ihram for Umrah and made Hajj obligatory upon him for the following year.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 119
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَبْصَرَهُمْ عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ يُهِلُّونَ وَيُكَبِّرُونَ قَالَ «هِيَ هِيَ هِيَ هِيَ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ» . قَالَ: فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ سُئِلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: «كَلِمَةُ التَّقْوَى، وَهُمْ أَحَقُّ بِهَا وَأَهْلُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Musa b. Abi Kathir, from someone who narrated to him, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he saw the people at the Jamrah proclaiming the talbiyah and takbir. He said, “That is it—yes, that is it—by the Lord of the Ka‘bah.” When he departed, he was asked about this, and he said, “It is the word of piety, and they are most entitled to it and worthy of it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 120
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا تَرَكَ الرَّجُلُ الْوَقْتَ، فَعَلَيْهِ دَمٌ إِلَّا أَنْ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: : “If a man passes the appointed miqat without entering ihram, he owes a dam (sacrificial offering), unless he returns to it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 120
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ «كَانَ رَمَلَ فِي الطَّوَافِ الْأَوَّلِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ مِنَ الْحَجَرِ إِلَى الْحَجَرِ» .
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, would perform ramal (brisk walking) in the first three circuits of the tawaf from the Black Stone back to it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 121
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: the same as that.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 121
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «أَكْرَهُ لِلْمُحْرِمِ أَنْ يُغَطِّيَ فَاهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said I disapprove for the pilgrim in ihram to cover his mouth.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 121
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ حُيَيٍّ رضي الله عنها أَنْ تَصْدُرَ، فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي حَائِضٌ. فَقَالَ: «عَقْرَى حَلْقَى، إِنَّكِ الْآنَ لَحَابِسَتُنَا» . ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ فَقَالَ: «أَمَا كُنْتِ طُفْتِ بِالْبَيْتِ طَوَافَ يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ» ؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ. قَالَ: «فَاصْدُرِي»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: Safiyyah bint Huyayy, ؓ, to leave. She said, “I am menstruating.” He exclaimed in frustration, “You are going to hold us up now!” He then asked, “Had you not already performed the tawaf of the House on the Day of Sacrifice?” She said, “Yes.” He said, “Then depart.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 121
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ لِلْمُحْرِمِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ أَنْ يَتَسَوَّكَ وَيَعْصِرَ الْقُرْحَةَ وَيَبُطَّ الْجَرْحَ، وَيَجْبُرَ الْكَسْرَ، وَيَرْبِطَ عَلَى الْجَبَائِرِ، وَيَتَدَاوَى بِمَا أَحَبَّ، وَيَكْتَحِلَ بِمَا أَحَبَّ بَعْدَ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ أَدْوِيَتِهِ وَأَكْحَالِهِ طِيبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said There is no harm for a man or woman in ihram to use the tooth-stick, squeeze a boil, open a wound, set a fracture, bind splints, treat themselves with whatever they wish, and apply kohl with whatever they wish, provided there is no perfume in any of their medicines or kohl.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 122
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْمُحْرِمَ إِذَا أَصَابَهُ أَذًى فِي جَسَدِهِ، أَوْ فِي رَأْسِهِ، فَيَتَدَاوَى بِدَوَاءٍ فِيهِ طِيبٌ أَوْ حَلَقَهُ، كَفَّرَ أَيَّ الْكَفَّارَاتِ شَاءَ: إِنْ شَاءَ صَامَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَطْعَمَ سِتَّةَ مَسَاكِينَ، لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ نِصْفُ صَاعٍ مِنْ بُرٍّ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ ذَبَحَ شَاةً فَتَصَدَّقَ بِلَحْمِهَا، فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {فَفِدْيَةٌ مِنْ صِيَامٍ} [البقرة: 196] فَهُوَ هَذَا الصِّيَامُ، {أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ} [البقرة: 196] هِيَ هَذِهِ الصَّدَقَةُ {أَوْ نُسُكٍ} [البقرة: 196] فَهُوَ شَاةٌ يَذْبَحُهَا فَيَتَصَدَّقُ بِلَحْمِهَا فَمِنْ هَذَا النُّسُكُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that if a pilgrim in ihram suffers harm to his body or head and treats it with medicine containing perfume or shaves his head, he may expiate with any of the expiations he wishes: if he wishes, he may fast three days; if he wishes, he may feed six poor persons, giving each poor person half a sa‘ of wheat; or if he wishes, he may slaughter a sheep and give its meat in charity. That is the saying of God the Exalted: “Then an expiation of fasting,” and this is that fast; “or charity,” and this is that charity; “or sacrifice,” and that is a sheep he slaughters and gives its meat in charity, so from this is the sacrifice.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 122
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رَفِيعٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَبَّلْتُ امْرَأَتِي وَأَنَا مُحْرِمٌ فَحَذَفْتُ بِشَهْوَتِي، قَالَ: «إِنَّكَ لَشَبِقٌ، أَهْرِقْ دَمًا، وَتَمَّ حَجُّكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abd al-Aziz b. Rafi from Mujahid from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that a man came to him and said, “I kissed my wife while I was in ihram, and I ejaculated from desire.” Ibn Abbas said, “You are indeed sexually driven. Offer a sacrificial animal, and your Hajj is complete.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 122
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «يَغْتَسِلُ الْمُحْرِمُ وَيَصُبُّ الْمَاءَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَيَرْفُقُ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said The pilgrim in ihram may bathe, pour water over his head, and do so gently.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 123
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، وَالْأَسْوَدِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا أَفَاضَا مَعَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهم جَمِيعًا، فَسَمِعْنَاهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ حِينَ أَفَاضَ: أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ «عَلَيْكُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةِ؛ فَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ لَيْسَ فِي إِيضَاعِ الْإِبِلِ، وَإِنَّ بَعِيرَهُ لَمْ يَزَلْ يَقْصَعُ بِجَرَّتِهِ حَتَّى نَزَلْنَا جَمْعًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah and Al-Aswad,
entries.matn_en: from Alqamah and al-Aswad, who said: “We departed from Arafat with Umar, ؓ. As he set out, we heard him say, ‘People, remain calm. Righteousness does not consist in driving camels swiftly.’ His camel kept chewing its cud until we reached Jam‘ (Muzdalifah).”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 123
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي رَجُلٍ قَالَ: هُوَ يُهْدِي رَجُلًا حُرًّا، قَالَ: «يَحُجُّهُ» ، قَالَ: وَقَالَ فِيمَنْ قَالَ: هُوَ يُهْدِي عَبْدَهُ: «أَهْدَاهُ، أَوْ هُوَ يُهْدِي عَبْدَ غَيْرِهِ اشْتَرَاهُ فَأَهْدَاهُ أَوْ أَهْدَى ثَمَنَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said about a man who says, “I dedicate a free man to pilgrimage”: “He should send him to perform Hajj.” He also said about someone who says, “I dedicate my slave”: “He may dedicate that slave; if he dedicates another person’s slave, he must buy him and then dedicate him—or dedicate the slave’s price.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 123
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَدْهِنُ الْمُحْرِمُ الشُّقَاقَ بِالسَّمْنِ وَالْوَدَكِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said The pilgrim in ihram may anoint cracks with clarified butter and fat.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 123
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «ادْهِنِ الشُّقَاقَ بِمَا أَكَلْتَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr
entries.matn_en: that he said "Treat the cracks [of your skin] with whatever you eat."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 123
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما: أَيَغْسِلُ الْمُحْرِمُ ثِيَابَهُ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَصْنَعُ بِدَرَنِهِ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Mujahid,
entries.matn_en: who said I asked Ibn Umar, ؓ, "Should the pilgrim in ihram wash his clothes?" He said, "Yes, for God does not care about his filth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 123
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ خَرَجَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ عَلَى مِيلَيْنِ أَوْ فَرْسَخَيْنِ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ بِعُمْرَةٍ أَحْرَمَ بِالْحَجِّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Nafi’, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he set out until he was two miles or two farsakhs from Medina while in the state of ihram for Umrah, then he entered ihram for Hajj.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 124
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُحْرِمِ: تَكُونُ بِهِ الْقُرُوحُ فَيَتَدَاوَى بِالطِّيبِ ثُمَّ تَخْرُجُ بِهِ قُرُوحٌ أُخْرَى قَبْلَ أَنْ تَبْرَأَ فَيَتَدَاوَى، «إِنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَيَّ الْكَفَّارَاتِ شَاءَ كَفَّارَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the pilgrim in ihram who has sores and treats them with perfume, then other sores appear before the first heal and he treats them: "He may choose whichever of the expiations he wishes; it is one expiation."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 124
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الطَّوَافُ لِلْغُرَبَاءِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him, from Ata b. Abi Rabah,
entries.matn_en: : “For visitors from outside Mecca, tawaf is dearer to me than prayer.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 124
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ أَبِي كَانَ شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا، فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَحُجَّ حَتَّى مَاتَ، أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ: «أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ دَيْنٌ فَقَضَيْتَهُ أَمَا كَانَ يُجْزِئُ عَنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham
entries.matn_en: that a man came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and said , "My father was an elderly man and could not perform Hajj until he died. Shall I perform Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "If your father had a debt and you paid it off, would it not suffice for him?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 124
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي قَضَيْتُ الْمَنَاسِكَ كُلَّهَا غَيْرَ الطَّوَافِ بِالْبَيْتِ، ثُمَّ وَاقَعْتُ أَهْلِي، قَالَ: «فَاقْضِ مَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْكَ وَأَهْرِقْ دَمًا، وَعَلَيْكَ الْحَجُّ مِنْ قَابِلٍ» ، قَالَ: فَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي جِئْتُ مِنْ شُقَّةٍ بَعِيدَةٍ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ja'far b. Muhammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said A man came to him and said, "I have completed all the rites of Hajj except the Tawaf around the House, then I had relations with my wife." He said, "Complete what remains for you, offer a sacrifice, and you must perform Hajj again next year." The man returned to him and said, "I have come from a distant land." So he replied to him as he had before.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 125
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ بِعَرَفَاتٍ: «إِنْ تَطَوَّعَ بَيْنَهُمَا صَلَّى كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَتَطَوَّعْ بَيْنَهُمَا صَلَّاهُمَا بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the prayer at Arafat: "If one volunteers to pray between them, he should pray each one with a call to prayer (adhan) and a commencement (iqamah). If he does not volunteer between them, he should pray them both with one call to prayer and two commencements."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 125
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الصَّلَاتَيْنِ بِجَمْعِ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ: «إِذَا تَطَوَّعْتَ بَيْنَهُمَا فَصَلِّ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَتَيْنِ وَإِذَا لَمْ يَتَطَوَّعْ بَيْنَهُمَا صَلَّاهُمَا بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the two prayers at Muzdalifah—combining Maghrib and Isha: "If you offer voluntary prayers between them, then pray each one with its own call to prayer and two iqamahs. But if you do not offer voluntary prayers between them, then pray them both with one call to prayer and one iqamah."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 125
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ تَرَكَ طَوَافَ الصَّدْرِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ فَعَلَيْهِ دَمٌ، وَمَنْ تَرَكَهُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ شَيْءٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said Whoever among the men omits the farewell circumambulation must offer a blood sacrifice, but whoever among the women omits it owes nothing.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 125
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ عَطِشَ وَهُوَ يَطُوفُ، فَمَالَ إِلَى زَمْزَمَ فَشَرِبَ وَصَبَّ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he became thirsty while performing Tawaf, so he turned toward Zamzam, drank from it, and poured some over his face.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 125
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سُرَاقَةَ بْنَ مَالِكِ بْنِ جُعْشُمٍ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أَرَأَيْتَ عُمْرَتَنَا هَذِهِ لِعَامِنَا أَمْ لِلْأَبَدِ؟ قَالَ: «لِلْأَبَدِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir b. Abd Allah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that Suraqah b. Malik b. Ju'shum said O Messenger of God, is this Umrah of ours for this year only or forever? He said: "Forever."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 126
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رضي الله عنه:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سُرَاقَةَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ فَحُدِّثْنَا عَنْ دِينِنَا هَذَا كَأَنَّا خُلِقْنَا لَهُ السَّاعَةَ نَعْمَلُ لِشَيْءٍ قَدْ جَرَتْ بِهِ الْمَقَادِيرُ وَجَفَّتْ بِهِ الْأَقْلَامُ أَمْ لِشَيْءٍ يُسْتَقْبَلُ؟ قَالَ: «بَلْ لِشَيْءٍ قَدْ جَرَتْ بِهِ الْمَقَادِيرُ، وَجَفَّتْ بِهِ الْأَقْلَامُ» ، قَالَ: فَفِيمَ الْعَمَلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «اعْمَلُوا فَكُلٌّ مُيَسَّرٌ لِمَا خُلِقَ» ، قَالَ: ثُمَّ قَرَأَ الْآيَةَ {فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَى وَاتَّقَى وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى} [الليل: 6] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that Suraqah b. Malik, ؓ, said: “We have been told about this religion of ours as though we had only just been created for it. Are we to act in matters already decreed and written down, or in matters yet to come?” The Prophet replied, “Rather, act in matters already decreed and written down.” Suraqah asked, “Then what is the point of acting, Messenger of God?” He said, “Act, for each person is facilitated toward what he was created for.” Then he recited the verse: “As for the one who gives, is mindful of God, and affirms the best [reward] …” through the end of the verse.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 126
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ بَعَثَ مَعَ عَلْقَمَةَ بِهَدْيٍ فَقَالَ انْحَرْ وَكُلْ ثُلُثًا، وَتَصَدَّقْ بِثُلُثٍ وَابْعَثْ إِلَى آلِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ بِثُلُثٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he sent Alqamah with an offering and said "Slaughter it, eat a third, give a third in charity, and send a third to the family of Utbah b. Mas'ud."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 127
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَارَ قَوْمًا فَذَبَحُوا لَهُ شَاةً، فَأَدْخَلَ لُقْمَةً مِنَ اللَّحْمِ فِي فَمِهِ، فَجَعَلَ لَا يُسِيغُهُ، فَقَالَ «مَا شَأْنُ هَذَا اللَّحْمِ؟» ، قَالُوا: هَذِهِ شَاةُ فُلَانٍ ذَبَحْنَاهَا حَتَّى يَجِيءَ فَنُرْضِيَهُ مِنْ شَاتِهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَطْعِمُوهَا الْأَسْرَى» يَعْنِي الْمَسَاكِينَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Asim b. Kulayb, from Abu Burdah, from Abu Musa, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, visited some people who slaughtered a sheep for him. He put a morsel of its meat in his mouth but could not swallow it. He asked, “What is the matter with this meat?” They replied, “It is so-and-so’s sheep. We slaughtered it before he arrived, intending to compensate him with one of his sheep.” The Prophet, ﷺ, said, “Give it to the captives”—meaning the poor.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 127
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِيمَنْ يُجَامِعُ أُمَّ امْرَأَتِهِ: «لَا تُحَرَّمُ عَلَيْهِ امْرَأَتُهُ؛ لَا يُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَرَامُ الْحَلَالَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Musa b. Abi Kathir from Amir
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who has intercourse with his wife’s mother: "His wife does not become unlawful to him; what is unlawful does not render what is lawful unlawful."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 128
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَتَّقِيكُمْ كَمَا تَتَّقُونَهُ، فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُ فَلَا تَهَابُوهُ فَيَرْكَبَكُمْ، وَلَكِنْ شُدُّوا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّهُ يَهْرَبُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Mujahid,
entries.matn_en: who said Satan fears you just as you fear him. So when you see him, do not be afraid of him, lest he overpower you. Instead, stand firm against him, for he will flee.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 128
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْبَصْرِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُمَّةُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, from the one who reported to him, from al-Hasan al-Basri,
entries.matn_en: that he said "The family of Muhammad, ﷺ, are the community of Muhammad, ﷺ."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 128
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «إِذَا زَنَتْ أُمُّ الْوَلَدِ فَلَا تُبَاعُ عَلَى حَالٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said If the mother of a child (concubine) commits adultery, she is not to be sold under any circumstances.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 128
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ بَعْضِ، أَصْحَابِهِ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَمَّمَهُ بِعِمَامَةٍ سَوْدَاءٍ، وَأَسْدَلَ لَهَا مِنْ خَلْفِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from some of his companions
entries.matn_en: that Gabriel came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and wrapped him in a black turban, letting its end hang down behind him.

sections.title_en: Chapters on Divorce

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 128
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو يُوسُفَ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما «طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فِي حَيْضِهَا، فَعِيبَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَاجَعَهَا وَطَلَّقَهَا فِي طُهْرِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated to us, saying: Abu Hanifah narrated to us from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Umar, ؓ, divorced his wife while she was menstruating. This was criticized, so he took her back and then divorced her while she was in a state of purity.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 128
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ أَبْغَضُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الطَّلَاقِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said There is nothing among what God has made lawful that is more hateful to God than divorce.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 128
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُطَلِّقُ امْرَأَتَهُ فَيُعْلِمُهَا وَيُرَاجِعُهَا، فَيُشْهِدُ وَلَا يُعْلِمُهَا: «أَنَّهَا امْرَأَتُهُ أَعْلَمَهَا أَوْ لَمْ يُعْلِمْهَا» قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: قَوْلُ عَلِيٍّ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ قَوْلِ عُمَرَ، يَعْنِي فِي امْرَأَةِ أَبِي كَنَفٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who divorces his wife, informs her of it, then takes her back, and bears witness to it but does not inform her: "She is his wife whether he informs her or not." Ibrahim said "The statement of Ali is more beloved to me than the statement of Umar," referring to the case of the wife of Abu Kanaf.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 129
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْحَامِلُ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا يُنْفَقُ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ نَصِيبِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Habib b. Abi Thabit from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "A pregnant woman whose husband has died is to be provided for from her share."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 129
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «كُلُّ فُرْقَةٍ كَانَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْمَرْأَةِ فَلَيْسَ بِطَلَاقٍ، وَكُلُّ فُرْقَةٍ كَانَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الزَّوْجِ فَهُوَ طَلَاقٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said "Every separation initiated by the woman is not a divorce, and every separation initiated by the husband is a divorce."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 129
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا كَنَفٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَأَعْلَمَهَا، وَرَاجَعَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا وَلَمْ يُعْلِمْهَا، فَجَاءَ وَقَدْ تَزَوَّجْتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فَأَتَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ الْخَبَرَ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «إِنْ وَجَدْتَهُ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا فَأَنْتَ أَحَقُّ بِهَا وَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ دَخَلَ بِهَا فَلَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهَا سَبِيلٌ» . فَقَدِمَ وَقَدْ وَضَعَتِ الْقُصَّةَ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا، فَقَالَ: إِنَّ لِي حَاجَةً فَأَخْلُونِي، فَفَعَلُوا، فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا وَبَاتَ عِنْدَهَا، ثُمَّ غَدَا إِلَى الْأَمِيرِ بِكِتَابِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَعَرَفُوا أَنَّهُ قَدْ جَاءَ بِأَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim:
entries.matn_en: Abu Kanaf divorced his wife and informed her, then took her back before her waiting period ended without telling her. Later he returned and found that she had married another man. He went to Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, and told him what had happened. Umar said, “If you find that the new husband has not consummated the marriage with her, you have the greater claim to her; but if he has, you have no claim to her.” Abu Kanaf returned and found that she had styled the forelock of her hair. He said, “I have something to attend to; leave me alone.” They did so, and he spent the night with her. In the morning he went to the governor with Umar’s letter. They recognized that he had come with a sound ruling.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 129
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «طَلَاقُ السُّنَّةِ أَنْ يُطَلِّقَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَاحِدَةً حِينَ تَطْهُرُ مِنْ حَيْضَتِهَا، مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُجَامِعَهَا، وَهُوَ يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ الْعِدَّةُ، فَإِذَا انْقَضَتْ فَهُوَ خَاطِبٌ مِنَ الْخُطَّابِ، فَإِنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُطَلِّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا طَلَّقَهَا حِينَ تَطْهُرُ مِنْ حَيْضَتِهَا الثَّانِيَةِ، ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقُهَا حِينَ تَطْهُرُ مِنْ حَيْضَتِهَا الثَّالِثَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said The divorce according to the Sunnah is that a man divorces his wife once when she is pure from her menstruation without having had intercourse with her, and he retains the right to take her back until her waiting period expires. When it expires, he is one of the suitors. If he wishes to divorce her three times, he divorces her when she is pure from her second menstruation, then he divorces her when she is pure from her third menstruation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 129
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُطَلِّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ لِلْعِدَّةِ وَهِيَ لَا تَحِيضُ، وَقَدْ يَئِسَتْ، قَالَ: «يُطَلِّقُهَا عِنْدَ رَأْسِ كُلِّ هِلَالٍ أَوْ مَتَى مَا بَدَا لَهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَحِيضُ تَرَكَهَا حَتَّى إِذَا حَاضَتْ ثُمَّ طَهُرَتْ طَلَّقَهَا وَاحِدَةً مِنْ غَيْرِ جِمَاعٍ، يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ طُهْرٍ إِنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ ثَلَاثًا، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَا تَحِيضُ فَعِنْدَ كُلِّ هِلَالٍ، وَعِدَّتُهَا مِنَ التَّطْلِيقَةِ الْأُولَى»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who wants to divorce his wife during her waiting period and she does not menstruate, having already reached menopause: He may divorce her at the beginning of every new moon or whenever he wishes. If she does menstruate, he should leave her until she menstruates, then when she becomes pure, he may divorce her with one divorce without having intercourse. He does this at every purity if he intends three divorces. If she does not menstruate, then at every new moon. Her waiting period begins from the first divorce.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 130
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا طَلَّقَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَاحِدَةً يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ، ثُمَّ أَشْهَدَ عَلَى رَجْعَتِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْقَضِيَ الْعِدَّةُ، وَهِيَ لَا تَعْلَمُ حَتَّى تَزَوَّجَتْ وَدَخَلَ بِهَا زَوْجُهَا، أَنَّهُ يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ زَوْجِهَا الْآخَرِ، وَتُرَدُّ عَلَى زَوْجِهَا الْأَوَّلِ، وَيَكُونُ لَهَا الْمَهْرُ عَلَى الْآخَرِ بِمَا اسْتَحَلَّ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said: “If a man gives his wife one revocable divorce, then has witnesses attest that he has taken her back before her waiting period ends, but she does not know of the revocation and marries another man who consummates the marriage with her, she must be separated from the second husband and returned to the first. She is entitled to a dowry from the second husband for the intercourse he had with her.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 130
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ " لَا يَتَسَرَّى الْعَبْدُ، أَلَا تَرَى إِلَى قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى {الَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ إِلَّا عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ} [المؤمنون: 6] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ، فَالْعَبْدُ لَا يَمْلِكُ شَيْئًا "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said A slave may not take a concubine. Do you not see the saying of God the Exalted: "Those who guard their private parts except from their wives or what their right hands possess" until the end of the verse? A slave does not own anything.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 130
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي " الْحُرِّ: يَتَزَوَّجُ أَرْبَعَ مَمْلُوكَاتٍ إِنْ شَاءَ، وَثَلَاثًا وَثِنْتَيْنِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the free man: he may marry four slave women if he wishes, or three, or two.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 130
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ الْعَبْدُ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوْلَاهُ فَلِلْمَوْلَى أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَيَأْخُذَ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ مَا أَخَذَتْ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ، وَإِنْ تَزَوَّجَ بِإِذْنِ مَوْلَاهُ فَالطَّلَاقُ بِيَدِ الْعَبْدِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said When a slave marries without the permission of his master, the master has the right to separate them and take from the woman what she received from the slave. But if he marries with the permission of his master, then the power of divorce is in the hand of the slave.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 131
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يَتَزَوَّجُ الْعَبْدُ إِلَّا اثْنَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said A slave may not marry more than two women.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 131
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي النَّصْرَانِيِّ وَالْيَهُودِيِّ وَالْمَجُوسِيِّ يُظَاهِرُ مِنِ امْرَأَتِهِ أَوْ يُطَلِّقُ ثُمَّ يُسْلِمُ: «إِنَّ الْإِسْلَامَ لَا يَزِيدُهُ إِلَّا شِدَّةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the Christian, the Jew, and the Magian who performs zihar against his wife or divorces her, then later embraces Islam: "Islam only intensifies his situation."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 131
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ فَجَرَ بِامْرَأَةٍ ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا، فَقَرَأَ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ» {وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِ وَيَعْفُو عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ} [الشورى: 25] "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he asked Alqamah about a man who committed adultery with a woman and then married her. He recited this verse: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds. (Ash-Shura: 25)

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 131
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي ذَلِكَ: «أَوَّلُهُ سِفَاحٌ وَآخِرُهُ نِكَاحٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding that: "Its beginning is fornication, and its end is marriage."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 131
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِامْرَأَتِهِ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا: أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ، أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ، أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ: بَانَتِ الْأُولَى، وَكَانَتِ الثِّنْتَانِ فِيمَا لَا يَمْلِكُ، وَإِذَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا جَمَاعَةً فَهِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ حَتَّى تَنْكِحَ زَوْجًا غَيْرَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “If a man says to his wife, before consummating the marriage, ‘You are divorced’ three times, she is irrevocably separated by the first divorce; the other two do not take effect because he no longer has a marriage to dissolve. If he pronounces three divorces at once, she is forbidden to him until she marries another husband.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 131
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْمَرْأَةِ يُنْعَى إِلَيْهَا زَوْجُهَا فَتَتَزَوَّجُ ثُمَّ يَقْدُمُ: «أَنَّهَا تُرَدُّ إِلَى زَوْجِهَا الْأَوَّلِ، وَلَا يَقْرَبُهَا حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا مِنَ الْآخَرِ، وَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْآخَرِ، وَلَهَا الْمَهْرُ مِنْهُ بِمَا اسْتَحَلَّ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا، وَلَا يَقْرَبُهَا الْأَوَّلُ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا مِنَ الْآخَرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali, ؓ, that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding a woman whose husband is announced dead to her, then she marries, and afterward her first husband returns: "She is to be returned to her first husband, and he may not approach her until her waiting period from the other man has ended. She is to be separated from the other man, and she is entitled to the dowry from him for what he lawfully enjoyed of her. The first husband may not approach her until her waiting period from the other man has ended."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 132
entries.matn_ar: وَأَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَالَ فِيهَا: " زَوْجُهَا الْأَوَّلُ بِالْخِيَارِ: إِنْ شَاءَ أَخَذَ مَهْرَهَا وَتَرَكَهَا عِنْدَ هَذَا، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَخَذَ امْرَأَتَهُ "، وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ: قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: قَوْلُ عَلِيٍّ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ قَوْلِ عُمَرَ
entries.matn_en: Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, said regarding it: "Her first husband has the choice: if he wishes, he may take her dowry and leave her with this one, or if he wishes, he may take his wife back." Hammad said: Ibrahim said: "The statement of Ali is more beloved to me than the statement of Umar."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 132
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه عَنِ الرَّجُلِ، يَمُوتُ وَلَهُ امْرَأَةٌ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ لَهَا مَهْرًا، قَالَ مَا سَمِعْتُ فِيهَا مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا، قَالَ: فَقِيلَ لَهُ: قُلْ فِيهَا بِرَأْيِكَ، قَالَ: «أَرَى لَهَا صَدَاقَ نِسَائِهَا كَامِلًا وَالْمِيرَاثَ كَامِلًا وَعَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةُ» قَالَ: فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَشْجَعَ: قَضَيْتَ فِيهَا وَالَّذِي يُحْلَفُ بِهِ بِقَضَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَرْوَعَ بِنْتِ وَاشِقٍ الْأَشْجَعِيَّةِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that a man asked Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, about a man who dies leaving a wife with whom he had not consummated the marriage and had not specified her dowry. He said I have not heard anything from the Prophet, ﷺ, regarding this. It was said to him: Then give your opinion on it. He said: I see that she should receive the full dowry of her peers, the full inheritance, and she must observe the waiting period. A man from Ashja' then said: You have judged in this matter, by the One by whom oaths are taken, with the same judgment as the Prophet, ﷺ, gave in the case of Barwa' bint Washiq al-Ashja'iyyah.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 132
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَجْعَلُ لِلْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا: السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةُ، فَقَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ ابْنَةُ قَيْسٍ: طَلَّقَنِي زَوْجِي ثَلَاثًا، فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُكْنَى وَلَا نَفَقَةً، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «لَا نَأْخُذُ بِقَوْلِ امْرَأَةٍ لَا نَدْرِي صَدَقَتْ أَمْ كَذَبَتْ، وَنَدَعُ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Umar, ؓ, used to grant the thrice-divorced woman both lodging and maintenance. Fatimah bint Qays said "My husband divorced me thrice, and the Messenger of God, ﷺ, did not grant me lodging or maintenance." So Umar said: "We will not act upon the statement of a woman whom we do not know whether she is truthful or lying, and abandon the Book of God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 132
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيْمَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُزَوَّجُ فِي عِدَّتِهَا فَيَدْخُلُ بِهَا زَوْجُهَا: «أَنَّهُ يُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ زَوْجِهَا الْآخَرِ وَتَعْتَدُّ بَقِيَّةَ عِدَّتِهَا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِ وَعِدَّةً مُسْتَقْبَلَةً مِنَ الْآخَرِ وَيَتَزَوَّجُهَا الْآخَرُ بَعْدَمَا تَنْقَضِي عِدَّتُهَا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِ إِنْ شَاءَ وَشَاءَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Ali b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a woman who marries during her waiting period and her husband consummates the marriage: "They are to be separated, and she must complete the remainder of her waiting period from the first husband and observe a new waiting period from the other. The other may marry her after her waiting period from the first husband ends if he wishes and she agrees."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 133
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَ قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه كُلِّهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَا يَتَزَوَّجُهَا الْآخَرُ أَبَدًا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: the same as Ali’s statement in its entirety, except that he said "The other may never marry her."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 133
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَاحِدَةً، فَحَاضَتْ حَيْضَتَيْنِ، حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلَتْ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ وَانْقَطَعَ الدَّمُ، وَدَخَلَتْ فِي مُغْتَسَلِهَا وَأَدْنَتْ مَاءَهَا، وَوَضَعَتْ ثَوْبَهَا أَتَاهَا فَرَاجَعَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُفِيضَ عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ، فَأَتَتْ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، وَعِنْدَهُ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ لَهُ: قُلْ فِيهَا، قَالَ: «أَرَاهَا امْرَأَتَهُ؛ لِأَنَّهَا لَمْ تَحِلْ لَهَا الصَّلَاةُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ حَتَّى تَحِلَّ لَهَا الصَّلَاةُ» ، قَالَ: وَأَنَا أَرَى ذَلِكَ، فَرَدَّهَا عَلَى زَوْجِهَا وَقَالَ: لَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ: كَنِيفٌ مَمْلُوءٌ عِلْمًا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim:
entries.matn_en: A man gave his wife one divorce. She menstruated twice. When she entered her third menstrual period and the bleeding stopped, she went to bathe, brought her water close, and removed her clothes. Before she poured the water over herself, he came and took her back. She went to Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, and told him what had happened. Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, was present, and Umar asked him for his opinion. Ibn Mas‘ud said, “I consider her still his wife, because prayer is not permitted to her while she menstruates until it becomes permitted to her again.” Umar said, “I hold the same view.” He returned her to her husband and said of Abdullah, “He is a storehouse filled with knowledge.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 134
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ الَّتِي سَأَلَتْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه عَنِ الَّتِي رَاجَعَهَا زَوْجُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ، كَانَ دَسَّهَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ لِعُمَرَ وَابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنهم لِيَنْظُرَ مَا يَقُولَانِ فِيهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ata b. Yasar:
entries.matn_en: The woman who asked Umar, ؓ, about the one whom her husband took back before she had performed the ritual bath—Al-Mughirah b. Shu'bah had sent her to Umar and Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, to see what they would say regarding her case.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 134
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا وَلَدَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ، فَمَاتَ وَلَدُهَا، فَكَثُرَ اللَّبَنُ فِي ثَدْيِهَا، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ: امْصُصْهُ ثُمَّ امْجُجْهُ، فَفَعَلَ ذَلِكَ فَدَخَلَ بَعْضُهُ فِي حَلْقِهِ، فَأَتَى أَبَا مُوسَى رضي الله عنه فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكَ امْرَأَتُكَ، ثُمَّ أَتَى ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ وَأَخْبَرَهُ بِقَوْلِ أَبِي مُوسَى، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّمَا كُنْتَ مُدَاوِيًا، وَأَنَّهُ لَا رَضَاعَ بَعْدَ فِطَامٍ، وَإِنَّمَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ مَا أَنْبَتَ اللَّحْمَ وَالْعَظْمَ، فَأَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ امْرَأَتَكَ،» فَأَتَى أَبَا مُوسَى فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِقَوْلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: لَا تَسْأَلُونِي مَا دَامَ هَذَا الْحَبْرُ فِيكُمْ
