entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim:
entries.matn_en: A Bedouin’s wife gave birth, but her child died. Her breast milk became abundant, and she said to her husband, “Suckle some of it, then spit it out.” He did so, and some milk went down his throat. He went to Abu Musa, ؓ, and asked him about it. Abu Musa said, “Your wife is now forbidden to you.” The man then went to Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, and asked him, telling him what Abu Musa had said. Ibn Mas‘ud replied, “You were only treating her. There is no nursing after weaning; only nursing that produces flesh and bone makes marriage unlawful. Keep your wife.” The man returned to Abu Musa and told him Abdullah’s ruling. Abu Musa said, “Do not ask me while this scholar is among you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 134
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمِ الْمَكِّيِّ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتْهَا فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ زَوْجِيَ يَأْتِينِي مُجَبِّيَةً وَمُسْتَلْقِيَةً مُكْرَهَةً، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي صِمَامٍ وَاحِدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ibn Khuthaym al-Makki, from Yusuf b. Mahak, from Hafsah, the wife of the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that a woman came to Hafsah, the Prophet’s wife, ؓ, and said, “My husband approaches me while I am crouched face-down, and while I am lying on my back against my will.” This reached the Prophet, ﷺ, and he said, “There is no harm, provided intercourse is through the vaginal opening.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 134
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِتْيَانُ النِّسَاءِ فِي مَحَاشِّهِنَّ حَرَامٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Humayd al-A‘raj, from Abu Dharr, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, said, “Anal intercourse with women is forbidden.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 135
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ تَمَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْقَعْقَاعِ الْجَرْمِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِتْيَانُ النِّسَاءِ فِي مَحَاشِّهِنَّ حَرَامٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from al-Minhal b. Khalifah from Salamah b. Tamam from Abu al-Qa‘qa‘ al-Jarmi from Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said, “Anal intercourse with women is forbidden.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 135
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ وَجَدْنَا كِتَابًا بِخَطِّ أَبِي أَعْرِفُهُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِتْيَانُ النِّسَاءِ فِي مَحَاشِّهِنَّ حَرَامٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Qasim b. Abd al-Rahman, from his father, who said that they found a document in his father’s handwriting, which he recognized, reporting Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, as saying:
entries.matn_en: “Anal intercourse with women is forbidden.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 135
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «إِذَا وَهَبَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا لِلرَّجُلِ بِشُهُودٍ، فَقَبِلَهَا الرَّجُلُ، فَهُوَ نِكَاحٌ، وَلَهَا مَهْرُ مِثْلِهَا، إِلَّا أَنْ تَرْضَى بِأَقَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْبَلْهَا فَلَا شَيْءَ، وَإِنْ قَبِلَهَا وَلَمْ تَكُنْ شُهُودٌ فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَالْعِدَّةُ عَلَيْهَا، وَلَا صَدَاقَ لَهَا إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ دَخَلَ بِهَا، فَإِنْ كَانَ دَخَلَ بِهَا فَعَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةُ وَلَهَا الصَّدَاقُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “If a woman offers herself to a man in marriage before witnesses and he accepts her, this constitutes a marriage. She is entitled to a dowry equivalent to that of women of her standing, unless she agrees to less. If he does not accept her, nothing is due. If he accepts her without witnesses, the two must be separated and she must observe the waiting period. She is not entitled to a dowry if he has not consummated the marriage; if he has, she must observe the waiting period and is entitled to the dowry.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 136
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُطَلِّقُ امْرَأَتَهُ ثَلَاثًا فِي مَرَضِهِ: «أَنَّهَا تَرِثُهُ مَا كَانَتْ فِي عِدَّتِهَا، فَإِذَا انْقَضَتِ الْعِدَّةُ لَمْ تَرِثْ، وَإِنْ طَلَّقَهَا فِي مَرَضِهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا فَلَهَا نِصْفُ الْمَهْرِ، وَلَا عِدَّةَ عَلَيْهَا، وَلَا مِيرَاثَ لَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: concerning a man who divorces his wife three times during his final illness: “She inherits from him as long as she is in her waiting period. When that period ends, she does not inherit. If he divorces her during his illness before consummating the marriage, she is entitled to half the dowry, has no waiting period, and does not inherit.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 136
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " إِذَا قَالَ: أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَلَا يَقَعُ الطَّلَاقُ، وَلَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Ghalib b. Ubaydillah, from Ata b. Abi Rabah,
entries.matn_en: who said: “If someone says, ‘You are divorced, if God wills,’ the divorce does not take effect; it has no legal effect.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 136
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْعِتَاقِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abdul-Malik b. Abi Sulayman, from Ata b. Abi Rabah,
entries.matn_en: concerning emancipation, the same ruling applies.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 137
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، وَابْنِ سِيرِينَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا «يَقَعُ الطَّلَاقُ وَاسْتِثْنَاؤُهُ بَاطِلٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Bakr, from al-Hasan and Ibn Sirin, who both said:
entries.matn_en: “The divorce takes effect, and the attempted exception is invalid.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 137
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَامِرٍ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ ذُكِرَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَ إِنْ تَزَوَّجْتَهَا فَهِيَ طَالِقٌ، فَسَأَلَ أَهْلَ الْحِجَازِ وَالنَّاسِ؟ فَقَالُوا: لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ، فَلَقِيَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ: «أَخْبِرْهَا أَنَّهَا أَمْلَكُ بِنَفْسِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad b. Qays, from Ibrahim and Amir, from al-Aswad, to whom a woman was mentioned.
entries.matn_en: He said, “If I marry her, she is divorced.” He consulted the people of the Hijaz and others, and they said, “That has no effect.” Then he met Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, who said, “Tell her that she has authority over her own decision.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 137
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يُوطَأُ فَرْجُ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْمَمْلُوكَاتِ إِلَّا فَرْجٌ إِنْ بَاعَهُ جَازَ، وَإِنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ جَازَ، وَإِنْ أَعْتَقَهَا جَازَ، وَإِنْ وَهَبَهَا جَازَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Isma'il b. Umayyah, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “A female slave may not be approached sexually unless she is one whom her owner may lawfully sell, give away in charity, emancipate, or give as a gift.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 137
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَتْ لَهُ جَارِيَتَانِ فَأَعْتَقَهُمَا عَنْ دُبُرٍ فَكَانَ يَطَأُهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ata b. Yasar, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who had two slave women whom he emancipated to take effect upon his death, and he used to have intercourse with them.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 138
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «كُلُّ فُرْقَةٍ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الرَّجُلِ فَهُوَ طَلَاقٌ، وَلَهَا نِصْفُ الصَّدَاقِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ دَخَلَ بِهَا، وَكُلُّ فُرْقَةٍ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِ النِّسَاءِ فَلَيْسَ لَهَا شَيْءٌ إِذَا لَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “Any separation initiated by the man is a divorce, and the woman is entitled to half the dowry even if the marriage has not been consummated. Any separation initiated by the woman entitles her to nothing if the marriage has not been consummated.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 138
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا طَلَّقَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَاحِدَةً أَوِ اثْنَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا رَجُلٌ آخَرُ وَدَخَلَ بِهَا، وَفَارَقَهَا الْأَوَّلُ، ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا الْأَوَّلُ، فَهِيَ عِنْدَهُ عَلَى طَلَاقٍ مُسْتَقْبَلٍ ثَلَاثٍ، وَيَهْدِمُ الزَّوْجُ الْوَاحِدَةَ وَالثِّنْتَيْنِ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ دَخَلَ بِهَا الزَّوْجُ الْآخَرُ فَهِيَ عِنْدَ الزَّوْجِ الْأَوَّلِ عَلَى مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ الطَّلَاقِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father. His father said: Abu Hanifah narrated to us from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If a man divorces his wife once or twice, then another man marries her and consummates the marriage, and the first husband separates from her, then the first husband marries her again, she is then subject to a fresh count of three divorces with him; the intervening husband extinguishes the earlier one or two divorces. If the other husband did not consummate the marriage, she remains with the first husband with whatever number of divorces remained.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 138
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِامْرَأَتِهِ: أَنْتِ طَالِقٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ، فَلَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ وَلَا يَقَعُ الطَّلَاقُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If a man says to his wife, ‘You are divorced, if God wills,’ that has no effect, and the divorce does not take effect.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 138
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «كُلُّ جِمَاعٍ يُدْرَأُ فِيهِ الْحَدُّ فَفِيهِ الصَّدَاقُ» فَقَالَ: «هَذِهِ امْرَأَةٌ حَبَسَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ مِيرَاثَهَا فَكُلْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “For every instance of intercourse in which the prescribed punishment is averted, a dowry is due.” He then said: “This is a woman whose inheritance God has retained for you, so consume it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 139
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَتْ تَحْتَ الْحُرِّ أَمَةٌ فَأُعْتِقَتْ ثُمَّ فَجَرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُجَامِعَهَا بَعْدَ الْعِتْقِ، فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ، وَإِنْ كَانَ جَامَعَهَا بَعْدَ الْعِتْقِ ثُمَّ فَجَرَ، فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ الرَّجْمَ، وَكَذَلِكَ الْعَبْدُ تَحْتَهُ الْحُرَّةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If a free man is married to a female slave and she is emancipated, then if he has illicit intercourse before having intercourse with her after her emancipation, only the prescribed corporal punishment applies to him. But if he has intercourse with her after her emancipation and then commits illicit intercourse, stoning is due. The same applies to a male slave married to a free woman.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 139
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي خُطْبَةِ النِّكَاحِ: " إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ، وَنَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا، مَنْ يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ، وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَاشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ {وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا} [النساء: 1] {اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ} [آل عمران: 102] {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا} [الأحزاب: 70] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: {فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا} [الأحزاب: 71] ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَمَّا بَعْدَ ذَلِكُمْ " ثُمَّ يَذْكُرُ حَاجَتَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Qasim b. Abd al-Rahman, from his father, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, who said in the marriage sermon:
entries.matn_en: “All praise belongs to God. We praise Him, seek His help and forgiveness, and seek refuge in God from the evil within ourselves. Whoever God guides, no one can lead astray; and whoever He leaves astray, no one can guide. I bear witness that there is no god but God, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. ‘Fear God, through whom you ask one another, and honor the ties of kinship. Surely God is ever watchful over you.’ [Qur’an 4:1] ‘Fear God as He ought to be feared, and do not die except as Muslims.’ [Qur’an 3:102] ‘O you who believe, fear God and speak words of integrity’—through His words, ‘then he has achieved a great triumph.’ [Qur’an 33:70–71] Then he would say: ‘To proceed,’ and then mention his purpose.”

sections.title_en: The Chapter on Option (to Cancel a Sale)

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 139
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali, ؓ, who said regarding the “choose” option:
entries.matn_en: “If she chooses her husband, it is one revocable divorce; if she chooses herself, it is one irrevocable divorce.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 139
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، وَابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي اخْتَارِي: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَهِيَ امْرَأَتُهُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَوَاحِدَةٌ وَهُوَ أَمْلَكُ بِهَا» وَإِنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ فِيهَا: «إِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا فَهِيَ امْرَأَتُهُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَهِيَ ثَلَاثٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Umar b. al-Khattab and Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, who said regarding the wife’s option to choose:
entries.matn_en: “If she chooses her husband, she remains his wife; if she chooses herself, it is one divorce, and he retains authority over her.” Zayd b. Thabit, ؓ, said of her: “If she chooses her husband, she remains his wife; if she chooses herself, it is three divorces.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 140
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " قَالَ فِي اخْتَارِي، وَأَمْرِكِ بِيَدِكِ: سَوَاءٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding "your choice" and "the matter is in your hands": they are the same.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 140
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ لِامْرَأَتِهِ: اعْتَدِّي ، قَالَ «وَاحِدَةً يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from someone who reported to him from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: about a man telling his wife, “Observe your waiting period”: “That counts as one revocable divorce.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 140
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا خُيِّرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ نَفْسَهَا فَقَامَتْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَ فَلَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Amr b. Dinar, from Jabir b. Zayd, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If a woman is given the choice and leaves her seat before choosing, that has no effect.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 140
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ تُعْتَقُ امْرَأَتُهُ وَهِيَ أَمَةٌ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا فَتَخْتَارُ نَفْسَهَا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَا مَهْرَ لَهَا؛ لِأَنَّ الْفُرْقَةَ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man whose enslaved wife is emancipated before he has consummated the marriage, and she then chooses to separate: “She is not entitled to a dowry, because the separation was initiated by her.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 141
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا: «اشْتَرِي بَرِيرَةَ فَأَعْتِقِيهَا؛ فَإِنَّ الْوَلَاءَ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ» ، فَاشْتَرَتْهَا فَأَعْتَقَتْهَا، فَخُيِّرَتْ وَكَانَ زَوْجُهَا مَوْلَى لِآلِ أَبِي أَحْمَدَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, said to her: “Buy Barirah and emancipate her, for the right of wala' (the bond of manumission-based clientage) belongs to the one who emancipates.” So she bought and emancipated her, and Barirah was given the choice. Her husband was a client of the family of Abu Ahmad.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 141
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي الْخِيَارِ: «إِذَا قَامَتْ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَخْتَارَ فَلَيْسَ لَهَا خِيَارٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim and Amr b. Dinar, from Jabir b. Zayd,
entries.matn_en: who both said regarding the option: “If she gets up from her seat before choosing, she forfeits the right to choose.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 141
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْعِنِّينِ: «يُؤَجَّلُ سَنَةً، فَإِنْ خَلَصَ إِلَيْهَا، وَإِلَّا خُيِّرَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ، فَإِنْ شَاءَتْ أَقَامَتْ مَعَ زَوْجِهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءَتِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا، فَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَهِيَ وَاحِدَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the impotent man: “He is given a respite of one year. If he is able to have intercourse with her during that time, then the matter is resolved. Otherwise, his wife is given the choice: if she wishes, she may stay with her husband, and if she wishes, she may choose herself. If she chooses herself, it is one irrevocable divorce.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 141
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْأَمَةِ: «إِذَا أُعْتِقَتْ خُيِّرَتْ، فَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ زَوْجُهَا دَخَلَ بِهَا فَلَا مَهْرَ لَهَا، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَقَدْ دَخَلَ بِهَا فَالْمَهْرُ لِسَيِّدِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the slave woman: When she is manumitted, she is given the choice. If she chooses herself and her husband has not consummated the marriage with her, then she is not entitled to a dowry. But if she chooses her husband and he has consummated the marriage with her, then the dowry belongs to her master.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 141
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ يُوسُفُ وَقَالَ أَبُو يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْبَصْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْعِنِّينِ: «يُؤَجَّلُ سَنَةً، فَإِنْ وَصَلَ إِلَيْهَا، وَإِلَّا فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَهَا الْمَهْرُ كَامِلًا، وَهِيَ تَطْلِيقَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ» وَذَكَرَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ نَحْوًا مِنْهُ عَنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf said, and Abu Yusuf said: Isma'il b. Muslim reported to us from al-Hasan al-Basri, from Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the impotent man: “He is given a respite of one year. If he has intercourse with her during that time, the marriage continues; otherwise, they are separated and she is entitled to the full dowry. This is one irrevocable divorce.” Abu Hanifah also related something similar from Umar.

sections.title_en: The Chapter on the Waiting Period

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 142
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِ اللهِ تَعَالَى {لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنْ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ} [الطلاق: 1] قَالَ: «خُرُوجُهَا مِنْ بَيْتِهَا فِي عِدَّتِهَا هِيَ الْفَاحِشَةُ الْمُبَيِّنَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: regarding the saying of God the Exalted: "Do not evict them from their houses, nor should they leave, unless they commit an obvious immorality" (At-Talaq: 1), he said "Her leaving her house during her waiting period is the obvious immorality."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 142
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه «رَدَّ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهُنَّ أَزْوَاجُهُنَّ مِنْ ظَهْرِ النَّجَفِ، كُنَّ خَرَجْنَ حُجَّاجًا فِي عِدَّتِهِنَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, sent back the widows from the hinterland of al-Najaf; they had set out as pilgrims during their waiting period.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 142
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْمُطَلَّقَةَ لَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْتِهَا فِي حَقٍّ وَلَا فِي غَيْرِهِ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا، وَالْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا لَا تَخْرُجُ إِلَّا فِي حَقٍّ لَابُدَّ مِنْهُ وَلَا تَبِيتُ عَنْ بَيْتِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that a divorced woman must not leave her home for any reason until her waiting period ends. A widow may leave only for an unavoidable necessity, and must not spend the night away from her home.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 142
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا وَالْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا: «لَا تَكْتَحِلُ إِلَّا لَوَجَعٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a woman divorced three times and a widow: “She may apply kohl only to treat an eye ailment.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 143
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُطَلِّقُ امْرَأَتَهُ ثُمَّ يُرَاجِعُهَا ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقُهَا فِي الْعِدَّةِ: «أَنَّ عَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةَ مُسْتَقْبَلَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who divorces his wife, then takes her back, then divorces her during the waiting period: "She must observe a new waiting period."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 143
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا نَقَلَ عَلِيٌّ رضي الله عنه أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ حِينَ قُتِلَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه؛ لِأَنَّهَا كَانَتْ مَعَ عُمَرَ فِي دَارِ الْإِمَارَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said Ali, ؓ, only moved Umm Kulthum when Umar, ؓ, was killed because she was with Umar in the house of governance.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 143
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُطَلِّقُ امْرَأَتَهُ تَطْلِيقَةً بَائِنَةً ثُمَّ يُرَاجِعُهَا فِي الْعِدَّةِ ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: «إِنَّ عَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةَ مُسْتَقْبَلَةً وَلَهَا الْمَهْرُ كَامِلًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the man who divorces his wife with a final divorce, then takes her back during the waiting period, then divorces her before consummating the marriage: "She must observe a new waiting period, and she is entitled to the full dowry."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 143
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي " عِدَّةِ الْحُرَّةِ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ: ثَلَاثُ حِيَضٍ، فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَا تَحِيضُ فَثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ أَمَةً مُطَلَّقَةً فَعِدَّتُهَا حَيْضَتَانِ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَا تَحِيضُ فَشَهْرٌ وَنِصْفٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the waiting period of a free divorced woman: three menstrual cycles. If she does not menstruate, then three months. If she is a divorced slave woman, her waiting period is two menstrual cycles. If she does not menstruate, then one and a half months.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 143
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " نَزَلَتْ {وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ} [الطلاق: 4] " بَعْدَ {أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا} [البقرة: 234] "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said: “The verse, ‘The term of those who are pregnant is until they give birth,’ was revealed later than the ruling of four months and ten days.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 143
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «نَسَخَتْ سُورَةُ النِّسَاءِ الْقُصْرَى كُلَّ عِدَّةٍ» {وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ} [الطلاق: 4]
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said: “The shorter Surah al-Nisa—Surat al-Talaq—abrogated all waiting-period rulings: ‘As for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 143
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا تَزَوَّجْتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي عِدَّتِهَا فَدَخَلَ بِهَا زَوْجُهَا فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَتَمَّتْ عِدَّةَ الْأَوَّلِ، وَاعْتَدَّتْ مِنَ الْآخَرِ عِدَّةً مُسْتَقْبَلَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said When a woman marries during her waiting period and her husband consummates the marriage with her, they are separated, she completes the waiting period of the first husband, and then observes a new waiting period from the other.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 144
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا طَلَّقَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَامِلٌ فَعِدَّتُهَا أَنْ تَضَعَ مَا فِي بَطْنِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said When a man divorces his wife while she is pregnant, her waiting period is until she delivers what is in her womb.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 144
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي السَّقْطِ: «إِذَا اسْتَبَانَ بَعْضُ خَلْقِهِ عُتِقَتِ الْأَمَةُ وَانْقَضَتْ بِهِ الْعِدَّةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a miscarriage: “If some of the fetus’s features have become distinguishable, the slave woman is emancipated, and her waiting period ends with the miscarriage.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 144
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْأَمَةِ يَمُوتُ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا عَبْدًا أَوْ حُرًّا: «عِدَّتُهَا شَهْرَانِ وَخَمْسَةُ أَيَّامٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a slave woman whose husband dies, whether he is a slave or a free man: "Her waiting period is two months and five days."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 144
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «تَعْتَدُّ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ بِأَيَّامِ حَيْضِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said The woman experiencing istihadah (non-menstrual bleeding) observes her waiting period according to the days of her menstruation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 144
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ الْأَسْلَمِيَّةَ رضي الله عنها مَاتَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا فِي حَبَلٍ، فَمَكَثَتْ خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً أَوْ نَحْوَهَا ثُمَّ وَضَعَتْ، فَمَرَّ بِهَا أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ رضي الله عنه وَقَدْ تَشَوَّفَتْ لِلْأَزْوَاجِ، فَقَالَ كَلَّا وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ إِنَّهُ لَأَبْعَدُ الْأَجَلَيْنِ، فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَتْهُ بِذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: «كَذَبَ أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ، إِذَا حَضَرَ ذَلِكَ فَآذِنِينِي» ، يَقُولُ: «إِذَا خُطِبْتِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad:
entries.matn_en: Subay'ah bint al-Harith al-Aslamiyyah, ؓ, was pregnant when her husband died. She remained for twenty-five nights or so, then gave birth. Abu al-Sanabil passed by while she was looking forward to marriage and said, “No, by the Lord of the Ka'bah, you must wait out the longer of the two periods.” She went to the Prophet, ﷺ, and told him. He said, “Abu al-Sanabil was mistaken. When that time comes, let me know”—meaning, “when you receive a marriage proposal.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 144
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْأَمَةِ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا فَاعْتَدَّتْ ثُمَّ أُعْتِقَتْ فِي عِدَّتِهَا: «اعْتَدَّتْ عِدَّةَ الْأَمَةِ كَمَا هِيَ، فَإِذَا طُلِّقَتْ تَطْلِيقَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أُعْتِقَتِ اعْتَدَّتْ عِدَّةَ الْأَمَةِ، وَإِنْ طُلِّقَتْ وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ أُعْتِقَتْ فِي حَيْضِهَا اعْتَدَّتْ عِدَّةَ الْحُرَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a female slave whose husband dies: if she observes her waiting period and is then emancipated during it, she continues with the waiting period prescribed for a slave woman. If she is divorced twice and then emancipated, she observes the slave woman’s waiting period. But if she is divorced once and is emancipated during her menstrual period, she observes the waiting period prescribed for a free woman.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 145
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُطَلِّقُ امْرَأَتَهُ فَتَعْتَدُّ بِشَهْرٍ أَوْ شَهْرَيْنِ ثُمَّ تَحِيضُ قَالَ «يَهْدِمُ الْحَيْضُ الشَّهْرَ، وَتَسْتَقْبِلُ عِدَّةَ الْحَيْضِ، فَإِنْ حَاضَتْ وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ يَئِسَتْ، اسْتَقْبَلَتِ الشُّهُورَ، فَإِنْ حَاضَتْ بَعْدُ اعْتَدَّتْ بِمَا مَضَى مِنَ الْحَيْضِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who divorces his wife: if she counts her waiting period by months for one or two months and then menstruates, he said: “Menstruation cancels the month count, and she starts over with a waiting period counted by menstrual cycles. If she menstruates once and then reaches menopause, she starts a waiting period counted by months. If menstruation resumes afterward, she completes the waiting period by counting the menstrual periods that have elapsed.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 145
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي أُمِّ الْوَلَدِ يَعْتِقُهَا مَوْلَاهَا أَوْ يَمُوتُ عَنْهَا: «عِدَّتُهَا ثَلَاثُ حِيَضٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said concerning an umm walad (a female slave who has borne a child to her master), if her master emancipates her or dies leaving her: “Her waiting period is three menstrual cycles.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 145
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْحُرِّ إِذَا كَانَتْ تَحْتَهُ أَمَةٌ وَيُطَلِّقُهَا تَطْلِيقَةً بَائِنَةً فَخُيِّرَتْ فَاخْتَارَتْ زَوْجَهَا ثُمَّ مَاتَ عَنْهَا قَالَ: «عِدَّتُهَا أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ وَلَهَا الْمِيرَاثُ، وَإِنِ اخْتَارَتْ نَفْسَهَا فَعِدَّتُهَا عِدَّةُ الْحُرَّةِ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثُ حِيَضٍ وَلَا مِيرَاثَ لَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a free man who has a slave woman as his wife and he divorces her with a final divorce, then she is given the choice and she chooses her husband, then he dies: "Her waiting period is four months and ten days and she inherits from him. If she chooses herself, her waiting period is that of a free divorced woman, three menstrual cycles, and she does not inherit."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 145
entries.isnad_ar: : قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ وَالْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا: «تَعْتَدُّ مِنْ يَوْمِ مَاتَ وَمِنْ يَوْمِ طَلَّقَهَا زَوْجُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a divorced woman and a widow: “The divorced woman observes her waiting period from the day her husband divorces her, and the widow from the day her husband dies.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 145
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي " الْمُطَلَّقَةِ وَاحِدَةً تُشَوَّفُ لِزَوْجِهَا وَتُزَيَّنُ لَهُ: لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا وَلَا يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا إِلَّا بِإِذْنٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a woman divorced once who adorns herself and beautifies for her husband: Perhaps he may take her back, but he may not enter upon her except with permission.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 146
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُطَلِّقُ الْمَرْأَةَ وَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ قَالَ: «تَعْتَدُّ بِقُرْءٍ وَالْحَيْضِ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ وَكَذَلِكَ إِنِ اسْتُحِيضَتْ بَعْدَمَا يُطَلِّقُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the man who divorces his wife while she is experiencing istihadah (non-menstrual bleeding): She observes her waiting period based on one menstrual cycle and the menstruation that preceded it. Likewise, if she experiences istihadah after he divorces her.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 146
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «آخِرُ الْآيَتَيْنِ نُزُولًا الَّتِي فِي سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ الْقُصْرَى»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Umar, ؓ, said: “The later-revealed of the two verses is the one in the shorter Surah al-Nisa (Surat al-Talaq).”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 146
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِسَوْدَةَ ابْنَةِ زَمْعَةَ رضي الله عنها: «اعْتَدِّي» ، فَقَعَدَتْ لَهُ فِي الطَّرِيقِ، فَسَأَلَتْهُ بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا، فَقَالَتْ: وَاللَّهِ مَابِي حِرْصٌ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ، وَلَكِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُحْشَرَ مَعَ أَزْوَاجِكَ وَاجْعَلْ يَوْمِي لِعَائِشَةَ، فَفَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that he said to Sawdah bint Zam'ah, ؓ: “Observe your waiting period.” She sat in his path and pleaded with him, invoking God’s name, to take her back. She said, “By God, I have no desire for men; I only wish to be resurrected among your wives. Give my day to Aisha.” The Messenger of God, ﷺ, did so.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 146
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِلَبَنِ الْفَحْلِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “There is no objection to recognizing the husband as the milk-father in breastfeeding kinship.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 147
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْفَحْلِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “Breastfeeding does not establish marriage prohibitions through the husband (the milk-father).”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 147
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «إِذَا وَضَعَتْ ذَا بَطْنِهَا فَقَدْ حَلَّتْ لِلرِّجَالِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “When she gives birth to the child she is carrying, she becomes eligible for marriage.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 147
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا أَعْتَقَ الرَّجُلُ أُمَّ وَلَدِهِ فَلَا يَتَزَوَّجُ أُخْتَهَا، يَعْنِي فِي عِدَّتِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said When a man emancipates his slave-woman who bore him a child, he may not marry her sister—meaning, while she is still in her waiting period.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 147
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ تَكُونُ لَهُ أَرْبَعُ نِسْوَةٍ فَيُطَلِّقُ إِحْدَاهُنَّ: «لَا يَتَزَوَّجُ حَتَّى تَنْقَضِيَ عِدَّتُهَا» قَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: لَا نَأْخُذُ بِقَوْلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الرَّضَاعِ، وَلَكِنْ يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ النَّسَبِ، وَقَالَ أَبُو يُوسُفَ فِي عِدَّةِ أُمِّ الْوَلَدِ: لَهُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ أُخْتَهَا فِي عِدَّتِهَا؛ لِأَنَّ عِدَّتَهَا لَيْسَتْ بِعِدَّةِ نِكَاحٍ وَلَا يَطَؤُهَا مَا دَامَتْ أُخْتُهَا فِي عِدَّةٍ مِنْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man with four wives who divorces one of them: “He must not marry another woman until her waiting period ends.” Abu Hanifah said: “We do not follow Ibrahim’s view about breastfeeding; rather, what is forbidden through breastfeeding is what is forbidden through lineage.” Abu Yusuf said about the waiting period of an umm walad: “He may marry her sister during her waiting period, because it is not a marital waiting period; but he may not have intercourse with her while her sister is still observing a waiting period from him.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Oaths of Abstention from Sexual Relations

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 147
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا مَضَتْ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ بَانَتْ بِالْإِيلَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ishaq from Shurayh
entries.matn_en: that he said When four months have passed, she is irrevocably divorced by the oath of abstention.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 147
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أُنَيْسٍ آلَى مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ، فَغَابَ ثُمَّ قَدِمَ بَعْدَ خَمْسَةِ أَشْهُرٍ فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى أَصْحَابِهِ وَرَأْسُهُ يَقْطُرُ، فَقَالُوا أَصَبْتَ مِنْ فُلَانَةَ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ "، قَالُوا: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ آلَيْتَ مِنْهَا؟ قَالَ: بَلَى "، قَالُوا: نَرَاهَا قَدْ بَانَتْ مِنْكَ، فَانْطَلَقُوا إِلَى عَلْقَمَةَ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا عِنْدَهُ فِيهَا شَيْئًا، وَانْطَلَقَ بِهِمْ عَلْقَمَةُ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنه، فَذَكَرُوا لَهُ أَمْرَهُ وَأَمْرَهَا، فَقَالَ: «أَخْبِرْهَا أَنَّهَا قَدْ بَانَتْ مِنْكَ وَاخْطُبْهَا» فَفَعَلَ وَأَصْدَقَهَا مَثَاقِيلَ فِضَّةٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that 'Abd Allah b. Unays swore to abstain from his wife, then went away and returned after five months and had intercourse with her. He then went out to his companions, his head dripping wet. They asked, “Have you been with so-and-so?” He said, “Yes.” They asked, “Had you not sworn to abstain from her?” He replied, “Yes.” They said, “We think she has become separated from you.” So they went to 'Alqamah, but he had no ruling for them on the matter. 'Alqamah then took them to 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, ؓ. They told him what had happened to the man and his wife. He said, “Tell her that she is now separated from you, and propose to her.” He did so and gave her several mithqals of silver as her dowry.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 148
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بَذِيمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْإِيلَاءِ: «إِذَا مَضَتِ الْأَرْبَعَةُ الْأَشْهُرِ بَانَتْ بِتَطْلِيقَةٍ، وَيَخْطُبُهَا زَوْجُهَا فِي عِدَّتِهَا وَلَا يَخْطُبُهَا غَيْرُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ali b. Budaymah, from Abu Ubaydah, from Masruq,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding an oath of abstention (ila'): “When the four months have passed, she is separated by one divorce. Her husband may propose to her during her waiting period, but no one else may propose to her.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 148
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُولِي مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ: «فَيْؤُهُ الرِّضَا إِذَا كَانَ لَهَا عُذْرٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Alqamah
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the man who swears to abstain from his wife: "His return to her is by her consent if she has a valid excuse."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 148
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا مَضَتْ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ» قِيلَ لَهُ: أَتَفِيءُ أَوْ تَعْزِمُ الطَّلَاقَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, from someone who reported to him from Abu al-Zubayr that he said
entries.matn_en: When four months have passed, it was said to him: Do you retract or do you resolve upon divorce?

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 148
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هِنْدَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ آلَى مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ، فَوَقَفَ بَعْدَ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: أَتَفِيءُ أَوْ تَعْزِمُ الطَّلَاقَ؟ قَالَ «أَفِيءُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Hind,
entries.matn_en: that Abu al-Zubayr took an oath of abstention from his wife. After four months, he was asked, "Will you return to her or resolve to divorce?" He said , "I will return."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 149
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِيلَاءُ الْأَمَةِ شَهْرَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “The ila' period for a slave woman is two months.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 149
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي رَجُلٍ آلَى مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ، ثُمَّ وَاقَعَهَا بَعْدَ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ قَالَ «عَلَيْهِ الْكَفَّارَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who swore to abstain from his wife, then had intercourse with her after four months: "He must offer expiation."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 149
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا آلَى الرَّجُلُ مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقَهَا أَوْ طَلَّقَهَا ثُمَّ آلَى مِنْهَا، فَأَيُّهُمَا سَبَقَ وَقَعَ فِي الْوَجْهَيْنِ جَمِيعًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Amir
entries.matn_en: that he said When a man swears to abstain from his wife and then divorces her, or divorces her and then swears to abstain from her, whichever of the two comes first takes effect in both cases.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 149
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: فِي رَجُلٍ آلَى مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ فَتَرَكَهَا حَتَّى انْقَضَتِ الْأَرْبَعَةُ، قَالَ «بَانَتْ مِنْهُ بِتَطْلِيقَةٍ وَاسْتَأْنَفَتِ الْعِدَّةَ بَعْدَ الْأَرْبَعَةِ، وَيَخْطُبُهَا فِي الْعِدَّةِ وَلَا يَخْطُبُهَا غَيْرُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Amr b. Murrah, from Abu Ubaydah, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who swore an oath to abstain from his wife and left her until the four months passed: "She is separated from him by one divorce, and she begins a new waiting period after the four months. He may propose to her during the waiting period, but no one else may propose to her."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 149
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْفَيْءُ الْجِمَاعُ، وَعَزِيمَةُ الطَّلَاقِ انْقِضَاءُ الْأَرْبَعَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Hakam, from Miqsam, from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said: “The husband’s return from ila' is intercourse; his decision to divorce comes when the four months expire.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 149
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَيْسَ إِلَى النِّسَاءِ مِنَ الْإِيلَاءِ وَلَا الظِّهَارِ وَلَا الطَّلَاقِ شَيْءٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “Women have no authority to initiate ila', zihar, or divorce.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 150
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «يَهْدِمُ الطَّلَاقُ الْإِيلَاءَ» وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: قَوْلُ عَامِرٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he used to say: "Divorce nullifies the oath of abstention (ila)." Abu Hanifah said "The statement of Amir is more preferable to me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 150
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ وثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: ثنا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ آلَى مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ شَهْرًا أَوْ شَهْرَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا مَا دُونَ الْأَرْبَعَةِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِيلَاءٌ» وَذَكَرَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ عَنْهُ نَحْوَ هَذَا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, who narrated from Sa'id ibn Abi 'Aruba, from 'Amir al-Ahwal, from 'Ata, from Ibn 'Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said: “Whoever swears to abstain from his wife for one, two, or three months—any period under four months—is not subject to the legal rule of ila'.” Abu Hanifah also related something similar from him.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Ẓihār (a pre-Islamic form of divorce)

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 150
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي رَجُلٍ لَهُ أَرْبَعُ نِسْوَةٍ قَالَ أَنْتُنَّ عَلَيَّ كَظَهْرِ أُمِّي؟ قَالَ: «فَعَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعُ كَفَّارَاتٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who has four wives and says, "You are to me like the back of my mother." He said , "He must offer four expiations."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 150
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ " إِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ لِامْرَأَتِهِ: أَنْتِ عَلَيَّ كَظَهْرِ امْرَأَةٍ مَحْرَمٍ فَهُوَ ظِهَارٌ، وَإِنْ قَالَ أَنْتِ عَلَيَّ كَظَهْرِ امْرَأَةٍ لَيْسَتْ بِذَاتِ مَحْرَمٍ فَلَيْسَ بِظِهَارٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said When a man says to his wife, "You are to me like the back of a woman who is a mahram," it is zihar. But if he says, "You are to me like the back of a woman who is not a mahram," it is not zihar.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 150
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي رَجُلٍ ظَاهَرَ مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقَهَا ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا بَعْدَ مَا انْقَضَتِ الْعِدَّةُ، قَالَ «الظِّهَارُ كَمَا هُوَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who declared zihar against his wife, then divorced her, then married her again after her waiting period had ended. He said "The zihar remains as it is."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 150
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَقُولُ لِامْرَأَتِهِ: إِنْ قَرِبْتُكِ فَأَنْتِ عَلَيَّ كَظَهْرِ أُمِّي؟ قَالَ «إِنْ قَرِبَهَا وَقَعَ الظِّهَارُ وَإِنْ تَرَكَهَا وَقَعَ الْإِيلَاءُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the man who says to his wife, “If I approach you, you are to me like the back of my mother.” He said , “If he approaches her, the zihar takes effect, and if he abandons her, the ila’ takes effect.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُظَاهِرُ مِنْ أَرْبَعِ نِسْوَةٍ قَالَ: «عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعُ كَفَّارَاتٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who performs zihar from four wives: "He must offer four expiations."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا تُجْزِئُ أُمُّ الْوَلَدِ فِي الظِّهَارِ، وَالَّذِي يُظَاهِرُ مِنْ أَمَتِهِ لَا يُجْزِئُ عَنْهَا إِلَّا التَّحْرِيرُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “A female slave who has borne her master a child (umm walad) cannot be used to fulfill the emancipation required for zihar expiation. Whoever pronounces zihar concerning his female slave has no expiation for it except to emancipate her.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُظَاهِرُ مِنِ امْرَأَتِهِ ثُمَّ يُظَاهِرُ أَيْضًا مَرَّتَيْنِ: «إِنْ أَرَادَ التَّغْلِيظَ فَعَلَيْهِ لِكُلِّ ظِهَارٍ كَفَّارَةٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَ أَرَادَ ظِهَارَهُ الْأَوَّلَ فَعَلَيْهِ كَفَّارَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، وَكَذَلِكَ الْيَمِينُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who performs zihar from his wife and then performs zihar again two more times: If he intended to make it more severe, then he must offer expiation for each zihar. But if he only intended his first zihar, then he must offer only one expiation. The same applies to an oath.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُظَاهِرُ مِنِ امْرَأَتِهِ ثُمَّ يَطَأُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُكَفِّرَ: «أَنَّهُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَلَا يَعُودُ حَتَّى يُكَفِّرَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the man who performs zihar against his wife then has intercourse with her before expiating: "He should seek forgiveness from God and not repeat it until he has expiated."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا ظَاهَرَ الرَّجُلُ مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، فَإِنْ عَنَى الظِّهَارَ وَحْدَهُ فَعَلَيْهِ كَفَّارَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، وَإِنْ عَنَى بِكُلِّ قَوْلٍ ظِهَارًا فَعَلَيْهِ ثَلَاثُ كَفَّارَاتٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said: “If a man declares zihar against his wife three times, then if he intended a single declaration of zihar, only one expiation is due; but if he intended each statement as a separate declaration, three expiations are due.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْعَبْدِ يُظَاهِرُ مِنِ امْرَأَتِهِ: «فَعَلَيْهِ صَوْمُ شَهْرَيْنِ لَا يُجْزِئُهُ تَحْرِيرٌ وَلَا طَعَامٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the slave who performs dhihar from his wife: "He must fast two months; freeing a slave or feeding the poor will not suffice for him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 151
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِي جَزْءٍ نَصْرِ بْنِ طَرِيفٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ شَاءَ بَاهَلْتُهُ أَنَّهُ لَا كَفَّارَةَ عَلَى الَّذِي يُظَاهِرُ مِنْ أَمَتِهِ» وَذَكَرَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ عَنْهُ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated to us, saying: Abu Yusuf narrated to us from Abu Jaz’ Nasr b. Tarif, from Ayyub, from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said: “Whoever wishes, I will enter into a mutual imprecation with him: may God’s curse be upon whichever of us is lying about there being no expiation for one who pronounces zihar against his female slave.” Abu Hanifah also related something similar from him.

sections.title_en: The Chapter on Temporary Marriage

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 152
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «شَكَوْنَا الْعُزُوبَةَ، فَأُحِلَّتْ لَنَا الْمُتْعَةُ ثَلَاثًا قَطُّ، ثُمَّ نَسَخَتْهَا آيَةُ النِّكَاحِ وَالْعِدَّةِ وَالْمِيرَاثِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Abdullah b. Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said We complained about celibacy, so temporary marriage was made lawful for us three times, then the verse of marriage, waiting period, and inheritance abrogated it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 152
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْأَهْلِيَّةِ أَوِ الْإِنْسِيَّةِ وَعَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ» : مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُسَافِحِينَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Nafi’, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said The Prophet, ﷺ, forbade the meat of domestic donkeys and temporary marriage—temporary marriage with women—saying, "We were not fornicators."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 152
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَبِيعٍ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Yunus b. Abdullah from Rabi'
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, forbade temporary marriage on the day of the conquest of Mecca.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 153
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «
entries.matn_ar: نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, from someone who reported to him from al-Zuhri, that he said
entries.matn_en: The Prophet, ﷺ, forbade temporary marriage on the day of the Conquest of Mecca.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Invoking Curse (Li'an)

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 153
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي رَجُلٍ قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ ثُمَّ طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا قَالَ «لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا لِعَانٌ، وَلَا حَدَّ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who accuses his wife of adultery and then divorces her three times: “There is no li'an between them, and he is not subject to the prescribed punishment.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 153
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا قَذَفَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ فَهُمَا عَلَى نِكَاحِهِمَا مَا لَمْ يَتَرَافَعَا، فَإِذَا تَرَافَعَا لَاعَنَهَا وَأُلْزِقَ الْوَلَدُ بِأُمِّهِ، وَاللِّعَانُ تَطْلِيقَةٌ بَائِنَةٌ، وَلَهَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةُ مَا دَامَتْ فِي عِدَّتِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “If a man accuses his wife of adultery, they remain married unless they bring the matter before a judge. If they do, he performs li'an (mutual imprecation) with her, and the child is attributed to its mother. Li'an is one irrevocable divorce, and she is entitled to housing and maintenance for as long as she remains in her waiting period.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 153
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا لِعَانَ إِلَّا بَيْنَ الْحُرَّيْنِ الْمُسْلِمَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said "There is no li'an except between two free Muslims."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 153
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الَّذِي يُلَاعِنُ امْرَأَتَهُ: «إِنْ أَكْذَبَ نَفْسَهُ جُلِدَ الْحَدَّ وَكَانَ خَاطِبًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the man who invokes li'an against his wife: "If he admits his own lie, he is flogged with the prescribed punishment and becomes a suitor."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 153
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُقِرُّ بِابْنِهِ وَأُمُّهُ حُرَّةٌ، ثُمَّ يَنْفِيهِ، قَالَ «يُلَاعِنُهَا وَيَنْفِيهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ طَلَّقَهَا يُضْرَبُ الْحَدَّ وَكَانَ ابْنَهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ أُمُّهُ قَدْ مَاتَتْ كَانَ ابْنَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who acknowledges his son whose mother is a free woman, then denies him: "He may invoke li'an against her and deny him. If he had already divorced her, the hadd punishment is applied, and he remains his son. If the mother had already died, he remains his son."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 154
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَقْذِفُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا فَنَظَرَ فَإِذَا هِيَ أُخْتُهُ: «فَلَا حَدَّ عَلَيْهِ وَلَا لِعَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who slanders his wife but has not consummated the marriage, then discovers she is his sister: "There is no prescribed punishment upon him, nor is there the process of mutual cursing."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 154
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَرْأَةَ فِي عِدَّتِهَا، وَدَخَلَ بِهَا ثُمَّ قَذَفَهَا، فَلَاعَنَهَا ثُمَّ عَلِمَ بِذَلِكَ فَاللِّعَانُ بَاطِلٌ، وَلَا حَدَّ عَلَيْهِ، وَيَخْطُبُهَا إِذَا انْقَضَتِ عِدَّتُهَا مِنَ الْأَوَّلِ، وَإِنْ عَلِمَ قَبْلَ اللِّعَانِ أَنَّهَا فِي عِدَّةٍ فَلَا حَدَّ عَلَيْهِ وَلَا لِعَانَ، وَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَهُوَ خَاطِبٌ إِذَا انْقَضَتِ الْعِدَّةُ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said If a man marries a woman during her waiting period and consummates the marriage, then accuses her of adultery, and they engage in the imprecation (li'an), but he later learns of her waiting period, the imprecation is invalid, and no hadd punishment applies to him. He may propose to her once her waiting period from the first husband has ended. If he learns before the imprecation that she is in her waiting period, then no hadd punishment applies to him, nor is there any imprecation, and they must be separated. He remains a suitor for her once the waiting period from the first husband has ended.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 154
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا قَذَفَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ بَعْدَ تَطْلِيقَةٍ يَمْلِكُ الرَّجْعَةَ، فَإِنَّهُ يُلَاعِنُ وَيُلْزِمُ الْوَلَدَ أُمَّهُ، وَالْأُمُّ عَصَبَةُ مَنْ لَا عَصَبَةَ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “If a man accuses his wife of adultery after pronouncing a revocable divorce, he performs li'an with her, and the child is attributed to its mother. The mother is the residuary heir when a person has no other residuary heir.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Coitus Interruptus

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 154
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَخَذَ مِيثَاقَ نَسَمَةٍ فِي صُلْبِ رَجُلٍ ثُمَّ صَبَّهُ عَلَى صَفَاةٍ، لَأَخْرَجَ اللَّهُ مِنْهَا تِلْكَ النَّسَمَةَ الَّتِي أَخَذَ مِنْهَا مَيثَاقَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "If God had taken a covenant from a soul in the loins of a man, then poured it onto a smooth rock, God would certainly bring forth from it that very soul from which He took the covenant."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 154
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ الْأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذِرَاعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى {فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة: 223] «إِنْ شِئْتَ فَاعْزِلْ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَلَا عَزْلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Kathir al-Asamm from Abu Dhira‘ from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: regarding the words of the Exalted, “Come to your tillage however you will,” that he said , “If you wish, withdraw, and if you wish, do not withdraw.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 155
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِالْعَزْلِ عَنِ الْأَمَةِ، فَأَمَّا الْحُرَّةُ، فَإِنْ أَذِنَتْ لَكَ فَاعْزِلْ وَإِنْ لَمْ تَأْذَنْ لَكَ فَلَا تَعْزِلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr
entries.matn_en: who said "There is no harm in coitus interruptus with a slave woman. As for a free woman, if she permits you, then practice coitus interruptus, but if she does not permit you, then do not."

sections.title_en: The Chapter on Judgment

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 155
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " هَلَكَ قَاضٍ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَى فَتًى مِنْ عُلَمَائِهِمْ، فَأَتَوْا رَجُلًا فَسَأَلُوهُ أَنْ يَقْعُدَ عَلَى الْقَضَاءِ فَأَبَى عَلَيْهِمْ، فَأُتِيَ فِي مَنَامِهِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: مَا يَمْنَعُكَ أَنْ تَقْعُدَ عَلَى الْقَضَاءِ؟ قَالَ: خِفْتُ أَنْ أَجُورَ، قَالَ: فَقِيلَ لَهُ: أَمَا نَجْعَلُ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْجَوْرِ عَلَمًا فُلَانًا، إِذَا قُمْتَ مَعَهُ فَكَانَ أَطْوَلَ مِنْكَ فَقَدْ جُرْتَ، قَالَ: فَأَصْبَحَ فَقَعَدَ عَلَى الْقَضَاءِ، وَكَانَ يُرْسِلُ إِلَى ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ فَيَقُومُ مَعَهُ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِرَارًا إِذَا أَشْكَلَ عَلَيْهِ الشَّيْءُ أَوْ شَكَّ فِيهِ، قَالَ: فَقَامَ مَعَهُ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فَكَانَ أَطْوَلَ مِنْهُ، قَالَ: فَقَامَ عَنِ الْقَضَاءِ حَزِينًا خَبِيثَ النَّفْسِ، فَأُتِيَ فِي مَنَامِهِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: قُمْتَ عَنِ الْقَضَاءِ، قَالَ: الْعَلَمُ الَّذِي جَعَلْتُمُوهُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَرْسَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ، فَقُمْتُ مَعَهُ، فَكَانَ أَطْوَلَ مِنِّي، قَالَ: فَقِيلَ لَهُ: أَمَا إِنَّ ذَلِكَ لَيْسَ مِنْ جُورٍ جُرْتَهُ، وَلَكِنَّهُ انْتَهَى إِلَيْكَ خَصْمَانِ فَأَحْبَبْتَ أَنْ يَكُونَ الْحَقُّ لِأَحَدِهِمَا فَتَقْضِي لَهُ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ: أَلَا تَرَانِي أَجُورُ فِي نَفْسِي قَبْلَ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ، لَا أَقْعُدُ عَلَى الْقَضَاءِ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Alqamah b. Marthad, from Abd al-Rahman b. Sabit,
entries.matn_en: who said A judge among the Children of Israel perished, leaving behind a young man from among their scholars. They approached a man and asked him to sit as a judge, but he refused. Then, he was visited in his dream and asked, "What prevents you from sitting as a judge?" He replied, "I fear that I may be unjust." It was said to him, "Shall We place between you and injustice a sign—so-and-so—so that if you stand with him and he is taller than you, then you have been unjust?" He said, "In the morning, he sat as a judge and would send for that man, standing with him several times a day whenever something was unclear or he had doubt about it." One day, he stood with him, and the man was taller than him. So, he stepped down from the judiciary, grieved and distressed. He was then visited in his dream and asked, "You stepped down from the judiciary?" He replied, "I sent for the sign you placed between me and injustice, and when I stood with him, he was taller than me." It was said to him, "That was not from the injustice you feared. Rather, two disputing parties came before you, and you wished the right to be for one of them, so you ruled in his favor." He said, "Do you not see that I am unjust within myself before I even speak? I will never sit as a judge after this, ever."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 156
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ شُرَيْحٍ إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِصَبَّاغٍ فَقَالَ: دَفَعْتُ ثَوْبِي إِلَى هَذَا، فَاحْتَرَقَ بَيْتُهُ فِيمَا يَزْعُمُ، قَالَ شُرَيْحٌ: «كَذَلِكَ» ، قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: «اغْرَمْ لَهُ ثَوْبَهُ» ، قَالَ: كَيْفَ أَغْرَمُ لَهُ ثَوْبَهُ وَقَدِ احْتَرَقَ بَيْتِي، قَالَ: «أَرَأَيْتَ لَوِ احْتَرَقَ بَيْتُهُ أَكُنْتَ تَدَعُ لَهُ مِنْ أَجْرِكَ شَيْئًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ali b. al-Aqmar
entries.matn_en: who said I was sitting with Shurayh when a man came with a dyer and said, "I gave my garment to this man, but his house burned down, as he claims." Shurayh said, "Is that so?" The man replied, "Yes." Shurayh said, "Compensate him for his garment." The man asked, "How can I compensate him for his garment when my house has burned down?" Shurayh said, "Tell me, if his house had burned down, would you have left him any of your wages?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 156
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ أَتَيَا شُرَيْحًا يَخْتَصِمَانِ إِلَيْهِ، وَقَدْ أَعَارَ أَحَدُهُمَا حَائِطَهُ فَوَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ جِذْعًا، فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُحَوِّلَ جِذْعَهُ، فَقَالَ شُرَيْحٌ: «حَوِّلْ جِذْعَكَ عَنْ مَطِيَّةِ أَخِيكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ali b. al-Aqmar:
entries.matn_en: Two men came to Shurayh disputing before him. One of them had lent his wall to the other, who placed a beam on it. The owner of the wall wanted to move his beam, so Shurayh said , "Move your beam away from your brother’s mount."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 156
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه قَضَى فِي رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي ذُبْيَانَ قَتَلَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحِيرَةِ: أَنْ يَدْفَعَ إِلَى وَلِيِّهِ، قَالَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ: اقْتُلْ حُنَيْنًا، قَالَ: «حَتَّى يَجِيءَ الْغَضَبُ ثُمَّ أَقْتُلُهُ» فَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ حِينَ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّهُ مِنْ فُرْسَانِ النَّاسِ فَأَحَبَّ أَنْ يَفْدِيَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
