entries.matn_en: that Umar, ؓ, ruled that a man from Banu Dhubyan who had killed a man from the people of al-Hirah should be handed over to the victim’s heir. Someone said to the heir, “Kill Hunayn.” He replied, “Not until anger comes; then I will kill him.” Later, when Umar learned that Hunayn was one of the people’s horsemen, he wrote that he wanted to ransom him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 156
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «إِذَا شَهِدَتِ الشُّهُودُ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ بِالزِّنَا أَحَدُهُمْ زَوْجُهَا رُجِمَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said When witnesses testify against a woman for adultery, and one of them is her husband, she is stoned.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 156
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَبِيتُ الرَّجُلُ فِي دَارِهِ لَيْلًا بِالسِّلَاحِ فَيَقْتُلُهُ، قَالَ «إِنْ عُلِمَ أَنَّهُ رَجُلُ سَوْءٍ دَاعِرٌ بَطُلَ دَمُهُ، وَإِنْ كَانَ لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ ضَمِنَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who spends the night in another man’s house armed at night and is killed: If it is known that he is a wicked, corrupt man, his blood is forfeit. But if he is not of that sort, the killer must pay compensation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 157
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَتَاهُ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْآخَرَ قَدْ زَنَى، فَرَدَّهُ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فَرَدَّهُ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ، فَرَدَّهُ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الرَّابِعَةَ فَسَأَلَ عَنْهُ قَوْمَهُ: «هَلْ تُنْكِرُونَ مِنْ عَقْلِهِ شَيْئًا؟» قَالُوا: لَا، قَالَ: فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ، فَأُتِيَ بِهِ أَرْضًا قَلِيلَةَ الْحِجَارَةِ، فَلَمَّا أَبْطَأَ عَلَيْهِ الْمَوْتُ انْطَلَقَ يَسْعَى إِلَى أَرْضٍ كَثِيرَةِ الْحِجَارَةِ، وَتَبِعَهُ النَّاسُ حَتَّى قَتَلُوهُ، فَلَمَّا أُخْبِرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ قَالَ: «فَهَلَّا خَلَّيْتُمْ سَبِيلَهُ» ، قَالَ: وَقَالَ بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ: هَلَكَ مَاعِزٌ وَأَهْلَكَ، وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: إِنَّا لَنَرْجُو أَنْ يَكُونَ تَوْبَتَهُ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «لَقَدْ تَابَ تَوْبَةً لَوْ تَابَهَا فِئَامُ النَّاسِ لَقُبِلَ مِنْهُمْ» فَطَمِعَ قَوْمُهُ فِي جَسَدِهِ، فَكَلَّمُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِ، فَقَالَ: «افْعَلُوا بِهِ كَمَا تَفْعَلُونَ بِمَوْتَاكُمْ مِنَ الْكَفَنِ وَالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Alqamah b. Marthad, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, was approached by Ma'iz b. Malik, ؓ, who said, “This wretched man has committed adultery.” The Prophet turned him away. Ma'iz came again, and the Prophet turned him away; he came a third time, and the Prophet turned him away; then he came a fourth time. The Prophet asked Ma'iz’s people, “Do you notice anything wrong with his reason?” They said, “No.” So he ordered that Ma'iz be stoned. He was taken to a place with few stones. When death was slow to come, he ran toward a place with many stones, and the people followed him until they killed him. When the Prophet was told what had happened, he said, “Why did you not let him go?” Some people of Medina said, “Ma'iz is ruined and has ruined others,” while others said, “We hope his repentance will be accepted.” When this reached the Prophet, he said, “He made such a repentance that, if a multitude of people made it, it would be accepted from them.” His people then sought his body and spoke to the Prophet about it. He said, “Do for him what you do for your dead: shroud him and pray over him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 157
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ إِذَا مَاتَ: «فَمَا كَانَ فِي الْبَيْتِ مِنْ مَتَاعِ الرِّجَالِ فَهُوَ لِلرِّجَالِ، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ مَتَاعِ النِّسَاءِ فَهُوَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ، وَمَا كَانَ مِنْ مَتَاعِ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ فَهُوَ لِلْبَاقِي بَعْدُ مِنْهُمَا، إِلَّا أَنْ يُقِيمَ الْآخَرُ بَيِّنَةً، وَإِذَا طَلَّقَ فَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ، غَيْرَ أَنَّ مَا كَانَ لِلنِّسَاءِ وَالرِّجَالِ فَهُوَ لِلرَّجُلِ؛ لِأَنَّهُ صَاحِبُ الْبَيْتِ فَلَهُ كُلُّ مَا كَانَ فِي الْبَيْتِ، إِلَّا مَا كَانَ مِنْ مَتَاعِ النِّسَاءِ وَإِذَا اخْتَلَفَا وَلَمْ يُطَلِّقْ فَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man when he dies: "Whatever is in the house of men's belongings belongs to the men, and whatever is of women's belongings belongs to the woman. As for what belongs to both men and women, it goes to the one who remains afterward, unless the other produces evidence. If he divorces, it is the same, except that what belongs to both women and men goes to the man because he is the owner of the house, and everything in the house belongs to him except what is of women's belongings. If they dispute and he does not divorce, it is the same."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 158
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُضَمِّنُ الْقَصَّارَ وَلَا الصَّوَّاغَ وَلَا الْحَائِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, Bashir reported to us from Muhammad b. Ali from his father from Ali, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he would not hold the fuller, the goldsmith, or the weaver liable for compensation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 158
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَكُونُ بَيْنَهُمَا الْوَلَدُ أَحَدُهُمَا كَافِرٌ وَالْآخَرُ مُسْلِمٌ: «أَنَّ الْوَلَدَ لِلْمُسْلِمِ مِنْهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man and a woman who have a child together, one of them a disbeliever and the other a Muslim: “The child is assigned to the Muslim parent.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 158
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلَيْنِ يَدَّعِيَانِ الْوَلَدَ: «أَنَّهُ ابْنُهُمَا يَرِثُهُمَا وَيَرِثَانِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding two men who claim a child: "He is their son, he inherits from them and they inherit from him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 158
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الصَّبِيِّ إِذَا اسْتَغْنَى عَنْ أُمِّهِ فِي الْأَكْلِ وَالشُّرْبِ وَاللِّبْسِ: «فَالْأَبُ أَحَقُّ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a boy who no longer needs his mother to eat, drink, or dress: “The father has the stronger claim to him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 158
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْأُمُّ أَحَقُّ بِالْوَلَدِ مَا كَانَ إِلَيْهَا مُحْتَاجًا، فَإِذَا تَزَوَّجَتْ فَجَدَّتُهُ أَوْ خَالَتُهُ أَحَقُّ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said "The mother has more right to the child as long as he is in need of her. If she marries, then his grandmother or his maternal aunt has more right to him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 159
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يُنْفِقُ عَلَى كُلِّ ذِي رَحِمٍ مَحْرَمٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said He spends on every relative with whom marriage is prohibited.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 159
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ:
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً طَوِيلَةً جَمِيلَةً، عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابٌ جِيَادٌ، تَقَدَّمَتْ إِلَى ابْنِ زِيَادٍ تَشْكُو زَوْجَهَا فِي النَّفَقَةِ وَإِضْرَارِهِ بِهَا، فَدَعَا زَوْجَهَا، فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ قَصِيرٌ قَلِيلٌ دَمِيمٌ، فَقَالَ سَلْهَا عَنْ هَذَا الشَّخْصِ أَمِنْ طَعَامِي هُوَ؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، أَفَتَمُنُّ عَلَيَّ بِكِسْرَةٍ قَالَ: فَسَلْهَا عَنْ هَذِهِ الثِّيَابِ أَمِنْ كُسْوَتِي؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، أَتَمُنُّ عَلَيَّ بِخِرْقَةٍ قَالَ: فَسَلْهَا عَمَّا فِي بَطْنِهَا أَمِنِّي هُوَ؟ قَالَتْ: نَعَمْ، وَوَدِدْتُ أَنَّهُ فِي بَطْنِ كَلْبٍ، قَالَ: فَمَا يُطْلَبُ مِنَ الزَّوْجِ إِلَّا أَنْ يُطْعِمَ وَيَكْسُوَ وَيُحْبِلَ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ: «صَدَقْتَ ذَلِكَ يُطْلَبُ مِنْهُ خُذْ بِيَدِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abdul-Malik b. Umayr
entries.matn_en: that a tall, beautiful woman, dressed in fine clothes, came before Ibn Ziyad to complain about her husband’s maintenance and the harm he caused her. Ibn Ziyad summoned her husband, who arrived as a short, unattractive man. He said, “Ask her about this person: is he from the food I provide?” She said, “Yes. Are you holding a morsel over me?” He said, “Ask her about these clothes: are they from the clothing I provide?” She said, “Yes. Are you holding a rag over me?” He said, “Ask her about the child in her womb: is it mine?” She said, “Yes, and I wish it were in a dog’s womb.” He said, “Is a husband required to do anything beyond feeding, clothing, and impregnating her?” Ibn Ziyad said, “You have spoken the truth; that is what is required of him. Take her by the hand.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 159
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا ضَرَبَهَا الطَّلْقُ فَهِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمَرِيضِ فِيمَا صَنَعَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said regarding a woman in labor: “When labor pains strike her, she is like a sick person in the legal dispositions she makes.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 159
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَدِمَ بِرَقِيقٍ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ، فَاحْتَاجَ إِلَى نَفَقَةٍ فَبَاعَ وَصِيفًا مِنْهُمْ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَظَرَ إِلَى أُمِّ الْوَصِيفِ وَالِهًا فَقَالَ «مَالِي أَرَاهَا وَالِهًا؟» قَالَ: كُنَّا احْتَجْنَا إِلَى نَفَقَةٍ فَبِعْنَا ابْنَهَا، قَالَ: «فَارْجِعْ فَرُدَّهُ» فَرَجَعَ فَرَدَّهُ، قَالَ: فَنَحْنُ وَآلُ عَبَّاسٍ نَخْتَصِمُ فِي وَلَائِهِ، يَقُولُونَ: أَعْتَقَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَلَاؤُهُ لَنَا، وَنَقُولُ نَحْنُ: وَهَبَهُ لِعَلِيٍّ فَأَعْتَقَهُ فَوَلَاؤُهُ لَنَا "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abdullah b. al-Hasan, from Zayd b. Harithah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that Zayd b. Harithah arrived with enslaved people from Yemen. Needing funds for expenses, he sold one young male slave. When he came to the Prophet, ﷺ, the boy’s mother was distraught. The Prophet asked, “Why do I see her so distressed?” Zayd replied, “We needed money for expenses, so we sold her son.” The Prophet said, “Go back and bring him back.” Zayd did so. Zayd said: “The family of Abbas and we dispute over his wala' (manumission-based clientage). They say, ‘The Prophet freed him, so his wala' belongs to us.’ We say, ‘The Prophet gave him to Ali, who freed him, so his wala' belongs to us.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 160
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي رَجُلٍ طَلَبَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ أَنْ يَكْفُلَ بِهِ فَأَبَى حَتَّى يَجْعَلَ لَهُ جُعْلًا، قَالَ: «لَا يَصْلُحُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who asked another man to guarantee him but he refused until he was given a fee: "It is not permissible."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 160
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُضَارَبَةِ بِالنِّصْفِ وَالثُّلُثِ وَفَضْلِ عَشْرَةٍ لَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ: «أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ لَمْ يَرْبَحْ إِلَّا عَشْرَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding a profit-sharing partnership of half, a third, and an additional ten: "There is no good in it. Have you considered if he only earned ten?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 160
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَعْطَاهُ مَالًا مُضَارَبَةً لِيَتِيمٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Humayd b. Ubayd from his father
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, gave him money as a mudarabah (profit-sharing partnership) for an orphan.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 160
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي " الْمُضَارَبَةِ وَالْوَدِيعَةِ وَالدَّيْنِ سَوَاءٌ فِي مَالِ الْمَيِّتِ: يَتَحَاصُّونَ جَمِيعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the mudarabah, deposit, and debt: they are equal in the wealth of the deceased, and they all share proportionally.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 160
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ رضي الله عنه عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ اخْتَصَمَا إِلَيْهِ فِي نَاقَةٍ ادَّعَاهَا كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا، وَأَقَامَ الْبَيِّنَةَ أَنَّهَا نَاقَتُهُ أَنْتَجَهَا، فَقَضَى بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلَّذِي هِيَ فِي يَدَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from a man from Jabir, ؓ, from the Prophet, ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: “Two men disputed before him over a she-camel. Each claimed it and presented evidence that it was his and that he had bred her. The Messenger of God ruled in favor of the one who possessed her.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 161
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا ارْتَدَّتْ عَنِ الْإِسْلَامِ: «يُعْرَضُ عَلَيْهَا الْإِسْلَامُ، فَإِنْ أَسْلَمَتْ تُرِكَتْ، وَإِنْ أَبَتْ قُتِلَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: regarding a woman who apostatizes from Islam: “She is invited to return to Islam. If she embraces Islam, she is left alone; if she refuses, she is killed.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 161
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْقَاتِلَ لَا يَرِثُ الْمَقْتُولَ مِنْ دِيَتِهِ وَلَا مِنْ غَيْرِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that a killer does not inherit from the person he killed, either from that person’s blood money or from any other part of the estate.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 161
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لِكُلِّ وَارِثٍ فِي الدَّمِ نَصِيبٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said Every heir has a share in the blood-money.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 161
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْبَيِّنَةُ عَلَى الْمُدَّعِي، وَالْيَمِينُ عَلَى الْمُدَّعَى عَلَيْهِ، وَكَانَ لَا يَرُدُّ الْيَمِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “The burden of proof is on the claimant, and the oath is upon the defendant.” Ibrahim would not refer the oath back to the claimant.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُجِيزُ شَهَادَةَ الرَّجُلِ لِامْرَأَتِهِ، وَلَا الْمَرْأَةِ لِزَوْجِهَا، وَلَا الشَّرِيكِ لِشَرِيكِهِ وَلَا السَّيِّدِ لِعَبْدِهِ، وَلَا رَجُلٍ لِأَبِيهِ، وَلَا أَبٍ لِابْنِهِ، وَلَا الْأَعْمَى، وَلَا الْمَحْدُودِ فِي قَذْفٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Amir from Shurayh
entries.matn_en: that he would not accept the testimony of a man for his wife, nor of a woman for her husband, nor of a partner for his partner, nor of a master for his slave, nor of a man for his father, nor of a father for his son, nor of a blind man, nor of one who had been punished for slander.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: فِي " الصَّبِيِّ ثُمَّ يَكْبُرُ وَالْعَبْدِ ثُمَّ يُعْتَقُ وَالْيَهُودِيِّ وَالنَّصْرَانِيِّ يُسْلِمَانِ، ثُمَّ يَشْهَدَانِ عَلَى شَهَادَةٍ: أَنَّهَا تَجُوزُ "، وَقَالَ: كَانَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ لَا يَسْتَحْلِفُ مَعَ الْبَيِّنَةِ، وَلَا يَرُدُّ الْيَمِينَ وَإِنَّ حَمَّادًا كَانَ لَا يَفْعَلُ شَيْئًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim that he said
entries.matn_en: regarding a child who later comes of age, an enslaved person who is later emancipated, and a Jew or Christian who later accepts Islam and then testifies regarding a prior testimony: “Their testimony is admissible.” He also said that Abu Hanifah did not require an oath when evidence had been presented and would not refer the oath back to the claimant; Hammad did none of these things.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْكَافِرِ إِذَا ضُرِبَ حَدًّا وَهُوَ كَافِرٌ، ثُمَّ أَسْلَمَ، قَالَ «يَهْدِمُ الْإِسْلَامُ مَا كَانَ مِنْهُ فِي الشِّرْكِ وَتَجُوزُ شَهَادَتُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding the disbeliever who is punished with a legal penalty while still a disbeliever, then later accepts Islam: "Islam erases what came before it during disbelief, and his testimony becomes valid."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «مُسْلِمٍ ضُرِبَ حَدًّا فِي قَذْفٍ وَارْتَدَّ عَنِ الْإِسْلَامِ ثُمَّ أَسْلَمَ أَنَّ شَهَادَتَهُ لَا تَجُوزُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a Muslim who was subjected to the prescribed punishment for slander, then apostatized from Islam, and then reverted to Islam: "His testimony is not permissible."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا تَجُوزُ شَهَادَةٌ عَلَى شَهَادَةٍ فِي الْحُدُودِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “A witness’s report of another person’s testimony is not admissible in cases involving fixed punishments (hudud).”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَضْرِبُ الرَّجُلَ فَيَمُوتُ، فَشَهِدَ الشُّهُودُ أَنَّهُ ضَرَبَهُ وَهُوَ صَحِيحٌ، قَالَ «إِذَا شَهِدُوا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَزَلْ صَاحِبُ فِرَاشٍ حَتَّى مَاتَ أُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who strikes another man and he dies, and witnesses testify that he struck him while he was healthy. He said If they testify that he remained bedridden until he died, the legal punishment is enforced upon him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 162
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمَحْدُودِ فِي قَذْفٍ: " إِذَا تَابَ ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ اسْمُ الْفُسُوقِ، وَلَا تَجُوزُ شَهَادَتُهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ {وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذَلِكَ} [النور: 5] فَإِذَا تَابَ ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ اسْمُ الْفُسُوقِ وَلَا تَجُوزُ شَهَادَتُهُ أَبَدًا "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the one punished for slander: "If he repents, the label of wickedness is removed from him, but his testimony is never accepted. God says: And do not accept their testimony ever, and those are the defiantly disobedient, except those who repent thereafter. So if he repents, the label of wickedness is removed from him, but his testimony is never accepted."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 163
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ قُطِعَ فِي سَرِقَةٍ، ثُمَّ تَابَ فَحَسُنَتْ تَوْبَتُهُ، ثُمَّ شَهِدَ عِنْدَ شُرَيْحٍ بِشَهَادَةٍ، فَقَالَ أَتُجِيزُ شَهَادَتِي؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ، وَأَرَاكَ لِذَلِكَ أَهْلًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Amir from Shurayh
entries.matn_en: that a man from Banu Asad had his hand amputated for theft, then repented sincerely. Later he gave testimony before Shurayh and asked, “Will you accept my testimony?” Shurayh replied, “Yes, and I consider you qualified to give it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 163
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «أُجِيزُ شَهَادَةَ الْمَحْدُودِ فِي قَذْفٍ إِذَا تَابَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Amir
entries.matn_en: that he said "The testimony of one who has been punished for slander is accepted if he repents."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 163
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «إِذَا وَهَبَ الرَّجُلُ لِذِي رَحِمٍ هِبَةً فَلَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ فِيهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “If a man gives a gift to a blood relative, he may not take it back.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 163
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُجِيزُ الصَّدَقَةَ إِلَّا صَدَقَةً مَقْبُوضَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Shurayh
entries.matn_en: that he would not validate a charitable gift unless possession of it had been transferred to the recipient.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 163
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا نُجِيزُ الصَّدَقَةَ إِلَّا صَدَقَةً مَقْبُوضَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “We do not consider a charitable gift valid until possession of it has been transferred to the recipient.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 163
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْهِبَةِ وَالصَّدَقَةِ: «لَا تَجُوزُ إِلَّا مَقْبُوضَةً مَعْلُومَةً» وَقَالَ: لَا أَدْرِي، كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَا يُجِيزُ حَتَّى يُعَايِنَ الشُّهُودُ الْقَبْضَ أَمْ لَا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding gifts and charitable donations: “They are valid only when the property is specified and possession has been transferred.” He added: “I do not know whether Ibrahim required the witnesses to see the transfer of possession before validating it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 164
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «الرَّجُلِ يَهَبُ لِامْرَأَتِهِ أَوْ لِبَعْضِ وَلَدِهِ، وَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ وَهُوَ فِي عِيَالِهِ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ جَائِزٌ إِذَا كَانَ قَدْ عَلِمَ بِهِ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْبِضْ ذَلِكَ الْمَوْهُوبُ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who gives a gift to his wife or to one of his adult children who remains dependent on him: “The gift is valid if the intended recipient knows of it, even if the recipient has not yet taken possession.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 164
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنِ الْمُسْتَوْرِدِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّ عَمِّي زَوَّجَنِي أَمَتَهُ، فَوَلَدَتْ مِنِّي وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَبِيعَ وَلَدَهَا، قَالَ: «لَيْسَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Salamah b. Kuhayl from al-Mustawrid from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that a man came to him and said My uncle married me to his slave woman, and she bore me a child while he intends to sell her child. He said: He has no right to do that.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 164
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ مَلَكَ ذَا رَحِمٍ مِنْ نَسَبٍ فَهُوَ حُرٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Umar, ؓ, said: “Whoever owns a blood relative, that relative is automatically free.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 164
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنِ اشْتَرَى ذَا رَحِمٍ مَحْرَمٍ فَهُوَ حُرٌّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said Whoever buys a relative within the prohibited degree, that relative is free.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 164
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا أَعْتَقَ الرَّجُلُ نِصْفَ عَبْدِهِ اسْتَسْعَاهُ فِيمَا لَمْ يُعْتِقْ، وَإِذَا كَانَ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ فَأَعْتَقَ أَحَدَهُمَا وَهُوَ مُعْسِرٌ سَعَى الْعَبْدُ لِآخَرَ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُوسِرًا فَالْآخَرُ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ ضَمِنَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ اسْتَسْعَى»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said: “If a man emancipates half of his slave, the slave must work toward the value of the portion that was not emancipated. If two people own a slave and one emancipates his share while insolvent, the slave must work to satisfy the other owner’s share. If the emancipating owner is solvent, the other owner may choose either to claim compensation from him or to require the slave to work for him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 165
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادٍ، أَوْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَعْتَقَ عَبْدًا وَلِإِخْوَةٍ لَهُ صِغَارٍ فِيهِ نَصِيبٌ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِعُمَرَ رضي الله عنه «فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُقَوِّمَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَأْنِي بِهِمْ أَنْ يُدْرِكُوا، فَإِنْ شَاءُوا أَعْتَقُوا وَإِنْ شَاءُوا أَخَذُوا الْقِيمَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ziyad or Yazid, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad
entries.matn_en: that he manumitted a slave in whom his young brothers had a share. He mentioned this to Umar, ؓ, who ordered him to appraise the slave and then wait for them to reach maturity. If they wished, they could manumit him, and if they wished, they could take the value.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 165
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي " الْعَبْدِ يَكُونُ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ فَيَعْتِقُ أَحَدُهُمَا، قَالَ: يُقَالُ لِلْآخَرِ أَتَعْتِقُ أَوْ تَضْمَنُ، فَإِنْ أَعْتَقَ فَالْوَلَاءُ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَإِنْ ضَمِنَ فَالْوَلَاءُ لِلَّذِي أَعْتَقَ وَإِنِ اسْتَسْعَى الْعَبْدُ فَالْوَلَاءُ بَيْنَهُمَا "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding a slave jointly owned by two men, when one emancipates his share: “The other is asked, ‘Will you emancipate your share or guarantee its value?’ If he emancipates it, the wala' (manumission-based clientage) is shared between them. If he pays the other’s share, the wala' belongs to the one who emancipated the slave. If the slave works to pay for the unfreed share, the wala' is shared between them.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 165
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ أَعْتَقَ مِنْ غُلَامِهِ شَيْئًا عَتَقَ مَا أَعْتَقَ وَسَعَى فِيمَا بَقَى»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said Whoever manumits a portion of his slave, that portion is freed, and the slave must work to pay for the remainder.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 165
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَسْتَحِبُّ لِلَّذِي يَرُدُّ الْآبِقَ أَنْ يَرْضَخَ لَهُ كَيْ يَرُدَّ بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he used to recommend giving a small reward to someone who returns a runaway slave, so that people would return one another’s runaways.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 165
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ : بَلَغَنِي عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه حَدِيثًا غَيْرَ حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْآبِقِ: " يُصَابُ خَارِجًا مِنَ الْمِصْرِ: جُعْلُهُ أَرْبَعُونَ دِرْهَمًا "
entries.matn_en: Abu Hanifah said It reached me from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, a hadith different from the hadith of Sa'id, that he said regarding the runaway slave: "If he is found outside the city, his reward is forty dirhams."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 166
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمَرْزُبَانِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه، فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: رَجُلٌ قَدِمَ بِآبِقٍ مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ، فَقَالَ الْقَوْمُ: لَقَدْ أَصَابَ أَجْرًا، فَقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه: «وَجُعْلًا إِنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْ كُلِّ رَأْسٍ أَرْبَعِينَ دِرْهَمًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Sa‘id ibn al-Marzuban, from Abu ‘Amr al-Shaybani,
entries.matn_en: who said I was sitting with Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, when a man came to him and said, "A man has arrived with a runaway slave from Bahrain." The people said, "He has earned a reward." Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, said, "And a payment, if he wishes, of forty dirhams for each slave."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 166
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: بِنَحْو مِنْ هَذَا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Sa‘id,
entries.matn_en: similarly to this.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 166
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " نَسَخَتْ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى {وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ} [الطلاق: 2] شَهَادَةَ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ فِي السَّفَرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said "The saying of God the Exalted, 'And take witnesses, two just men from among you' (At-Talaq: 2) abrogated the testimony of the People of the Book during travel."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 167
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ بِلَالٍ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَشَتِ الْعُمْرَى عَلَى عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، احْبِسُوا عَلَيْكُمْ أَمْوَالَكُمْ وَلَا تُهْلِكُوهَا، فَإِنَّ مَنْ أَعْمَرَ شَيْئًا فِي حَيَاتِهِ فَهُوَ لَهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Bilal, from Wahb b. Kaysan, from Jabir b. Abd Allah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “The practice of 'umra (a lifetime grant) became widespread during the Prophet’s time. The Prophet said, ‘People, hold on to your property and do not squander it. Whoever grants something as 'umra during his lifetime retains it after his death.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 167
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ شَهِدْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما وَسَأَلَهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ عَنِ الْعُمْرَى فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهَا «مِيرَاثٌ لِلَّذِي يُعْطِيهَا، وَهُوَ للَّذِي يَكُونُ فِي يَدَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Habib b. Abi Thabit,
entries.matn_en: who said that he had witnessed Ibn Umar, ؓ, when a Bedouin asked him about 'umra (a lifetime grant). Ibn Umar replied: “It is inherited by the person who grants it, but it belongs to the person who has it in his possession.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 167
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الشُّفْعَةُ بِالْأَبْوَابِ، أَقْرَبُ الْأَبْوَابِ إِلَيْهَا أَحَقُّ بِالشُّفْعَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Shurayh,
entries.matn_en: who said: “The right of pre-emption is determined by the entrances; the entrance nearest to the property has the strongest claim to pre-emption.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 167
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ رضي الله عنهما عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: سَاوَمَهُ سَعْدٌ بِبَيْتٍ، فَقَالَ سَعْدٌ: خُذْ هَذَا الْبَيْتَ بِأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ، أَمَا إِنِّي قَدْ أُعْطِيتُ بِهِ ثَمَانِمِائَةٍ، وَلَكِنِّي أُعْطِيكَهُ لِحَدِيثٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «الْجَارُ أَحَقُّ بِسَقَبِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abd al-Karim, from al-Miswar b. Makhramah, ؓ, from Abu Rafi’, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who reported: Sa'd negotiated with him over a house. Sa'd said, “Take this house for four hundred. I have been offered eight hundred for it, but I am giving it to you because of a report I heard from the Messenger of God, ﷺ: ‘A neighbor has the stronger claim to his adjoining property.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 167
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي اللُّقَطَةِ: " عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلًا، فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا وَإِلَّا فَتَصَدَّقْ بِهَا، وَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَمْسَكْتَ، فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ: إِنْ شَاءَ ضَمِنَكَ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ اخْتَارَ الْأَجْرَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Ishaq, from Asim, from Ali b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding lost property: “Announce it for a year. If its owner comes, [give it to him]; otherwise, give it in charity. If you wish, you may keep it. If its owner later comes, he has the choice: he may hold you liable, or he may choose the reward [of the charity].”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 168
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ثنا. . . . ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: «أَلَكَ بُدٌّ مِنْ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ، إِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَتَلْبَسُ ثَوْبَكَ وَتَحْنَثُ، فَالْبَسْ ثِيَابَكَ وَصَلِّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَكَفِّرْ يَمِينَكَ، فَإِنَّمَا أَرَادَ الشَّيْطَانُ أَنْ يَلْعَبَ بِكَ» قَالَ: فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما فَقَالَ: ابْنُ عُمَرَ: وَمَنْ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى مُخَبَّيَاتِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا
entries.matn_en: …That was mentioned, and Ibn Abbas said to him: “Must you pray when the prayer time comes, put on your clothes, and break your oath? Then put on your clothes, pray in the Sacred Mosque, and expiate your oath. Satan only wanted to toy with you.” He said: “I mentioned that to Ibn Umar, ؓ, and Ibn Umar said: ‘Who can match Ibn Abbas’s hidden insights, ؓ?’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 168
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " فِي كَفَّارَةِ الْيَمِينِ إِطْعَامُ عَشْرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ أَوِ الْكِسْوَةُ لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ ثَوْبٌ ثَوْبٌ، أَوِ الطَّعَامُ لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ نِصْفُ صَاعٍ مِنْ بُرٍّ أَوْ دَقِيقٍ، أَوْ صَاعٍ مِنْ تَمْرِ، أَوْ يُغَدِّيهِمْ وَيُعَشِّيهِمْ، أَوْ تَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ، فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مُتَتَابِعَاتٍ، وَهُوَ فِيهِ بِالْخِيَارِ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ: أَوْ أَوْ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “The expiation for an oath is to feed ten poor people, clothe them (one garment for each), or give each person half a sa' of wheat or flour, or one sa' of dates; or to provide them with lunch and dinner; or to free a slave. Whoever cannot do so must fast three consecutive days. He may choose among these alternatives, for God says: ‘or … or …’”

sections.title_en: In the obligations (inheritance laws).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 168
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «عَصَبَةُ ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ عَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ، وَهُمْ يَعْقِلُونَ عَنْهُ وَيَرِثُونَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “The agnatic kin of a child born of li'an are his mother’s agnatic kin; they bear his blood-wit and inherit from him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 169
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوَالِي الْقَوْمَ أَنَّهُمْ يَرِثُونَهُ وَيَعْقِلُونَ عَنْهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ تَحَوَّلَ عَنْهُمْ إِلَى غَيْرِهِمْ مَا لَمْ يَعْقِلُوا عَنْهُ، فَإِذَا عَقَلُوا عَنْهُ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَتَحَوَّلَ إِلَى غَيْرِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said regarding a man who affiliates himself with a people: “They inherit from him and pay his blood-wit. If he wishes, he may transfer his affiliation to others so long as they have not paid his blood-wit. Once they have paid it for him, he may no longer transfer his affiliation to others.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 169
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَعْتَقَ عَبْدًا لَهُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: «مَالُكَ لِي وَلَكِنْ سَأَدَعُهُ لَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Imran b. Umayr, from his father, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who freed a slave of his. He said to him: “Your property is mine, but I will leave it to you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 169
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادِ بْنِ الْهَادِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَةً لِحَمْزَةَ رضي الله عنهما أَعْتَقَتْ مَمْلُوكًا لَهَا، فَمَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَةً ، فَأَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ابْنَتَهُ النِّصْفَ، وَابْنَةَ حَمْزَةَ النِّصْفَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Hakam, from Abdullah b. Shaddad b. al-Had,
entries.matn_en: who reported that Hamzah’s daughter, ؓ, freed a slave of hers. The slave died leaving a daughter, and the Messenger of God, ﷺ, allotted half to the slave’s daughter and half to Hamzah’s daughter.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 170
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، وَالزُّبَيْرَ بْنَ الْعَوَّامِ رضي الله عنهما اخْتَصَمَا إِلَى عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه فِي مَوْلًى لِصَفِيَّةَ رضي الله عنها، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ: أَنَا عَصَبَةُ عَمَّتِي، وَأَنَا أَعْقِلُ عَنْ مَوْلَاهَا وَأَرِثُهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ: أُمِّي، وَأَنَا أَرِثُ مَوْلَاهَا، «فَقَضَى عُمَرُ لِلزُّبَيْرِ بِالْمِيرَاثِ، وَقَضَى بِالْعَقْلِ عَلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “Ali b. Abi Talib and al-Zubayr b. al-Awwam, ؓ, disputed before Umar, ؓ, over a freedman of Safiyyah, ؓ. Ali said, ‘I am my aunt’s agnatic heir; I bear liability for her freedman’s blood-wit and inherit from him.’ Al-Zubayr said, ‘She is my mother, and I inherit from her freedman.’ Umar awarded the inheritance to al-Zubayr and charged Ali b. Abi Talib with the blood-wit.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 170
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأُرْدُنِّ وَالَى ابْنَ عَمٍّ لَهُ، وَأَسْلَمَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ، فَمَاتَ وَتَرَكَ مَالًا، فَسَأَلَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه عَنْ ذَلِكَ «فَأَمَرَهُ بِأَكْلِ مِيرَاثِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Muhammad b. Qays from Masruq
entries.matn_en: a man from the people of al-Urdunn affiliated himself with a cousin, and the cousin became Muslim at his hand. The man died leaving property, so [the cousin] asked Ibn Masud, ؓ, about it. Ibn Masud instructed him to take his inheritance.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 170
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، سَأَلَ حُذَيْفَةَ رضي الله عنه عَنْ فَرِيضَةٍ، فَقَالَ «مَا لِي بِهَا عِلْمٌ» ، قَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ: أُجِيبُهُ، قَالَ: «وَتَعْلَمُهَا؟» قَالَ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: قَالَ «فَأَجِبْهُ» ، قَالَ: فَأَجَابَهُ عَلْقَمَةُ فَقَالَ لَهُ حُذَيْفَةُ: «مِنْ أَيْنَ عَلِمْتَهَا» ، قَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ: مِنْ قِبَلِ صَاحِبِنَا، يَعْنِي: عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ «أَوَ يُعَلِّمُكُمْ هَذَا؟» قَالَ: نَعَمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah
entries.matn_en: that a man asked Hudhayfah, ؓ, about an obligatory duty, so he said "I have no knowledge of it." Alqamah said: "Shall I answer him?" He said: "And do you know it?" He said: "Yes." He said: "Then answer him." So Alqamah answered him, and Hudhayfah said to him: "From where did you know it?" Alqamah said: "From our companion," meaning Abdullah b. Mas'ud, ؓ. Hudhayfah said: "Does he teach you this?" He said: "Yes."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 170
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَافَحَتْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَوَلَدَتْ غُلَامًا، فَاشْتَرَى أَخُو الْمَرْأَةِ غُلَامًا فَأَعْتَقَهُ، فَمَاتَ وَتَرَكَ سِتَّةَ ذَوْدٍ، فَرُفِعَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَأَمَرَ بِهَا إِلَى إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ، فَخَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَأَخْبَرَهُ، فَدَخَلَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه عَلَى عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ «إِنْ لَمْ تُوَرِّثْهُ مِنْ قِبَلِ النَّسَبِ فَوَرِّثْهُ مِنْ قِبَلِ النِّعْمَةِ» ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: وَتَرَى ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ: «نَعَمْ» ، قَالَ: وَأَنَا أَرَاهُ، فَوَرَّثَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: a woman had illicit intercourse in pre-Islamic times and gave birth to a boy. Her brother bought a slave and emancipated him. The freedman died leaving six camels. The case was brought before Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, and he ordered the camels transferred to the charity camels. The man went to Ibn Masud and told him what happened. Ibn Masud went to Umar and said: “If you will not let him inherit by blood relationship, then let him inherit by the benefit of emancipation.” Umar asked, “Do you hold that view?” He said, “Yes.” Umar said, “I hold it too,” and awarded him the inheritance.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 170
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه تَأَوَّلَ فِي الْخَالَةِ وَالْعَمَّةِ {وَأُولُو الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ} [الأحزاب: 6] فَقَالَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ رضي الله عنهما: " إِنَّمَا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ فِي {الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا مَا لَكُمْ مِنْ وَلَايَتِهِمْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ} [الأنفال: 72] ، وَكَانَ الْأَعْرَابِيُّ لَا يَرِثُ الْمُهَاجِرَ، ثُمَّ نَسَخَتْهَا بَعْدُ: {وَأُولُو الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ} [الأحزاب: 6] فَكَانَ الْأَعْرَابِيُّ يَرِثُ الْمُهَاجِرَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him, from Ibn al-Zubayr,
entries.matn_en: that it reached him that Ibn Mas‘ud interpreted the verse regarding the maternal aunt and paternal aunt: "But kindred by blood are nearer to one another in the decree of God." Ibn al-Zubayr said "This verse was only revealed concerning: 'As for those who believed but did not emigrate, you owe them no duty of protection until they emigrate.' The Bedouin would not inherit from the Emigrant. Then it was later abrogated by: 'But kindred by blood are nearer to one another in the decree of God.' So the Bedouin would inherit from the Emigrant."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 171
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنِ الْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ أَبِي حُمَيْصَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «بَعَثَهُ عَلَى بَعْضِ الشَّامِ عَلَى حِمْصَ أَوْ غَيْرِهَا، فَقَسَمَ لِلْفَارِسِ سَهْمَيْنِ، وَلِلرَّاجِلِ سَهْمًا، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ عُمَرَ فَرَضِيَ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Zakariyya b. al-Harith, from someone who narrated to him, from al-Mundhir b. Abi Humaysah,
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, sent him to some part of Syria—either Homs or elsewhere—and he allocated two shares for the horseman and one share for the foot soldier. When this reached Umar, he approved of it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 171
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْكُفْرُ كُلُّهُمْ مِلَّةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ، لَا نَرِثُهُمْ وَلَا يَرِثُونَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr from Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "All disbelief is one religion; we do not inherit from them, nor do they inherit from us."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 171
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مَاتَتْ، وَتَرَكَتْ مَوَالِيَ لَهَا، وَتَرَكَتْ أَبَاهَا وَابْنَهَا، ثُمَّ مَاتَ الْمَوْلَى، فَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: «لِأَبِيهَا السُّدُسُ، وَمَا بَقِيَ فَهُوَ لِابْنِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that a woman died, leaving behind her freed slaves, her father, and her son. Then the freed slave died, so Ibrahim said "Her father receives one-sixth, and whatever remains is for her son."

sections.title_en: In the chapter on bequests.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 172
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه يَعُودُهُ، فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، أُوصِي بِثُلُثَيْ مَالِي قَالَ: «لَا» قَالَ: فَبِنِصْفِهِ، قَالَ: «لَا» قَالَ: فَبِثُلُثِهِ، قَالَ: «الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ، إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَدَعْ أَهْلَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَدَعَهُمْ فُقَرَاءَ يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ata b. al-Sa’ib, from his father,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, visited Sa’d b. Malik to check on him. Sa’d said O Messenger of God, shall I bequeath two-thirds of my wealth? He said: No. Sa’d said: Then half of it? He said: No. Sa’d said: Then one-third of it? He said: One-third, and one-third is much. It is better for you to leave your family wealthy than to leave them poor, begging from people.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 172
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَيْسَ لِلْمَيِّتِ مِنْ مَالِهِ إِلَّا الثُّلُثُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said The deceased has no claim on his wealth except a third.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 172
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَا مَعْشَرَ هَمْدَانَ إِنَّكُمْ أَحْرَى حَيٍّ أَنْ يَمُوتَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلَا يَتْرُكُ وَارِثًا فَلْيَضَعْ مَالَهُ حَيْثُ أَحَبَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from Amir, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "O people of Hamdan, you are the most likely of people that one of you may die without leaving an heir, so let him place his wealth where he wishes."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 172
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَا أَوْصَى الْمَيِّتُ بِهِ مِنْ رَقَبَةٍ عَلَيْهِ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نَذْرٍ فَهُوَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said Whatever the deceased bequeaths of a slave to be freed, charity, or a vow is to be taken from the third (of the estate).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 173
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يُبْدَأُ بِالْعِتْقِ فِي الْوَصِيَّةِ، فَإِنْ كَانَ فَضْلٌ كَانَ لِلْمُوصَى لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said Manumission is given priority in a bequest; if there is any surplus, it goes to the legatee.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 173
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا أَوْصَى بِالثُّلُثِ وَأَعْتَقَ بُدِئَ بِالْعِتْقِ فِي الْوَصِيَّةِ، وَإِذَا أَوْصَى بِالثُّلُثِ وَدَرَاهِمَ مُسَمَّاةٍ بِعَيْنِهَا أَوْ بِغَيْرِ عَيْنِهَا بُدِئَ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ قَبْلَ الثُّلُثِ، وَإِذَا أَعْتَقَهُ فِي صِحَّتِهِ كَانَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ مَالِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “If someone bequeaths one-third of his estate and also emancipates a slave, the emancipation is given priority within the bequest. If he bequeaths one-third and a specified sum in dirhams, whether or not particular coins are designated, the dirhams are given priority over the one-third. If he emancipates a slave while in good health, it is charged against his entire estate.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 173
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَأْكُلُ الْوَصِيُّ مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ قَرْضًا عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr
entries.matn_en: who said: “The guardian may take a loan from the orphan’s property, which is owed by the guardian.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 173
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَنْظُرُ الْوَصِيُّ لِلْيَتِيمِ، فَإِنْ رَأَى أَنْ يُبْضِعَ مَالَهُ أَوْ يُعْطِيَهُ مُضَارَبَةً، أَوْ يَشْتَرِيَ هُوَ لِلْيَتِيمِ وَيَبِيعَ أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُ هُوَ مُضَارَبَةً، فَعَلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said The guardian of the orphan should consider; if he sees fit to invest the orphan’s wealth, give it as a profit-sharing venture, buy and sell on behalf of the orphan, or take it himself as a profit-sharing venture, he may do so.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 174
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ «كَانُوا يَضَعُونَ طَعَامَ الْيَتِيمِ عَلَى الْإِخْوَانِ عَلَى حِدَةٍ» ، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ " مَا كُنْتُ لِأَدَعَهُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْوَحْشَى حَتَّى أَخْلِطَ طَعَامِي بِطَعَامِهِ وَلَبَنِي بِلَبَنِهِ وَعَلَفَ دَابَّتِي بِعَلَفِ دَابَّتِهِ، ثُمَّ قَرَأْتُ {وَإِنْ تُخَالِطُوهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ} [البقرة: 220] "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Amir from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “They used to set aside the orphan’s food separately from his siblings’ food.” Aisha said: “I would not keep him apart like a wild animal; I would mix my food with his, my milk with his, and my animal’s fodder with his animal’s fodder.” Then she recited: “If you mix with them, then they are your brothers.”

sections.title_en: On fasting.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 174
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْأَعْوَرِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «خَرَجَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فِي رَمَضَانَ، فَشَكَا إِلَيْهِ النَّاسُ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ الْجَهْدَ، فَأَفْطَرَ حَتَّى أَتَى مَكَّةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Muslim al-A‘war from Anas b. Malik, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, set out from Medina to Mecca during Ramadan. Along the way, the people complained to him of hardship, so he broke his fast until he reached Mecca.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 174
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ خَلَتَا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، فَسَارَ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى قُدَيْدٍ، ثُمَّ شَكَا النَّاسُ إِلَيْهِ الْجَهْدَ، فَأَفْطَرَ بِقُدَيْدٍ، ثُمَّ لَمْ يَزَلْ مُفْطِرًا حَتَّى أَتَى مَكَّةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from Anas b. Malik, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said The Messenger of God, ﷺ, departed from Medina to Mecca when two nights of Ramadan had passed. He traveled until he reached Qudayd, then the people complained to him of exhaustion, so he broke his fast at Qudayd. He continued breaking his fast until he reached Mecca.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 174
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَظَلُّ صَائِمًا فِي رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ يَبِيتُ طَاوِيًا قَائِمًا، حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ السَّحَرُ شَرِبَ شَرْبَةَ لَبَنٍ فَكَانَتْ إِفْطَارَهُ وَسَحُورَهُ، وَإِنَّ رَجُلًا بَاتَ لَيْلَةً عِنْدُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَطَلَبُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا فِي بُيُوتِ أَزْوَاجِهِ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا شَيْئًا، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَطْعَمَ اللَّهُ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي» ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ، ثُمَّ نَظَرُوا إِلَى الْعَنْزِ فَإِذَا هِيَ حَافِلٌ، فَحَلَبَ مِنْهَا مِثْلَ مَا كَانَ يَشْرَبُ فَشَرِبَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ali b. al-Aqmar
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, would keep fasting during Ramadan and then spend the night hungry, standing [in prayer], until just before dawn, when he drank some milk; that served as both his breaking of the fast and his pre-dawn meal. A man spent a night with the Prophet, ﷺ. They searched for something for him in his wives’ homes but found nothing. The Prophet said three times, “May God feed whoever fed me.” Then they saw that the she-goat was full of milk. He milked it, producing about as much as he usually drank, and the Prophet drank.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 175
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَدْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْمًا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَتَقْدِرُ عَلَى تَحْرِيرِ رَقَبَةٍ؟» قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «أَتَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَصُومَ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ؟» قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «أَتَقْدِرُ أَنْ تُطْعِمَ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا؟» قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: فَأَعَانَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِكْتَلٍ فِيهِ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ صَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: «تَصَدَّقْ بِهَا» فَقَالَ: مَا بَيْنَ لَابَتَيْهَا أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ أَحْوَجُ مِنِّي وَمِنْ عِيَالِي، قَالَ: «فَكُلْ وَأَطْعِمْ عِيَالَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ata b. Abi Rabah, from Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyib,
entries.matn_en: that a man came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and said "I broke my fast on a day in Ramadan." The Prophet, ﷺ, said to him: "Can you afford to free a slave?" He said: "No." He said: "Can you fast two consecutive months?" He said: "No." He said: "Can you afford to feed sixty poor people?" He said: "No." Then the Prophet, ﷺ, helped him with a basket containing fifteen sa‘ of dates and said to him: "Give this in charity." The man said: "There is no household between the two lava fields more in need than me and my dependents." He said: "Then eat it and feed your dependents."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 175
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يَصُومُ أَحَدٌ عَنْ أَحَدٍ، وَلَا يُصَلِّي أَحَدٌ عَنْ أَحَدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said No one fasts on behalf of another, nor does anyone pray on behalf of another.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 176
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ يَكُونُ عَلَيْهَا صَوْمُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ فَتَحِيضُ: «أَنَّهَا تَسْتَقْبِلُ الصَّوْمَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a woman who must fast two consecutive months but then menstruates: "She must restart the fast."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 176
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، وَالْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي ذَلِكَ: «تَبْنِي عَلَى ذَلِكَ وَتَقْضِي أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad and al-Haytham from Amir
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding that: "You may build upon that and make up the days of her menstruation."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 176
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الَّذِي يُدْرِكُهُ رَمَضَانُ وَعَلَيْهِ رَمَضَانُ آخَرُ: «يَصُومُ الَّذِي دَخَلَ ثُمَّ يَقْضِي الَّذِي كَانَ عَلَيْهِ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said regarding a person whom the next Ramadan finds still owing a previous Ramadan: “He should fast the Ramadan that has begun, then make up the one he owed; nothing further is due from him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 176
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ صَوْمَ الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي كَانَ يُشَكُّ فِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he used to disapprove of fasting on the day about which there was doubt.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 176
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «عَاشُورَاءُ يَوْمُ التَّاسِعِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from al-Haytham from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "Ashura is the ninth day."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 176
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَوْمُ الْعَاشِرِ مِنَ الْمُحَرَّمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said "The tenth day of Muharram."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 176
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ: «مُرْ قَوْمَكَ فَلْيَصُومُوا هَذَا الْيَوْمَ» قَالَ: إِنَّهُمْ قَدْ طَعِمُوا، قَالَ: «وَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ طَعِمُوا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ibrahim b. Muhammad b. al-Muntashir from his father from Humayd b. Abd al-Rahman al-Himyari
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said to one of his companions on the day of Ashura: "Instruct your people to fast this day." The man said, "They have already eaten." He said, "Even if they have eaten."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 177
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «صَوْمُ يَوْمِ عَاشُورَاءَ يَعْدِلُ صَوْمَ سَنَةٍ، وَصَوْمُ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ يَعْدِلُ صَوْمَ سَنَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Sa‘id ibn Jubayr,
entries.matn_en: who said "Fasting the day of ‘Ashura’ is equivalent to fasting a year, and fasting the day of ‘Arafah is equivalent to fasting two years."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 177
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُقَبِّلُ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ziyad b. 'Ilaqah from 'Amr b. Maymun from 'Aishah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, used to kiss while fasting.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 177
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُصِيبُ مِنْ وَجْهِهَا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from Amir, from Masruq, from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, would kiss her face while fasting.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 178
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَطُوفِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا «كَانَا يَحْتَجِمَانِ وَهُمَا صَائِمَانِ وَيَعْزِلَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu al-Atuf from al-Zuhri from Sa'd b. Malik and Zayd b. Thabit, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that they would practice cupping while fasting and practice coitus interruptus.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 178
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَوَّارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَاضِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ مُحْرِمٌ بِالْقَاحَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Sawwar from Abu Hadir from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, was cupped while he was fasting and in a state of ihram at Al-Qaha.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 178
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ فُرَاتِ بْنِ أَبِي فُرَاتٍ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ رضي الله عنها «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا احْتَجَمَتْ وَهِيَ صَائِمَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Furat b. Abi Furat from Qays, the freed slave of Umm Salamah, from Umm Salamah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she was cupped while fasting.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 178
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ أَبِي الصَّبَّاحِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " فِي هَؤُلَاءِ أُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ {وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ} [البقرة: 184] " قَالَ: «الشَّيْخُ الْكَبِيرُ يُطْعِمُ وَلَا يَصُومُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Musa b. Abi Kathir Abu al-Sabbah from Mujahid
entries.matn_en: that he said "This verse was revealed concerning these people: And upon those who are able to fast [but with hardship] – a ransom [as substitute] of feeding a poor person." He said: "The elderly man feeds [the poor] and does not fast."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 178
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَمَّنْ، حَدَّثَ أَبَا يُوسُفَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا جَمِيعًا: «قَضَاءُ رَمَضَانَ مُتَتَابِعًا أَحَبُّ إِلَيْنَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, and from someone who narrated to Abu Yusuf, from Amir,
entries.matn_en: that they both said "Making up the fasts of Ramadan consecutively is more beloved to us."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي قَضَاءِ رَمَضَانَ: «فَرِّقْ إِنْ شِئْتَ» وَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ: «مُتَتَابِعًا أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Sa'id ibn Jubayr
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding making up Ramadan: "Separate them if you wish." And Ibrahim said: "Consecutively is more beloved to me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الصَّائِمِ يَسْتَاكُ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ رَطْبًا كَانَ أَوْ يَابِسًا، وَلَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَسْتَاكَ بِالْمَاءِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the fasting person who uses the tooth-stick: "There is no harm in it, whether it is moist or dry, and there is no harm in using water to clean the teeth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الشَّيْخِ الْكَبِيرِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَصُومَ: «يُطْعِمُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ نِصْفَ صَاعٍ مِنْ حِنْطَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the elderly person who is unable to fast: "He feeds for each day half a sa' of wheat."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْحَامِلِ وَالْمُرْضِعِ: «إِذَا خَافَتَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمَا وَأَوْلَادِهِمَا أَفْطَرَتَا وَقَضَتَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the pregnant and the nursing woman: "If they fear for themselves and their children, they may break their fast and make it up later."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الصَّائِمِ يُدْرِكُهُ الْقَيْءُ: «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ، يُتِمُّ صَوْمَهُ، وَإِذَا اسْتَقَاءَ عَمْدًا صَامَ يَوْمَهُ ذَلِكَ وَقَضَى يَوْمًا مَكَانَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the fasting person who is overcome by vomiting: "He is not liable for anything; he completes his fast. But if he induces vomiting intentionally, he fasts that day and makes up another day in its place."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الَّذِي يَأْكُلُ نَاسِيًا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ، قَالَ: «يُتِمُّ صَوْمَهُ وَلَا شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the one who eats forgetfully while fasting: "He completes his fast and there is nothing upon him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ فَقَالَتْ: أَصَائِمٌ أَنْتَ؟ قُلْتُ: لَا، قَالَتْ: يَا جَارِيَةُ خَوِّضِي لَهُ سُوَيْقًا وَأَحْلِيهِ، ثُمَّ قَالَتْ: لَوْمَا أَنِّي صَائِمَةٌ لَذُقْتُهُ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: مَا مَنَعَنِي مِنَ الصَّوْمِ إِلَّا أَنِّي ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ، فَقَالَتْ: «إِنَّمَا يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ يَوْمَ يَنْحَرُ النَّاسُ، وَيَوْمُ الْفِطْرِ يَوْمَ يُفْطِرُونَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ali b. al-Aqmar, from Masruq,
entries.matn_en: who said I entered upon Aisha, ؓ, on the Day of Arafah, and she said, "Are you fasting?" I said, "No." She said, "O servant girl, mix some sawiq for him and sweeten it." Then she said, "If I were not fasting, I would have tasted it." I said, "Nothing prevented me from fasting except that I thought it was the Day of Sacrifice." She said, "The Day of Sacrifice is only the day when the people sacrifice, and the Day of Breaking the Fast is the day when they break their fast."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 179
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا رُئِيَ الْهِلَالُ فِي أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ أَفْطَرَ الْقَوْمُ وَخَرَجُوا يَوْمَئِذٍ، وَإِذَا رُئِيَ بِالْعَشِيِّ أَتَمُّوا صَوْمَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَخَرَجُوا مِنَ الْغَدِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said When the crescent is sighted at the beginning of the day, the people break their fast and go out that day. If it is sighted in the evening, they complete the fast of that day and go out the next day.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 180
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَطُوفِ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ حَلَفَ لَا يَدْخُلُ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ شَهْرًا، فَلَمَّا كَانَ تِسْعَةً وَعِشْرِينَ يَوْمًا أَرْسَلَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، فَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا مَضَى تِسْعَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ يَوْمًا، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ الشَّهْرَ قَدْ يَكُونُ تِسْعَةً وَعِشْرِينَ يَوْمًا وَيَكُونُ ثَلَاثِينَ»
