entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu al-Atuf from al-Zuhri
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, swore not to enter upon his wives for a month. When twenty-nine days had passed, he sent for Aisha, ؓ, and she said , "Only twenty-nine days have passed." He said, "The month may be twenty-nine days or it may be thirty."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 180
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه كَانَ فِي يَوْمِ غَيْمٍ فِي رَمَضَانَ، ظَنَّ أَنَّ الشَّمْسَ قَدْ غَابَتْ فَأَفْطَرَ هُوَ وَأَصْحَابُهُ، فَطَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «مَا تَجَانَفْنَا لِإِثْمٍ، نُتِمُّ صَوْمَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَنَصُومُ يَوْمًا مَكَانَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, was on a cloudy day in Ramadan. He thought the sun had set, so he and his companions broke their fast. Then the sun appeared afterward, so Umar said "We did not deliberately commit a sin. We will complete the fast of this day and fast another day in its place."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 180
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الَّذِي يُفْطِرُ يَوْمًا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّدًا: «يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَيَصُومُ يَوْمًا مَكَانَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the one who breaks his fast on a day of Ramadan intentionally: "He seeks forgiveness from God and fasts a day in its place."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 180
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا تَمَضْمَضَ الصَّائِمُ وَدَخَلَ حَلْقَهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْمَاءِ وَهُوَ ذَاكِرٌ صَوْمَهُ أَتَمَّ صَوْمَهُ وَعَلَيْهِ يَوْمٌ مَكَانَهُ، وَإِنْ دَخَلَ الْمَاءُ حَلْقَهُ وَهُوَ نَاسٍ لِصَوْمِهِ أَتَمَّ صَوْمَهُ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاؤُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said When a fasting person rinses his mouth and some of that water enters his throat while he remembers his fast, he completes his fast and must make up that day. But if the water enters his throat while he has forgotten his fast, he completes his fast and does not have to make it up.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 181
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه كَانَ يُفْتِي أَنَّ مَنْ أَدْرَكَهُ الْفَجْرُ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ فَقَدْ أَفْطَرَ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، فَقَالَتْ «يَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ لَمْ يَحْفَظْ، كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْرُجُ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ وَرَأْسُهُ يَقْطُرُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْجَنَابَةِ ثُمَّ يَصُومُ» ، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه فَقَالَ: هِيَ أَعْلَمُ مِنِّي فَرَجَعَ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Abu Hurayrah, ؓ, used to give the ruling that whoever reached dawn in a state of major ritual impurity had thereby broken the fast. This reached Aisha, ؓ, and she said: “May God have mercy on Abu Hurayrah; he did not retain it correctly. The Messenger of God, ﷺ, would reach dawn with water dripping from his head after washing from janabah, then he would fast.” This reached Abu Hurayrah, ؓ, and he said, “She knows better than I do,” and withdrew his ruling.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 181
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ «فَمَا لِلصَّوْمِ وَمَا لِلْجَنَابَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim b. Muhammad,
entries.matn_en: that it reached him from Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, that he said "What has fasting to do with janabah?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 181
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ قَالَ تَذَاكَرْنَا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «أَتَذْكُرُونَ لَيْلَةَ كُنَّا بِقَاعِ كَذَا وَكَذَا لَيْلَةً، كَانَ الْقَمَرُ كَفَلْقَةِ الصَّحْفَةِ» قَالَ: فَتَذَاكَرْنَا تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ فَلَمْ نُثْبِتْهَا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that it reached him from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, that he said We were discussing the Night of Decree in the presence of the Prophet, ﷺ, and he said, "Do you recall the night when we were at such-and-such a place, and the moon was like a piece of a dish?" He said: So we discussed that night but could not confirm it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 181
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَحْلِفُ أَنَّ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ لَيْلَةُ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ» ، وَيَقُولُ: «إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ صَبِيحَتَهَا لَيْسَ لَهَا شُعَاعٌ، كَأَنَّهَا طَسْتٌ تَرَقْرَقَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Asim b. Abi al-Najud, from Zirr b. Hubaysh, from Ubayy b. Ka'b, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who would swear that the Night of Decree is the twenty-seventh night and say: “The sun rises the following morning without rays, looking like a gleaming basin.”

sections.title_en: On sales and loans.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 181
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَتَّابِ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَهُ أَمِيرًا عَلَى مَكَّةَ، وَقَالَ " إِنِّي أَبْعَثُكَ إِلَى أَهْلِ اللَّهِ، فَانْهَهُمْ عَنْ أَرْبَعِ خِصَالٍ: عَنْ رِبْحِ مَا لَمْ يُضْمَنْ، وَبَيْعِ مَا لَمْ يُقْبَضْ، وَعَنْ شَرْطَيْنِ فِي بَيْعٍ وَسَلَفٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Yahya, from someone who narrated to him from ‘Attab b. Asid, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, appointed him governor of Mecca and said: “I am sending you to the people of the Sacred House. Forbid them from four practices: profiting from what one does not bear liability for, selling what one has not taken possession of, stipulating two conditions in a single sale, and combining a loan with a sale.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 182
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما،
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلًا مُؤَبَّرًا أَوْ عَبْدًا، فَثَمَرُ النَّخْلِ وَمَالُ الْعَبْدِ لِلْبَائِعِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu al-Zubayr from Jabir b. Abd Allah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, said Whoever sells a pollinated palm tree or a slave, the fruit of the palm and the slave’s wealth belong to the seller unless the buyer stipulates otherwise.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 182
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ بَاعَ مِنَ الْأَشْعَثِ رَقِيقًا مِنْ رَقِيقِ الْإِمَارَةِ، فَقَالَ الْأَشْعَثُ: أَخَذْتُهُمْ بِعَشْرَةِ آلَافٍ، وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: بِعِشْرِينَ أَلْفًا، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: اجْعَلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ رَجُلًا، فَقَالَ الْأَشْعَثُ: أَنْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: لَأَقْضِيَنَّ فِيهَا بِقَضَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، قَالَ: «إِذَا اخْتَلَفَا الْمُتَبَايِعَانِ فَالْقَوْلُ قَوْلُ الْبَائِعِ أَوْ يَتَرَادَّانِ الْبَيْعَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Masud, ؓ, sold al-Ashath some slaves from the governorship’s holdings. Al-Ashath said, “I bought them for ten thousand,” while Abdullah said, “For twenty thousand.” Abdullah said, “Let us appoint someone to arbitrate between us.” Al-Ashath replied, “You decide between us.” Abdullah said, “I will judge this according to the Messenger of God’s judgment.” He then quoted: “When the two parties to a sale disagree, the seller’s word is accepted, or they rescind the sale.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 183
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي السِّلْعَةِ يَبِيعُهَا الرَّجُلُ بِنَسِيئَةٍ: «لَا يَشْتَرِيَنَّهَا بِأَقَلَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَتَغَيَّرَ الْمَبِيعُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a commodity a man sells on credit: "He must not buy it back for less than that until the sold item changes."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 183
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ: إِنِّي اشْتَرَيْتُ بِغَايَةِ الْعَشْرَةِ بِسَبْعَةٍ وَنِصْفٍ وَبِسَبْعَةٍ، فَقَالَ: أُتِيَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه بِإِنَاءٍ قَدْ أُحْكِمَتْ صِنَاعَتُهُ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَبِيعَهُ لَهُ فَأَعْطَيْتُ بِهِ وَزْنَهُ وَزِيَادَةً، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: «لَا إِلَّا مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ، وَإِنَّ الْفَضْلَ رِبًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Walid b. Sari from Anas b. Malik, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “I asked him, saying: ‘I bought [it] against ten for seven and a half and seven [the wording and relation between these amounts are unclear in the Arabic].’” He said: “A finely made vessel was brought to Umar, ؓ, and he ordered me to sell it for him. I was offered its weight and something extra. I told him about that, and Umar said: ‘No: only like for like, for any excess is usury.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 183
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ الْعَوْفِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ وَزْنًا بِوَزْنٍ، يَدًا بِيَدٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالْفِضَّةُ بِالْفِضَّةِ وَزْنًا بِوَزْنٍ يَدًا بِيَدٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالْحِنْطَةُ بِالْحِنْطَةِ كَيْلًا بِكَيْلٍ، وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالشَّعِيرُ بِالشَّعِيرِ كَيْلًا بِكَيْلٍ وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ كَيْلًا بِكَيْلٍ وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا، وَالْمِلْحُ بِالْمِلْحِ كَيْلًا بِكَيْلٍ وَالْفَضْلُ رِبًا» وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: ذَكَرْنَا بَيْعَ الْهِرِّ عِنْدَ عَطَاءٍ فَلَمْ يَعِبْهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Atiyyah al-Awfi from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, said Gold for gold, weight for weight, hand to hand, and any excess is usury. Silver for silver, weight for weight, hand to hand, and any excess is usury. Wheat for wheat, measure for measure, and any excess is usury. Barley for barley, measure for measure, and any excess is usury. Dates for dates, measure for measure, and any excess is usury. Salt for salt, measure for measure, and any excess is usury. Abu Hanifah said: We mentioned selling a cat in the presence of Ata’, and he did not disapprove of it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 184
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، رَفَعَهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قِيلَ لَهُ: سَعِّرْ، فَقَالَ «إِنَّ الرُّخْصَ وَالْغَلَاءَ مِنَ اللَّهِ، وَإِنِّي أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَلْقَى اللَّهَ تَعَالَى وَلَا مَظْلَمَةَ لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدِي»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, who raised it to the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that it was said to him: "Fix prices." He said: "Verily, cheapness and high prices are from God, and I would love to meet God the Exalted with no injustice toward anyone from me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 184
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَقْرَضَ رَجُلًا دَرَاهِمَ، فَأَتَاهُ بِدَرَاهِمَ أَجْوَدَ مِنْهَا فَأَعْطَاهَا إِيَّاهُ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَقْبَلَهَا وَقَالَ «ائْتِنَا بِمِثْلِ دَرَاهِمِنَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Masud, ؓ, lent a man some dirhams. The man brought back dirhams of better quality, but Ibn Masud refused to accept them and said: “Bring us dirhams like the ones we lent you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 184
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ الرَّجُلُ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ الدَّرَاهِمَ قَرْضًا عَلَى أَنْ يُوَفِّيَهُ إِيَّاهَا فِي أَرْضٍ أُخْرَى»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he used to disapprove of a man taking dirhams as a loan from another man on the condition that he would repay him in another land.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 184
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مَرْزُوقٍ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ ، عَنْ أَبِي جَبَلَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّا نَقْدُمُ الْأَرْضَ وَمَعَنَا الْوَرِقُ الْخِفَافُ النَّافِقَةُ، وَبِهَا الْوَرِقُ الثِّقَالُ الْكَاسِدَةُ، أَفَنَشْتَرِي وَرِقَهُمْ بِوَرِقِنَا، فَقَالَ: «لَا، وَلَكِنْ بِعْ وَرِقَكَ بِالدَّنَانِيرِ وَاشْتَرِ وَرِقَهُمْ بِالدَّنَانِيرِ وَلَا تُفَارِقْهُ حَتَّى تَقْبِضَ، وَإِنْ صَعِدَ فَوْقَ بَيْتٍ فَاصْعَدْ مَعَهُ وَإِنْ وَثَبَ فَثِبْ مَعَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Marzuq Abu Bukayr, from Abu Jabalah, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he was asked: "We arrive in a land with our light, widely accepted silver coins, while their heavy, sluggish silver coins are there. Should we buy their silver with our silver?" He said "No. Instead, sell your silver for gold dinars, then buy their silver with the dinars. Do not part from him until you take possession. If he ascends to an upper room, ascend with him, and if he jumps, jump with him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 185
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الدَّرَاهِمِ تَكُونُ لِلرَّجُلِ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ فَيَأْخُذُ بِهَا دَنَانِيرَ، أَوْ دَنَانِيرَ فَيَأْخُذُ بِهَا دَرَاهِمَ أَوْ يَأْخُذُ بِذَلِكَ عَرُوضًا يَدًا بِيَدٍ، فَقَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding dirhams a man is owed by another, and he takes dinars in exchange for them, or dinars and he takes dirhams in exchange for them, or he takes goods in exchange for that, hand to hand: "There is no harm in that."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 185
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ الدَّيْنُ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ إِلَى أَجَلٍ فَيُعَجِّلُ لَهُ بَعْضَهَا قَبْلَ الْأَجَلِ وَيَحُطُّ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مَالُهُ تَرَكَهُ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who is owed a debt by another man to be paid at a fixed term, and the creditor accepts part of it before the term and waives the rest: "There is no harm in that. It is his wealth, and he has left it for him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 185
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما أَنَّ لِرَجُلٍ عَلَيَّ أَرْبَعَةَ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ إِلَى أَجَلٍ وَأَنَّهُ قَالَ: عَجِّلْ لِي أَلْفَيْنِ وَأَحُطُّ عَنْكَ أَلْفَيْنِ، قَالَ: فَنَهَانِي ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَنَهَانِي ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَنَهَانِي ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَقَامَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي وَقَالَ: «إِنَّ هَذَا يُرِيدُ أَنْ أُطْعِمَهُ الرِّبَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ziyad b. Maysarah, from his father,
entries.matn_en: who said I asked Ibn Umar, ؓ, about a man to whom I owed four thousand dirhams due at a fixed time, and he said, "Give me two thousand now, and I will cancel the other two thousand." He forbade me. Then I asked him again, and he forbade me. Then I asked him again, and he forbade me. Then I asked him again, so Ibn Umar stood up, took my hand, and said: "This man wants me to feed him usury."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 186
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لِرَجُلٍ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ، فَقَالَ عَجِّلْ لِي وَأَضَعُ عَنْكَ، فَسَأَلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما فَنَهَاهُ، فَقَالَ: إِنَّمَا هُوَ مَالُهُ يَهَبُ لِي مِنْهُ، فَنَهَاهُ فَأَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ وَقَالَ: «إِنَّ هَذَا يُرِيدُ أَنْ أُطْعِمَهُ الرِّبَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from a man of the people of Mecca from his father
entries.matn_en: that a man had a debt owed to another, who said to him, “Pay me sooner and I will reduce what you owe.” He asked Ibn Umar, ؓ, about it, and Ibn Umar forbade it. The man said, “It is only his money; he is gifting me a portion of it.” Ibn Umar forbade him again. The man repeated his request, so Ibn Umar took his hand and said: “This man wants me to feed him usury.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 186
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُمَرَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَأْخُذُ بَعْضَ سَلَمِهِ وَيَأْخُذُ بَعْضَ رَأْسِ مَالِهِ، فَقَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ ذَلِكَ الْمَعْرُوفُ الْحَسَنُ الْجَمِيلُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Abu Umar, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who takes part of his advance payment and part of his capital: "There is no harm in it; that is the recognized, good, and excellent way."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 186
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ امْرَأَةِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ بَاعَنِي جَارِيَةً بِثَمَانِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ نَسِيئَةً، وَاشْتَرَاهَا مِنِّي بِسِتِّمِائَةٍ، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ: «أَبْلِغِي زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ رضي الله عنه أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى قَدْ أَبْطَلَ جِهَادَهُ إِنْ لَمْ يَتُبْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Ishaq, from the wife of Abu al-Safar,
entries.matn_en: that a woman asked Aisha, ؓ, saying: "Zayd b. Arqam sold me a slave girl for eight hundred dirhams on credit, then bought her back from me for six hundred." Aisha said "Tell Zayd b. Arqam, ؓ, that God the Exalted has nullified his jihad if he does not repent."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 186
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه اشْتَرَى مِنْ زَيْنَبَ الثَّقَفِيَّةِ جَارِيَةً، وَاشْتَرَطَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ هُوَ اسْتَغْنَى عَنْهَا فَهِيَ أَحَقُّ بِالثَّمَنِ؛ فَأَتَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «مَا يُعْجِبُنِي أَنْ تَطَأَهَا وَلِأَحَدٍ فِيهَا شَرْطٌ» ، قَالَ: فَرَجَعَ فَرَدَّهَا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him from Al-Zuhri
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, bought a slave girl from Zaynab al-Thaqafiyyah. She stipulated that if he no longer needed her, she would have the right to the price. He then went to Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, and asked him about that. Umar said , "It does not please me that you lie with her while someone else has a condition over her." So Ibn Mas'ud returned and gave her back.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 186
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَعْطَى زَيْدَ بْنَ خُلَيْدَةَ مَالًا مُضَارَبَةً، فَأَسْلَمَ إِلَى عَتْرِيسِ بْنِ عُرْقُوبٍ فِي قَلَائِصَ مَعْلُومَةٍ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ، فَحَلَّتْ فَأَخَذَ مِنْهُ بَعْضًا وَبَقِيَ بَعْضٌ، فَاشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا بَقِيَ، فَأَتَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ وَكَلَّمَهُ فِي أَنْ يُنْظِرَهُ فِيمَا بَقِيَ، فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى زَيْدٍ فَسَأَلَهُ «فِيمَا أَسْلَمْتَ» ، قَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ إِلَيْهِ فِي قَلَائِصَ مَعْلُومَةٍ بِأَسْنَانٍ مَعْلُومَةٍ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ، فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «ارْدُدْ مَا أَخَذْتَ مِنْهُ وَخُذْ رَأْسَ مَالِكَ، وَلَا تُسْلِمْ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَمْوَالِنَا فِي الْحَيَوَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Masud, ؓ, gave Zayd b. Khulayda capital for a profit-sharing venture. Zayd then entered into a salam (advance-payment) contract with Atris b. Urqub for a specified number of young she-camels of specified ages, deliverable at a specified time. When the term came due, Atris delivered some of them, leaving the rest outstanding, and pressed Zayd for the balance. Zayd went to Abdullah [Ibn Masud] and asked him to grant Atris more time for what remained. Abdullah sent for Zayd and asked, “What did you contract to receive by advance payment?” Zayd said, “A specified number of young she-camels, of specified ages, at a specified time.” Abdullah said: “Return what you received from him and take back your capital. Do not put any of our capital into an advance-payment contract for livestock.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 187
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «أَسْلِمْ مَا يُكَالُ فِيمَا يُوزَنُ، وَأَسْلِمْ مَا يُوزَنُ فِيمَا يُكَالُ وَلَا تُسْلِمْ مَا يُكَالُ فِيمَا يُكَالُ، وَلَا مَا يُوزَنُ فِيمَا يُوزَنُ، وَإِذَا كَانَ نَوْعًا وَاحِدًا مِمَّا لَا يُكَالُ وَلَا يُوزَنُ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ اثْنَيْنِ بِوَاحِدٍ يَدًا بِيَدٍ، وَلَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ نَسِيئَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “Enter into a salam contract for goods measured by volume in exchange for goods measured by weight, and for goods measured by weight in exchange for goods measured by volume. Do not make a salam contract for volume-measured goods against goods of the same measure, or for weighed goods against goods of the same measure. If the goods are of different kinds and are neither measured by volume nor weighed, there is no harm in exchanging two for one on the spot, but there is no good in doing so on credit.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 187
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا تَأْخُذْ أَلَا رَأْسَ مَالِكَ أَوْ مَا أَسْلَمْتَ فِيهِ بِعَيْنِهِ، وَإِذَا كَانَ نَوْعَانِ مُخْتَلِفَانِ مِمَّا لَا يُكَالُ وَلَا يُوزَنُ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِاثْنَيْنِ بِوَاحِدٍ يَدًا بِيَدٍ، وَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ نَسِيئَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “Accept nothing except your principal or the very commodity for which you paid in advance. If the goods are of two different kinds and are neither measured by volume nor weighed, there is no harm in exchanging two for one on the spot, nor in doing so on credit.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 187
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا اخْتَلَفَ النَّوْعَانِ فَلَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُسَلَمَ مَا يُوزَنُ فِيمَا يُوزَنُ، وَمَا يُكَالُ فِيمَا يُكَالُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, from someone who reported to him from Amir,
entries.matn_en: who said: “When the two kinds differ, there is no harm in making an advance-payment contract for goods measured by weight in exchange for goods measured by weight, or for goods measured by volume in exchange for goods measured by volume.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 187
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِالسَّلَمِ فِي الثِّيَابِ إِذَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ مَعْلُومًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “There is no harm in an advance-payment contract for garments when their specifications are known.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 187
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِالسَّلَمِ فِي الْفُلُوسِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said "There is no harm in salam (advance payment) for fulus (copper coins)."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 187
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ : «لَا تُسْلِمْ فِي الثَّمَرَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “Do not enter into an advance-payment contract for fruit.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 188
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي رَجُلٍ يَكُونُ لَهُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ دَيْنٌ فَيَجْعَلُهُ فِي السَّلَمِ، قَالَ «لَا حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who has a debt owed to him by another and converts it into a salam transaction: "It is not permissible until he takes possession of it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 188
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُسْلِمُ فِي الْفَاكِهَةِ إِلَى الْقَطَّاعِ، فَيَأْخُذُهَا قَفِيزًا قَفِيزًا، قَالَ «لَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: regarding a man who pays in advance for fruit from harvesters and then takes delivery one qafiz at a time: “There is no good in that.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 188
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِالسَّلَمِ إِذَا كَانَ كَيْلًا مَعْلُومًا أَوْ ذَرْعًا مَعْلُومًا إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “There is no harm in an advance-payment contract when the quantity is specified by a known measure of volume or a known cubit-length, and the delivery date is specified.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 188
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِالرَّهْنِ وَالْكَفِيلِ فِي السَّلَمِ وَالْبَيْعِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said There is no harm in pledging collateral and having a guarantor in a forward sale and in a sale.

sections.title_en: Regarding cultivation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 188
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَنْ عَامِرٍ، وَالْحَسَنِ الْبَصْرِيِّ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، وَعَطَاءٍ، وَمُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمْ «كَانُوا يَكْرَهُونَ الزِّرَاعَةَ بِالثُّلُثِ» ، وَإِنَّ سَالِمًا وَطَاوُسًا كَانَا لَا يَرَيَانِ بِذَلِكَ بَأْسًا، وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ لِطَاوُسٍ أَرْضٌ يُؤَاجِرُهَا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, and from Amir, al-Hasan al-Basri, Sa'id ibn Jubayr, Ata, and Mujahid
entries.matn_en: that they "used to disapprove of cultivation for a third [of the produce]," while Salim and Tawus saw no harm in it. This was because Tawus had land that he would lease out.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 189
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ قُلْتُ لِسَالِمٍ: أَتَكْرَهُ الْمُزَارَعَةَ؟ وَكَانَ يُزَارِعُ: قَالَ: «مَا كُنْتُ لِأَدَعَ مَعِيشَتِي لِقَوْلِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ubaydullah b. Dawud, from Ja'far,
entries.matn_en: who said I said to Salim, "Do you disapprove of sharecropping?"—and he used to practice sharecropping—He replied, "I would not abandon my livelihood on the word of a single man."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 189
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنهما،
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ وَقَالَ «لَا تَبِيعُوا النَّخْلَ سَنَتَيْنِ وَثَلَاثًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Zayd b. al-Walid, from Jabir b. Abdillah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, forbade muhaqalah and muzabanah, and said: “Do not sell the dates of palm trees for two or three years [in advance].”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 189
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حُصَيْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خُدَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ مَرَّ عَلَى حَائِطٍ، فَقَالَ «لِمَنْ هَذَا؟» قُلْتُ: لِي، قَالَ: «مِنْ أَيْنَ هُوَ لَكَ» قَالَ: قُلْتُ: اسْتَأْجَرْتُهُ، قَالَ: «لَا تَسْتَأْجِرَنَّهُ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْهُ» وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لِابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه أَرْضُ خَرَاجٍ وَلِخَبَّابٍ رضي الله عنه أَرْضُ خَرَاجٍ وَلِحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنهما، أَرْضُ خَرَاجٍ وَلِشُرَيْحٍ أَرْضُ خَرَاجٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Husayn from Ibn Rafi b. Khudayj from his father, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, passed by an orchard and asked, “Whose is this?” I said, “Mine.” He asked, “How did it come to belong to you?” I said, “I rented it.” He said, “Do not rent it in return for any of its produce.” Abu Hanifah added that Ibn Masud, Khabbab, Husayn b. Ali, and Shurayh each had kharaj land (land subject to a land levy).

sections.title_en: Regarding the slave who has a contract of manumission, the one who is granted freedom upon the death of his master, and the mother of a child (born to her master).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 190
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُكَاتَبِ: «يُعْتَقُ مِنْهُ بِقَدْرِ مَا أَدَّى وَيُرَقُّ مِنْهُ بِقَدْرِ مَا لَمْ يُؤَدِّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ali b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the slave who has a contract of manumission: "He is freed in proportion to what he has paid, and remains enslaved in proportion to what he has not paid."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 190
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا أَدَّى قِيمَةَ رَقَبَتِهِ فَهُوَ غَرِيمٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When a mukatab has paid the value of his person, he becomes a creditor [for any amount paid beyond that value].”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 190
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «هُوَ عَبْدٌ مَا بَقَى عَلَيْهِ دِرْهَمٌ» ، وَقَالَ زَيْدٌ: «إِنْ مَاتَ أَخَذَ مَوْلَاهُ مَالَهُ كُلَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Zayd b. Thabit, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said "He is a slave as long as a dirham remains upon him." And Zayd said: "If he dies, his master takes all his wealth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 190
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، وَشُرَيْحٍ رضي الله عنهم،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا فِي الْمُكَاتَبِ يَمُوتُ وَيَتْرُكُ وَفَاءً: «يُؤَدِّي بَقِيَّةَ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ وَمَا بَقَى فَهُوَ مِيرَاثٌ لِوَرَثَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Ali, Abdullah b. Mas'ud, and Shurayh, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that they said regarding the slave who has a contract of manumission and dies leaving sufficient wealth: "He pays the remainder of his contract, and what remains is inheritance for his heirs."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 190
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «قَوْلُ عَلِيٍّ وَابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَشُرَيْحٌ رضي الله عنهم فِي الْمُكَاتَبِ إِذَا مَاتَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ قَوْلِ زَيْدٍ، وَقَوْلُ زَيْدٍ فِي الْحَيَاةِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ قَوْلِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said The opinion of Ali, Ibn Mas'ud, and Shurayh, ؓ, regarding the slave who has a contract of manumission and then dies is more preferable to me than the opinion of Zayd. However, the opinion of Zayd during his lifetime is more preferable to me than their opinion.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 191
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها، "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَهَا مُكَاتَبٌ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا، فَبَلَغَهُ قَوْلُ زَيْدٍ، فَقَالَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَسْتَرِقَّنِي، فَأَدَّى إِلَيْهَا فَاحْتَجَبَتْ عَنْهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from a man from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she had a slave who had a contract of manumission with her, and some of his payment was still due. He used to enter upon her, but when he heard the statement of Zayd, he said "He wants to enslave me again." So he paid her what was due, and she then veiled herself from him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 191
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَشُرَيْحٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا «يَضْرِبُ مَوْلَى الْمُكَاتَبِ مَعَ الْغُرَمَاءِ مَا بَقَى عَلَيْهِ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim and Shurayh,
entries.matn_en: that they both said: “The master of a mukatab ranks alongside the creditors for whatever remains due on the mukatab’s emancipation contract.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 191
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي عَبْدٍ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ، كَاتَبَ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ «لَا يَجُوزُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ شَرِيكِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a slave jointly owned by two men, where one of them granted his share in kitabah (contract of manumission): "That is not permissible except with the permission of his partner."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 191
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " إِذَا كَاتَبَ الرَّجُلُ عَبِيدَهَ مُكَاتَبَةً وَاحِدَةً، فَجَعَلَ نُجُومَهُمْ وَاحِدَةً، وَقَالَ: إِنْ أَدَّيْتُمَ فَأَنْتُمْ أَحْرَارٌ، وَإِنْ عَجَزْتُمْ فَأَنْتُمْ رَقِيقٌ، فَمَاتَ وَاحِدٌ لَمْ يَرْفَعْ عَنْهُمْ بِهِ شَيْئًا "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he said When a man writes a single contract of manumission by payment for his slaves, making their installments the same, and says, “If you pay, you are free, and if you are unable, you remain slaves,” then if one of them dies, it does not reduce anything from their obligation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 191
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، تَكَفَّلَ لِرَجُلٍ بِمَالٍ عَنْ مُكَاتَبِهِ، إِنَّ ذَلِكَ بَاطِلٌ، وَكَيْفَ يَجُوزُ، وَإِنَّمَا كُفِلَ بِمَالِهِ عَنْ عَبْدِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that a man guaranteed to another the amount owed by his mukatab. That guarantee is invalid. How could it be valid? He has only guaranteed his own money on behalf of his own slave.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 191
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدًا كَانَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ الْقِبْطِيِّ فَدَبَّرَهُ ثُمَّ احْتَاجَ فَبَاعَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَمَانِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him from ‘Ata b. Abi Rabah
entries.matn_en: that a slave belonged to Ibrahim al-Qibti, so he granted him a tadbir (conditional manumission upon his death). Then Ibrahim needed money, so the Prophet, ﷺ, sold him for eight hundred dirhams.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 192
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «وَلَدُ الْمُدَبَّرَةِ وَوَلَدُ أُمِّ الْوَلَدِ بِمَنْزِلَتِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said The child of a mudabbirah and the child of an umm walad share her status.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 192
entries.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ أَبُو يُوسُفَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَدِّثٌ عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَا يُبَاعُ وَلَا يُوهَبُ، وَإِنْ كَاتَبَ جَارِيَةً فَوَطِئَهَا مَوْلَاهَا فَوَلَدُهَا بِمَنْزِلَتِهَا يُعْتَقُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Yusuf said A narrator related to me from Amir
entries.matn_en: that he said: "It is neither to be sold nor gifted. If a slave woman is contracted for emancipation and her master has intercourse with her, her child holds the same status as her and is emancipated from one-third [of the estate]."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 192
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُنَادِي عَلَى مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ «بَيْعَ أُمَّهَاتِ الْأَوْلَادِ حَرَامٌ، إِذَا وَلَدَتِ الْأَمَةُ لِسَيِّدِهَا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا رِقٌّ بَعْدَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, would announce from the pulpit of the Messenger of God, ﷺ, that "the sale of mothers of children is forbidden. When a slave woman gives birth to her master’s child, she is no longer subject to slavery thereafter."

sections.title_en: Chapter on Military Expeditions and Armies

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 192
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا بَعَثَ جَيْشًا أَوْ سَرِيَّةً يُوصِي صَاحِبَهُمْ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ فِي خَاصَّةِ نَفْسِهِ وَأَوْصَاهُ بِمَنْ مَعَهُ خَيْرًا ثُمَّ قَالَ: «اغْزُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ، قَاتِلُوا مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ، وَلَا تَغُلُّوا، وَلَا تَغْدِرُوا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا وَلِيدًا وَلَا، تُمَثِّلُوا، وَإِذَا لَقِيتُمْ عَدُوَّكُمْ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَادْعُوهُمْ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا فَاقْبَلُوا مِنْهُمْ وَكُفُّوا عَنْهُمْ ثُمَّ ادْعُوهُمْ إِلَى التَّحَوُّلِ مِنْهَا إِلَى دَارِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ ، فَإِنْ أَبَوْا فَأَخْبِرُوهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَأَعْرَابِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، يَجْرِي عَلَيْهِمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ الَّذِي يَجْرِي عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ مِنَ الْفَيْءِ وَالْغَنِيمَةِ نَصِيبٌ، وَإِنْ أَبَوْا فَادْعُوهُمْ إِلَى إِعْطَاءِ الْجِزْيَةِ، فَإِنْ قَبِلُوا ذَلِكَ فَاقْبَلُوا مِنْهُمْ وَكُفُّوا عَنْهُمْ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْبَلُوا ذَلِكَ فَقَاتِلُوهُمْ، وَإِذَا حَصَرْتُمْ أَهْلَ حِصْنٍ فَلَا تُعْطُوهُمْ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَلَا ذِمَّةَ رَسُولِهِ، وَلَكِنْ أَعْطُوهُمْ ذِمَمَكُمْ وَذِمَمَ آبَائِكُمْ، فَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ تَخْفِرُوا ذِمَمَكُمْ أَهْوَنُ، وَإِنْ أَرَادُوكُمْ عَلَى أَنْ يَنْزِلُوا عَلَى حُكْمِ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَفْعَلُوا ، وَلَكِنْ أَنْزِلُوهُمْ عَلَى حُكْمِكُمْ ثُمَّ احْكُمُوا فِيهِمْ مَا بَدَا لَكُمْ» قَالَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Alqamah b. Marthad, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said When the Prophet, ﷺ, sent out an army or a detachment, he would advise its leader to fear God in his own conduct and to treat those with him well. Then he would say: "March forth in the cause of God, in the name of God. Fight those who disbelieve in God. Do not embezzle, do not betray, do not kill a child, and do not mutilate. When you meet your enemy from the polytheists, call them to Islam. If they accept, then accept it from them and refrain from fighting them. Then call them to migrate from their land to the abode of the emigrants. If they refuse, inform them that they will be like the Bedouin Muslims—God’s ruling applies to them as it does to the believers, but they will have no share in the spoils of war or booty. If they refuse, then call them to pay the jizyah. If they accept, then accept it from them and refrain from fighting them. If they do not accept, then fight them. If you besiege the people of a fortress, do not grant them the covenant of God or the covenant of His Messenger, but grant them your own covenant and the covenant of your fathers. If you violate your covenant, it is less severe than violating God’s covenant. If they ask you to let them surrender to God’s judgment, do not do so. Instead, let them surrender to your judgment, then decide their fate as you see fit."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 193
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Yahya b. Sa‘id, from Alqamah b. Marthad, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father, ؓ, from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: the same narration.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 193
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ مُسَافِرٍ، عَنْ مُقَاتِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ هَيْصَمٍ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ الْمُقَرَّنِ الْمُزَنِيِّ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا بَعَثَ أَمِيرًا عَلَى جَيْشٍ أَوْ سَرِيَّةٍ أَوْصَاهُ فِي خَاصَّةِ نَفْسِهِ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ وَمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ خَيْرًا ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمُ: " اغْزُوا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، قَاتِلُوا مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ، وَلَا تَغُلُّوا، وَلَا تَغْدِرُوا، وَلَا تُمَثِّلُوا، وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا وَلِيدًا، وَإِذَا لَقِيتَ عَدُوَّكَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَادْعُهُمْ إِلَى ثَلَاثِ خِصَالٍ أَوْ ثَلَاثِ خِلَالٍ: ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، فَإِنْ قَبِلُوا فَكُفُّوا عَنْهُمْ، وَاقْبَلْ مِنْهُمْ، وَادْعُهُمْ إِلَى التَّحَوُّلِ مِنْ دَارِهِمْ إِلَى دَارِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ إِنْ فَعَلُوا لَهُمْ مَا لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ، وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا عَلَى الْمُهَاجِرِينَ، وَإِنْ دَخَلُوا فِي الْإِسْلَامِ وَاخْتَارُوا دَارَهُمْ فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَأَعْرَابِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ، يَجْرِي عَلَيْهِمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ مَا يَجْرِي عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَلَا يَكُونُ لَهُمْ مِنَ الْفَيْءِ وَالْغَنِيمَةِ شَيْءٌ إِلَّا أَنْ يُجَاهِدُوا مَعَهُمْ، وَإِنْ أَبَوْا فَادْعُهُمْ إِلَى إِعْطَاءِ الْجِزْيَةِ، فَإِنْ قَبِلُوا فَكُفَّ عَنْهُمْ وَاقْبَلْ مِنْهُمْ ذَلِكَ، وَإِنْ أَبَوْا فَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَقَاتِلْهُمْ، وَإِذَا حَاصَرْتَ أَهْلَ حِصْنٍ فَأَرَادُوا أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَذِمَّةَ رَسُولِهِ فَلَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَلَا ذِمَّةَ رَسُولِهِ، وَلَكِنِ اجْعَلْ لَهُمْ ذِمَّتَكَ وَذِمَّةَ أَصْحَابِكَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تَخْفِرْ ذِمَّتَكَ وَذِمَّةَ أَصْحَابِكَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَنْ تَخْفِرَ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَذِمَّةَ رَسُولِهِ، وَإِذَا حَاصَرْتَ أَهْلَ حِصْنٍ فَأَرَادُوا أَنْ يَنْزِلُوا عَلَى حُكْمِ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ حُكْمَ اللَّهِ، وَلَكِنِ اجْعَلْ لَهُمْ حُكْمَكَ وَحُكْمَ أَصْحَابِكَ، فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي هَلْ تُصِيبُ فِيهِمْ حُكْمَ اللَّهِ أَمْ لَا؟ " قَالَ مُقَاتِلٌ: فَنَظَرْتُ فِيمَا فُتِحَ مِنْ أَرْضِ خُرَاسَانَ فِي عَهْدِ عُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنهما فَلَمْ أَجِدْ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْهَا ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَلَا ذِمَّةَ رَسُولِهِ، إِلَّا ذِمَّةَ الْإِمَامِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ مِمَّنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Rawh b. Musafir, from Muqatil b. Hayyan, from Muslim b. Haysam, from al-Nu'man b. al-Muqarrin al-Muzani, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said Whenever the Messenger of God, ﷺ, sent a commander over an army or a detachment, he would advise him personally to fear God and to treat well those Muslims with him. Then he would say to them: "March forth in the name of God and in the path of God. Fight those who disbelieve in God. Do not embezzle, do not betray, do not mutilate, and do not kill children. When you meet your enemy from the polytheists, call them to three matters—invite them to Islam. If they accept, then refrain from fighting them and accept from them. Then call them to migrate from their land to the land of the emigrants, and inform them that if they do so, they will have what the emigrants have, and upon them will be what is upon the emigrants. If they enter Islam but choose to remain in their land, inform them that they are like the Bedouin Muslims—God’s ruling applies to them as it applies to the Muslims, but they will have no share in the spoils of war or booty unless they fight alongside you. If they refuse, then call them to pay the jizyah. If they accept, then refrain from fighting them and accept it from them. If they refuse, then seek God’s help against them and fight them. If you besiege the people of a fortress and they wish for you to grant them the protection of God and the protection of His Messenger, do not grant them the protection of God or the protection of His Messenger. Instead, grant them your protection and the protection of your companions, for if you violate your protection or that of your companions, it is better for you than violating the protection of God and His Messenger. If you besiege the people of a fortress and they wish to surrender to God’s judgment, do not grant them God’s judgment. Instead, grant them your judgment and the judgment of your companions, for you do not know whether you will judge among them according to God’s judgment or not." Muqatil said: "I examined the lands of Khurasan that were conquered during the time of 'Umar and 'Uthman, ؓ, and I did not find in any of them the protection of God or the protection of His Messenger, but only the protection of the Imam and his companions among the Muslims."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 194
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُحِبُّ لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يُنَفِّلَ لِيُغْرِيَ النَّاسَ، وَأَمَّا النَّفَلُ وَالْقَوْمُ فِي الْقِتَالِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he "used to prefer that the leader grant an extra share to incite the people, but as for the extra share while the troops are already engaged in battle..."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 194
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «فَرَضَ عَلَى كُلِّ أَرْضٍ تَصْلُحُ لِلزَّرْعِ دِرْهَمًا وَقَفِيزًا عَلَى الْجَرِيبِ، وَعَلَى الْكَرْمِ عَشْرَةُ دَرَاهِمَ، وَعَلَى الرُّطَبَةِ خَمْسَةُ دَرَاهِمَ وَأَهْدَرَ النَّخْلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ishaq from Muhammad b. Ubaydillah al-Thaqafi from al-Mughirah b. Shu'bah
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, assessed a levy of one dirham and one qafiz per jarib on each cultivable tract, ten dirhams on vineyards, and five dirhams on fields of green fodder crops (al-rutba), while exempting date palms.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 194
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ،
entries.matn_ar: نَحْوًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْأَقْفِزَةِ لِأَنَّهَا لَا تَصْلُحُ لِلزَّرْعِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ishaq
entries.matn_en: similar to that, but he did not mention the qafiz levies because these lands are not suited to grain cultivation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 195
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا أَحْرَزَ الْعَدُوُّ الْعَبْدَ الْمَتَاعَ لِرَجُلٍ، فَأَصَابَهُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، فَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ مَوْلَاهُ قَبْلَ الْقِسْمَةِ أَخَذَهُ بِغَيْرِ شَيْءٍ، وَإِنْ وَجَدَهُ بَعْدَ الْقِسْمَةِ أَخَذَهُ بِالْقِيمَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: If the enemy seizes a slave or property belonging to a man, and the Muslims then capture it, if the owner finds it before the division, he may take it without payment. But if he finds it after the division, he may take it by paying its value.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 195
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: with the same report.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 195
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْعَبْدِ يُحْرِزُهُ الْعَدُوُّ فَظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ، «إِنْ وَجَدَهُ صَاحِبُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْسَمَ فَهُوَ لَهُ يَأْخُذُهُ، وَإِنْ وَجَدَهُ قَدِ اقْتُسِمَ أَخَذَهُ بِالثَّمَنِ وَكَذَلِكَ الْمَتَاعُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding the slave captured by the enemy and then recovered by the Muslims: "If his owner finds him before he is divided [among the soldiers], he may take him. If he finds him after he has been divided, he may take him by paying its price. The same applies to goods."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 195
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَحْمِلَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْحَرْبِ السِّلَاحَ وَالْكُرَاعِ، وَلَا يَرَى بِمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ بَأْسًا مِنَ التِّجَارَةِ، وَأَنْ لَا يُحْمَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْءٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he used to disapprove of carrying weapons and horses to the people of war, but saw no harm in other trade besides that. He said , "And that nothing be carried to them is more beloved to me."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 195
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يُبَاعُ الْوَلَاءُ وَلَا يُورَثُ هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ النَّسَبِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “The wala' (the bond of clientage created by emancipation) is neither sold nor inherited; it is like blood lineage.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 196
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ الرَّهْنُ بِأَكْثَرَ مِمَّا فِيهِ فَهَلَكَ فَالْمُرْتَهِنُ فِي الْفَضْلِ أَمِينٌ، وَإِنْ كَانَ بِأَقَلَّ مِمَّا فِيهِ فَهَلَكَ غَرِمَ الْغَرِيمُ الْفَضْلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said When the collateral is for more than its value and it perishes, the creditor is a trustee regarding the excess. But if it is for less than its value and it perishes, the debtor compensates for the difference.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 196
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْكَفَالَةُ عَنِ الْمُكَاتَبِ لَيْسَتْ بِشَيْءٍ لِأَنَّهُ كُفِلَ لَهُ بِمَالِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said "Guaranteeing for a slave under contract of manumission is invalid because what is guaranteed for him is his own property."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 196
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «أَسِرُّوا مَا شِئْتُمْ، مَنْ أَسَرَّ سَرِيرَةَ خَيْرٍ أَلْبَسَهُ اللَّهُ رِدَاءَهَا، وَمَنْ أَسَرَّ سَرِيرَةَ شَرٍّ أَلْبَسَهُ اللَّهُ رِدَاءَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said Conceal whatever you wish. Whoever conceals a secret of goodness, God will clothe him in its robe, and whoever conceals a secret of evil, God will clothe him in its robe.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 196
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «إِنَّ الْبَلَاءَ مُوَكَّلٌ بِالْكَلَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she said: “Misfortune is bound up with what is said.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 196
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا تَخَالَجَكَ أَمْرَانِ فَظُنَّ أَنَّ أَحَبَّهُمَا إِلَى اللَّهِ أَيْسَرُهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said When two matters perplex you, assume that the one more beloved to God is the easier of the two.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 197
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه قَالَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْبَلَاءَ مُوَكَّلٌ بِالْكَلَامِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, who said
entries.matn_en: who said: “Misfortune is bound up with what is said.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 197
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ صَاحِبٍ لَهُ يُقَالُ لَهُ خَطِيرٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الصَّبِيِّ: «إِذَا كَانَ ابْنَ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً كُتِبَ لَهُ حَسَنَاتُهُ، وَلَمْ يُكْتَبْ عَلَيْهِ سَيِّئَاتُهُ، حَتَّى إِذَا أَدْرَكَ كُتِبَ لَهُ حَسَنَاتُهُ وَكُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ سَيِّئَاتُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from a companion of his called Khateer, from al-Hasan,
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the child: "When he reaches the age of twelve, his good deeds are recorded for him, but his bad deeds are not recorded against him, until he reaches maturity, at which point his good deeds are recorded for him and his bad deeds are recorded against him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 197
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ: كُنْتُ رَدِيفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ «يَا أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ، مَنْ شَهِدَ أَلَّا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ مُخْلِصًا وَجَبَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ» ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ؟ فَسَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ عَادَ لَكَلَامِهِ، قَالَ: فَقُلْتُ: وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ؟ فَسَارَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ عَادَ لَكَلَامِهِ، فَقُلْتُ: وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ؟ فَقَالَ: «وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ وَإِنْ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ» فَكَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ يُحَدِّثُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عِنْدَ كُلِّ جُمُعَةٍ عِنْدَ مِنْبَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَيَضَعُ أُصْبُعَهُ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ وَيَقُولُ: " وَإِنْ زَنَى وَإِنْ سَرَقَ وَإِنْ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abdullah b. Abi Habibah,
entries.matn_en: who said: I heard Abu al-Darda, ؓ, say: I was riding behind the Messenger of God, ﷺ, when he said , "O Abu al-Darda, whoever testifies that there is no god but God and that I am the Messenger of God sincerely, Paradise is obligatory for him." I said to him, "Even if he commits adultery and steals?" He remained silent for a while, then repeated his statement. I said again, "Even if he commits adultery and steals?" He remained silent for a while, then repeated his statement. I said once more, "Even if he commits adultery and steals?" He said, "Even if he commits adultery and steals, even if it displeases Abu al-Darda." Abu al-Darda used to narrate this hadith every Friday near the pulpit of the Messenger of God, ﷺ, placing his finger on his nose and saying, "Even if he commits adultery and steals, even if it displeases Abu al-Darda."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 197
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هِنْدَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَامِرًا صَحِبَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما فِي سَفِينَةٍ إِلَى وَاسِطَ، فَجَعَلَ يَلْعَنُ غُلَامَهُ، فَنَهَاهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «إِنِّي أَرَاكَ كَثِيرَ اللَّعْنِ لِغِلْمَانِكَ أَوْ خَدَمِكَ» ، فَقَالَ عَامِرٌ: كُلُّ مَمْلُوكٍ أَوْ مَمْلُوكَةٍ لَعَنْتُهُ قَطُّ فَهُوَ حُرٌّ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Hind, from Amir,
entries.matn_en: that Amir accompanied Ibn Abbas (ؓ) on a ship to Wasit. Amir began cursing his servant, so Ibn Abbas forbade him from doing so and said "I see you frequently cursing your servants or slaves." Amir replied: "Every male or female slave I have ever cursed is free for the sake of God."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 197
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «الْكَبَائِرُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النِّسَاءِ إِلَى رَأْسِ ثَلَاثِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “The verses on major sins run from the beginning of Surat al-Nisa to the beginning of verse thirty.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 197
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا رَأَيْتَ الْمَرْأَةَ فَأَعْجَبَتْكَ فَاذْكُرْ مَنَاتِنَهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “When you see a woman and she pleases you, remember what is repellent about her.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 198
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتْهُ مِنْ دَيْرِ هِنْدَ تَسْتَفْتِيهِ فَعَجِبَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that a woman came to him from Dayr Hind seeking a religious ruling, and he was amazed at that.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 198
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَاهُ بَارًّا بِوَالِدَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: أُبَايِعُكَ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنْ أَمْرَتُكَ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَالِدَيْكَ فَعَلْتَ؟» قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: لَا، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ، فَبَايَعَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «فَإِنَّا لَا نَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تَقْتُلَ وَالِدَيْكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, and Abu Hanifah said
entries.matn_en: It reached me from the Prophet, ﷺ, that a man who was dutiful to his parents came to him and said, "I pledge allegiance to you for Islam." The Prophet, ﷺ, said, "If I command you to kill your parents, would you do it?" He said, "No." Then he came to him a second time and said the same, and he said, "No." Then he came to him a third time and said the same to him, and he said, "Yes." So he pledged allegiance to him, and the Prophet, ﷺ, said to him, "We would never command you to kill your parents."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 198
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ رَجُلٌ لَهُ لِسَانٌ وَجِلْدٌ لَا يُطَاقُ، فَشَاتَمَهُ رَجُلٌ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: وَاللَّهِ مَا تُدْعَى إِلَى أَبِيكَ الَّذِي أَنْتَ لَهُ، فَسَلْ عَنْ ذَلِكَ أُمَّكَ، قَالَ: فَأَتَاهَا فَسَأَلَهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ لَأَضْرِبَنَّكِ بِالسَّيْفِ إِنْ لَمْ تَصْدُقِينِي، فَقَالَتْ: إِنَّ أَبَاكَ فُلَانٌ، لِغَيْرِ الَّذِي كَانَ يُدْعَى لَهُ، وَكَانَ كَذَلِكَ فَضَرَبَهَا بِالسَّيْفِ فَقَتَلَهَا، فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: «هُوَ شَرُّ الثَّلَاثَةِ لِذَلِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Awn, who said
entries.matn_en: There was a man so sharp-tongued and hard to put up with that people could not bear him. Another man insulted him, saying: “By God, you are not attributed to the father whose name you bear; ask your mother about that.” The man went to his mother and asked her, threatening: “By God, I will strike you with a sword unless you tell me the truth.” She said: “Your father is so-and-so, not the man whose name you bear.” And that was true. He struck and killed her. When this reached the Prophet, ﷺ, he said: “For that, he is the worst of the three.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 198
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى الْقَاضِي أَوِ الْقَاصِّ، شَكَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي " أَنَّ الْحَوَارِيِّينَ اشْتَاقُوا إِلَى يَحْيَى بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا عَلَيْهِمَا الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ فَقَالُوا يَا أَبَهْ: لِعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ عليه الصلاة والسلام، يَا أَبَهْ، إِنْ رَأَيْتَ أَنْ تُخْرِجَهُ لَنَا فَنَنْظُرَ إِلَيْهِ وَنُسَلِّمَ عَلَيْهِ، فَذَهَبَ بِهِمْ إِلَى قَبْرِهِ فَنَادَاهُ: يَا يَحْيَى، قُمْ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: فَخَرَجَ مِنْ قَبْرِهِ يَنْفُضُ رَأْسَهُ قَدِ ابْيَضَّ نِصْفُ رَأْسِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ: فَارَقْتَنَا وَأَنْتَ أَسْوَدُ الرَّأْسِ، فَمَا شَأْنُ رَأْسِكَ؟ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ عِيسَى فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهَا السَّاعَةُ، فَقَالَ لَهُ عِيسَى عليه السلام: هَلْ لَكَ أَنْ أَدْعُوَ اللَّهَ فَيُحْيِيَكَ وَتَعِيشَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، فَقَالَ: أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ وَالرَّحِمَ، وَكَانَ ابْنَ خَالَتِهِ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا ذَهَبَتْ مَرَارَةُ الْمَوْتِ مِنْ صَدْرِي، أَوْ مِنْ حَلْقِي بَعْدُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abd al-A'la the Judge—or the Preacher, Abu Bakr was uncertain—who said
entries.matn_en: that the disciples longed to see Yahya b. Zakariyya, peace be upon them both, and said to Isa b. Maryam, ﷺ: “Father, if you would bring him out to us, we could see him and greet him.” Isa took them to Yahya’s grave and called, “Yahya, rise by God’s permission.” Yahya emerged from his grave, shaking his head; half of it had turned white. The disciples said: “You left us with a black head. What happened to it?” Yahya said: “I heard Isa’s voice and thought the Hour had come.” Isa said: “Would you like me to supplicate to God to revive you so you could live in this world?” Yahya said: “I adjure you by God and by our kinship”—for he was Isa’s maternal cousin—“By God, the bitterness of death has not yet left my chest”—or, he said, “my throat.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 199
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَنْشُدُ بَعِيرًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا وَجَدْتَهُ، إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْبُيُوتَ بُنِيَتْ لِلَّذِي بُنِيَتْ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Alqamah
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, heard a man calling in the mosque for his lost camel. The Prophet said: “May you not find it! These mosques were built for the purpose for which they were built [worship and remembrance of God].”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 199
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ قَوْمًا مَرُّوا بِمَاءٍ، فَسَأَلُوا أَهْلَهَا: أَيْنَ الْبِئْرُ؟ فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يَدُلُّوهُمْ، وَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُعْطُوهُمُ الدَّلْوَ فَقَالُوا وَيْحَكُمْ، إِنَّ أَعْنَاقَنَا وَأَعْنَاقَ رِكَابِنَا قَدْ كَادَتْ تُقْطَعُ عَطَشًا، فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُعْطُوهُمْ أَوْ يُدْلُوهُمْ، فَذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ: «أَلَا وَضَعْتُمْ فِيهِمُ السِّلَاحَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham
entries.matn_en: that a group of people passed by some water. They asked its owners, "Where is the well?" But they refused to guide them and refused to give them the bucket. The people said , "Woe to you! Our necks and the necks of our mounts are about to be severed from thirst." Yet they still refused to give them or guide them. This was mentioned to Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, and he said, "Why did you not strike them with weapons?"

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 199
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِنْ يَكُنِ الشُّؤْمُ فِي شَيْءٍ فَفِي الدَّارِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَالْفَرَسِ، فَأَمَّا الدَّارُ فَشُؤْمُهَا ضِيقُهَا وَخُبْثُ جِيرَانِهَا، وَأَمَّا الشُّؤْمُ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ فَسُوءُ خُلُقِهَا وَعُقْمُ رَحِمِهَا، وَأَمَّا الْفَرَسُ فَإِنَّهُ يَكُونُ جَمُوحًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Alqamah b. Marthad from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that he said If there is bad luck in anything, it is in the house, the woman, and the horse. As for the house, its bad luck is its narrowness and the wickedness of its neighbors. As for the bad luck in the woman, it is her bad character and the barrenness of her womb. As for the horse, it is that it is unruly.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 199
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً دَخَلَتْ عَلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا خَرَجَتْ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ رضي الله عنها: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّهَا قَصِيرَةٌ، فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «تَحَلَّلِي»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham,
entries.matn_en: that a woman came to the Prophet of God, ﷺ. After she left, Aisha, ؓ, said: “Messenger of God, she is short.” The Prophet said to her: “Ask her to pardon you for that.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 199
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُكَ لِأُجَاهِدَ مَعَكَ وَتَرَكْتُ وَالِدَيَّ يَبْكِيَانِ، قَالَ: «انْطَلِقْ فَأَضْحِكْهُمَا كَمَا أَبْكَيْتَهُمَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Muhammad b. Suqah
entries.matn_en: that a man came to the Prophet, ﷺ, and said I have come to you to strive in jihad with you, but I have left my parents weeping. He said: Go back and make them laugh just as you made them weep.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 200
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ أَفْتَى النَّاسَ فِي كُلِّ مَا يَسْأَلُونَهُ عَنْهُ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ فَهُوَ مَجْنُونٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Musa b. Abi Kathir from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "Whoever gives religious verdicts to people in everything they ask him about in every matter is insane."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 200
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ قَالَ جِبْرِيلُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَتَيْتُكَ الْبَارِحَةَ فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْنِي مِنَ الدُّخُولِ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا هَذَا السِّتْرُ الَّذِي فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ، وَإِلَّا هَذَا التِّمْثَالُ الَّذِي فِي الْبَابِ، فَأَخْرِجُوا هَذَا الْكَلْبَ، وَاجْعَلُوا هَذَا السِّتْرَ وِسَادَتَيْنِ تُوطَآنِ، وَاقْطَعُوا رَأْسَ التِّمْثَالِ فِي هَذَا الْبَابِ فَيَكُونُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الشَّجَرَةِ» قَالَ: فَفَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَلِكَ، وَكَانَ الْكَلْبُ لِصَبِيٍّ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Yunus b. Abi Ishaq from Mujahid
entries.matn_en: who said Gabriel said to the Prophet, ﷺ, "I came to you last night, but nothing prevented me from entering upon you except this curtain that has images on it and this statue at the door. So remove this dog, make this curtain into two cushions to be stepped on, and cut off the head of the statue at this door so that it becomes like a tree." He said: The Prophet, ﷺ, did that, and the dog belonged to a child.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 201
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَّقَ فِي بَيْتِهِ سِتْرًا فِيهِ تَمَاثِيلُ، فَأَبْطَأَ عَنْهُ جِبْرِيلُ، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ، فَقَالَ «مَا بَطَّأَكَ عَنِّي؟» ، قَالَ: إِنَّا لَا نَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلَا تَمَاثِيلُ، فَابْسُطْ هَذَا السِّتْرَ، وَاقْطَعُوا رَأْسَ التَّمَاثِيلِ، وَأَخْرِجُوا هَذَا الْكَلْبَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf related to us from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ishaq
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, hung a curtain with images in his house. Gabriel was delayed in coming to him, then he came and the Prophet said , "What delayed you from me?" He replied, "We do not enter a house in which there is a dog or images. Spread out this curtain, cut off the heads of the images, and remove this dog."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 201
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: بِمِثْلِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf related to us from his father from Abu Hanifah from Al-Haytham from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: with the same narration.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 201
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «فَنَاءُ أُمَّتِي بِالطَّعْنِ وَالطَّاعُونِ» فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: قَدْ عَرَفْنَا الطَّعْنَ، فَمَا الطَّاعُونُ؟ قَالَ: «وَخْزُ أَعْدَائِكُمْ مِنَ الْجِنِّ» قَالَ: «وَفِي كُلٍّ شَهَادَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ziyad b. ‘Ilaqah, from ‘Abd Allah b. al-Harith, from Abu Musa, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said, “The destruction of my nation will be by stabbing and plague.” Some of them said, “We know what stabbing is, but what is plague?” He said, “The piercing of your enemies from the jinn.” He said, “And in each is martyrdom.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 201
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ «قَالَ فِي الطَّعْنِ وَالطَّاعُونِ وَالْغَرَقِ وَالْحَرَقِ وَالْهَدْمِ وَأَكْلِ السَّبْعِ وَالْبَطْنِ وَالنُّفَسَاءِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ جُمَعًا، كُلُّ ذَلِكَ شَهَادَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, and Abu Hanifah said
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, spoke of stabbing, plague, drowning, burning, death in a collapse, being devoured by a wild beast, abdominal illness, a woman who dies in childbirth or postpartum, and a pregnant woman who dies [with her fetus], saying: “All of these are martyrdom.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 202
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَضَى الدُّخَانُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ الْكُبْرَى وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "The Smoke has passed, the Great Seizure has passed, and the moon has split."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 202
