entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ الطَّائِيِّ، قَالَ أُرَاهُ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ حُبْلَى، تَحْمِلُ مَعَهَا صَبِيًّا رَضِيعًا، وَمَعَهَا صَبِيُّ فَطِيمٌ تَمَسَّكَ بِيَدِهَا يَمْشِي مَعَهَا، قَالَ: فَمَا سَأَلَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَئِذٍ شَيْئًا إِلَّا أَعْطَاهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «حَامِلَاتٌ وَالِدَاتٌ رَحِيمَاتٌ بِأَوْلَادِهِنَّ، وَلَوْلَا مَا يَصْنَعْنَ بِأَزْوَاجِهِنَّ دَخَلَ مُصَلِّيَاتُهُنَّ الْجَنَّةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ayyub al-Ta'i, who said I think it is from Mujahid,
entries.matn_en: that a woman came to the Prophet, ﷺ, while she was pregnant, carrying an infant with her, and a weaned child who was holding her hand and walking with her. He said: That day, she did not ask the Messenger of God, ﷺ, for anything except that he gave it to her. Then he said: "They are bearers, mothers, compassionate toward their children. Were it not for what they do to their husbands, their praying women would enter Paradise."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 202
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ الْجَزَرِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً خُطِبَتْ إِلَى أَبِيهَا فَقَالَتْ مَا أَنَا بِالَّذِي أَتَزَوَّجُ حَتَّى آتِيَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَسْأَلَهُ عَنْ حَقِّ الزَّوْجِ عَلَى زَوْجَتِهِ، قَالَ: فَأَتَتْهُ فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا حَقُّ الزَّوْجِ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ؟ قَالَ: «إِنْ خَرَجَتْ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ لَمْ يَزَلِ اللَّهُ يَلْعَنُهَا وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ وَخَزَنَةُ دَارِ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَخَزَنَةُ دَارِ الْعَذَابِ حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ» ، فَقَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، فَمَا حَقُّ الزَّوْجِ عَلَى زَوْجَتِهِ؟ قَالَ: «إِنْ دَعَاهَا وَهِيَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ قَتَبٍ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهَا أَنْ تَمْنَعَهُ» ، ثُمَّ قَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، مَا حَقُّ الزَّوْجِ عَلَى زَوْجَتِهِ؟ قَالَ: «تُرْضِيهِ إِذَا غَضِبَ» قَالَ رَجُلٌ: وَإِنْ كَانَ ظَالِمًا؟ قَالَ: «وَإِنْ كَانَ ظَالِمًا» ، قَالَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ: مَا أَنَا بِالَّذِي أَتَزَوَّجُ بَعْدَ مَا أَسْمَعُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Hakam b. Ziyad al-Jazari
entries.matn_en: that a woman was sought in marriage through her father, but she said: “I will not marry until I go to the Prophet, ﷺ, and ask him about a husband’s rights over his wife.” She went to him and asked: “Messenger of God, what right does a husband have over his wife?” He replied: “If she leaves his house without his permission, God, the angels, the Trustworthy Spirit, the keepers of the Abode of Mercy, and the keepers of the Abode of Punishment continue to curse her until she returns to his house.” She asked: “What right does a husband have over his wife?” He replied: “If he calls her while she is on the back of a saddle, she may not refuse him.” She asked again: “What right does a husband have over his wife?” He said: “She should appease him when he is angry.” A man asked: “Even if he is unjust?” He replied: “Even if he is unjust.” The woman said: “I will not marry after hearing this.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 203
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَلَا أَسْجُدُ لَكَ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ لِأَحَدٍ، وَلَوْ كُنْتُ آمُرُ أَحَدًا بِالسُّجُودِ لَأَمَرْتُ الْمَرْأَةَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِزَوْجِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah that he said
entries.matn_en: It reached me that a Bedouin said to the Messenger of God, ﷺ, "Shall I prostrate to you?" The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said, "It is not proper for anyone to prostrate to anyone. If I were to command anyone to prostrate, I would command the woman to prostrate to her husband."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 203
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ سَعْدٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " يُقْعَدُ الْمُؤْمِنُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، فَيُقَالُ: مَنْ رَبُّكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ : اللَّهُ، فَيُقَالُ: مَا دِينُكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: الْإِسْلَامُ، فَيُقَالُ: مَنْ نَبِيُّكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: مُحَمَّدٌ، فَيُفْسِحُ اللَّهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَيَرَى مَنْزِلَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ، وَيُقْعَدُ الْكَافِرُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، فَيُقَالُ: مَنْ رَبُّكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: هَاهْ، كَالْمُضَلِّ شَيْئًا، وَيُقَالُ: مَا دِينُكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: هَاهْ كَالْمُضَلِّ شَيْئًا، وَيُقَالُ: مَنْ نَبِيُّكَ؟ فَيَقُولُ: هَاهْ كَالْمُضَلِّ شَيْئًا، قَالَ: فَيَضِيقُ عَلَيْهِ قَبْرُهُ حَتَّى تَخْتَلِفَ أَضْلَاعُهُ فِيهِ وَيَرَى مَنْزِلَهُ فِي النَّارِ وَيُضْرَبُ ضَرْبَةً يَسْمَعُهَا مَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا الثَّقَلَيْنِ، وَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ وَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الظَّالِمِينَ} [إبراهيم: 27] "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Alqamah, from someone who narrated from Sa'd, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said The believer will be seated in his grave and asked, "Who is your Lord?" He will say, "God." Then he will be asked, "What is your religion?" He will say, "Islam." Then he will be asked, "Who is your prophet?" He will say, "Muhammad." Then God will expand his grave, and he will see his place in Paradise. The disbeliever will be seated in his grave and asked, "Who is your Lord?" He will say, "Hah," like one who is confused about something. Then he will be asked, "What is your religion?" He will say, "Hah," like one who is confused about something. Then he will be asked, "Who is your prophet?" He will say, "Hah," like one who is confused about something. Then his grave will be constricted upon him until his ribs interlock, and he will see his place in the Fire. He will be struck a blow that all on earth will hear except humans and jinn. That is the meaning of God’s statement: "God keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word in the worldly life and in the Hereafter, and God sends astray the wrongdoers." (Ibrahim: 27)

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 204
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ بَعْضِ، أَصْحَابِهِ «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُعْتَمًّا بِعِمَامَةٍ قَدْ أَسْدَلَهَا خَلْفَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from some of his companions
entries.matn_en: that Gabriel came to the Prophet, ﷺ, wearing a turban, the end of which he had let hang down behind him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 204
entries.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: «
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ اسْتَقْرَضَ مِنْ بَيْتِ الْمَالِ سَبْعَةَ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ وَهِيَ عَلَيْهِ، فَأَوْصَى بِهَا أَنْ تُقْضَى عَنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifah said
entries.matn_en: Abu Bakr borrowed seven thousand dirhams from the public treasury, which remained as his debt, so he bequeathed that it be repaid on his behalf.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 204
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " يُؤْتَى يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِمِثْلِ السَّحَابِ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ، فَيُقَالُ: هَذَا مَا عَمِلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ يُعْمَلُ بِهِ بَعْدَكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said On the Day of Resurrection, something like clouds will be brought to a man, and it will be said: "This is the good you did for the people, which continued to be practiced after you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 204
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " يَقْدُمُ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى ثَلَاثَةِ دَوَاوِينَ: دِيوَانٌ فِيهِ الْحِسَابُ، وَدِيوَانٌ فِيهِ النَّعِيمُ، وَدِيوَانٌ فِيهِ الذُّنُوبُ، فَيُقَابَلُ بِالْحِسَابِ النَّعِيمُ فَيَسْتَغْرِقُهَا وَتَبْقَى الذُّنُوبُ فَهِيَ الَّتِي فِيهَا الْمَغْفِرَةُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Awn b. Abdillah, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said People will come forward on the Day of Resurrection in three registers: a register containing the account, a register containing the blessings, and a register containing the sins. The blessings will be weighed against the account and will consume it, leaving the sins, and it is in them that forgiveness lies.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 204
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ أَتَزَوَّجُ فُلَانَةً؟ فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا، ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ أَيْضًا فَقَالَ: أَتَزَوَّجُ فُلَانَةً؟ فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: " سَوْدَاءُ وَلُودٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ حَسْنَاءَ عَاقِرٍ، أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنِّي مُكَاثِرٌ بِكُمُ الْأُمَمَ، حَتَّى إِنَّكَ لَتَرَى السَّقْطَ مُحَبْنَطًا، يُقَالُ لَهُ: ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ فَيَقُولُ: لَا، حَتَّى يَدْخُلَهَا أَبَوَايَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abd al-Malik b. Umayr, from a man of the people of Syria, from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that a man came to him asking, “Should I marry so-and-so?” He discouraged him from marrying her. The man came again and asked the same, and he discouraged him again. Then the Prophet said: “A dark-complexioned, fertile woman is dearer to me than a beautiful, barren one. Do you not know that I will take pride in your numbers before the nations? You may even see a miscarried child standing in indignation [at the gate of Paradise]. It will be told, ‘Enter Paradise,’ and it will say, ‘No, not until my parents enter it.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 205
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ «
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا طَلَعَ النَّجْمُ رُفِعَتِ الْعَاهَةُ عَنْ أَهْلِ كُلِّ بَلَدٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ata b. Abi Rabah from Abu Hurayrah, ؓ, who said
entries.matn_en: When the star rises, the affliction is lifted from the people of every land.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 205
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، قَالَ "
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ مَلِكًا لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ هَلَكَ، فَأَتَوْا رَجُلًا مُتَرَهِّبًا فَأَرَادُوا أَنْ يُمَلِّكُوهُ، فَأَبَى إِلَّا أَنْ يَدَعُوهُ يَسِيحُ سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَيَنْظُرُ فِي أَمْرِهِمْ سِتَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ، قَالَ: فَفَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: فَبَيْنَا هُوَ يَسِيحُ فِي تِلْكَ السِّتَّةِ الْأَشْهُرِ إِذَا هُوَ بِأَهْلِ بَيْتٍ فَضَافَهُمْ، فَرَاحَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ بَقَرَةٌ لَهُمْ فَاحْتَلَبُوا مِنْهَا، فَبَاعُوا مِنْهَا طَائِفَةً لِطَعَامِهِمْ وَأَمْسَكُوا طَائِفَةً، قَالَ: فَقَالَ: أَمَا لَكُمْ مَعِيشَةٌ إِلَّا هَذِهِ؟ فَقَالُوا: لَا، فَقَالَ: لَوْ أَخَذْتُ هَذِهِ لَعِشْتُ فِيهَا، فَأَقَامَ عِنْدَهُمْ فَرَاحَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَابِلَةُ وَلَيْسَ فِي ضَرْعِهَا قَطْرَةٌ، فَقَالَ: مَا شَأْنُ بَقَرَتِكُمْ؟، قَالُوا: مَا أَصَابَهَا مِثْلُ هَذَا قَطُّ، قَالَ: فَمَا تَرَى شَأْنَهَا؟ قَالَ رَبُّ الْبَيْتِ: أَرَى الْمَلِكَ حَدَّثَتْهُ نَفْسُهُ بِمَظْلَمَةٍ فَرُفِعَتِ الْبَرَكَةُ، قَالَ: فَعَرَفَ ذَلِكَ وَنَزَعَ عَمَّا أَرَادَ، فَأَقَامَ عِنْدَهُمْ، فَرَاحَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَابِلَةُ حَافِلًا، فَقَالَ : مَا شَأْنُهَا قَالَ الشَّيْخُ: إِنَّ الْمَلِكَ نَزَعَ عَمَّا تُحَدِّثُ نَفْسُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah, who said
entries.matn_en: It reached me that a king of the Children of Israel died, so they came to a devout monk and wanted to make him king. He refused unless they allowed him to wander for six months and then look into their affairs for six months. They agreed to that. While he was wandering during those six months, he came upon a household and stayed with them. Their cow returned to them, and they milked it. They sold some of the milk for their food and kept some. He said, "Do you have no livelihood except this?" They said, "No." He said, "If I took this, I could live on it." So he stayed with them. The next day, the cow returned, but there was not a drop in its udder. He asked, "What is the matter with your cow?" They said, "It has never happened like this before." He asked, "What do you think is the matter with it?" The head of the household said, "I think the king has entertained an unjust thought in his heart, so the blessing has been lifted." He recognized that and abandoned what he had intended. He stayed with them, and the next day, the cow returned with a full udder. He asked, "What is the matter with it?" The old man said, "The king has abandoned what his heart was entertaining."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 206
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ أَبْيَضَ، مُشْرَبَ حُمْرَةٍ، كَثِيرَ اللَّحْمِ، بَعِيدَ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ، عَلَى صَدْرِهِ قَضِيبٌ مِنْ شَعْرٍ، لَيْسَ بِالْقَصِيرِ وَلَا بِالطَّوِيلِ، رَجِلَ الشَّعْرِ إِلَى شَحْمَةِ أُذُنِهِ، شَثْنَ الْأُصْبُعَيْنِ مِنْ قَدَمِهِ الْوُسْطَى وَالَّتِي جَانِبُ الْإِبْهَامِ، إِذَا مَشَى تَكَفَّأَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Al-Haytham
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, was fair-complexioned with a reddish tinge, full-bodied and broad-shouldered, with a line of hair on his chest. He was neither short nor tall, and his wavy hair reached his earlobes. The middle toe and the toe beside the big toe on each foot were thick. When he walked, he leaned forward.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 206
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ لَا يُقَدِّمُ رُكْبَتَهُ قُدَّامَ جَلِيسٍ لَهُ، وَلَا يُصَافِحُهُ رَجُلٌ فَيَكُونُ هُوَ يَنْزِعُ يَدَهُ مِنْ يَدِهِ حَتَّى يَنْزِعَهَا الرَّجُلُ، وَلَا يَجْلِسُ إِلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ فَيَقُومُ حَتَّى يَقُومَ الرَّجُلُ» ، قَالَ «وَلَمْ أَجِدْ رِيحًا قَطُّ أَطْيَبَ مِنْ رِيحِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him from Anas b. Malik, ؓ, from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that he would not place his knee in front of his companion, nor would a man shake his hand and he withdraw his hand from the man’s hand until the man withdrew his. No man would sit with him and then stand until the man stood. He said I never found any fragrance more pleasant than the fragrance of the Messenger of God, ﷺ.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 206
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَخْرَةَ، "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَكْبًا مِنْ مُحَارِبٍ نَزَلُوا إِلَى جَنْبِ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَاشْتَرَى مِنْهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَزُورًا بِوَسْقٍ مِنْ تَمْرٍ، فَلَمَّا أَنْ ذَهَبَ بِهَا وَتَوَارَى فِي بُيُوتِ الْمَدِينَةِ، فَقَالُوا أَعْطَيْنَاهَا رَجُلًا لَا نَعْرِفُهُ، فَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ مِنْهُمْ: لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ صَفْحَةَ الرَّجُلِ، مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُلْبِسَهُ غَدَرَةً ، فَمَا كَانَ إِلَّا أَنْ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ فَدَعَاهُمْ، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِالتَّمْرِ ثُمَّ نُثِرَ عَلَى نِطَعٍ، فَقَالَ: كُلُوا فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا، ثُمَّ أَوْفَاهُمْ تَمْرَهُمْ، فَقَالُوا: مَا رَأَيْنَا كَالْيَوْمِ فِي الْوَفَاءِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Sakhrah
entries.matn_en: that a group from the tribe of Muharib camped near Medina. The Prophet, ﷺ, bought a camel from them in exchange for a wasq of dates. When he took the camel and disappeared among the houses of Medina, they said , "We gave it to a man we do not know." An old woman among them said, "I have seen the face of this man—God would never clothe him in treachery." Soon after, he sent for them and invited them. He ordered the dates to be brought and spread on a leather mat. He said, "Eat," and they ate until they were full. Then he gave them their full measure of dates. They said, "We have never seen the like of this day in fulfillment."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 207
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَوْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Dhawbah, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, said Whoever lies about me intentionally, let him take his seat in the Fire.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 207
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ «مَا يَمْنَعُنِي أَنْ أَجْمَعَ الْقُرْآنَ إِلَّا أَنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ لَا أَقُومَ بِهِ» ، فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: تَنَامُ عَالِمًا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَنَامَ جَاهِلًا، وَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: تَعَلَّمْهُ وَاعْمَلْ بِمَا فِيهِ وَأَنْتَ مُسْتَيْقِظٌ، وَأَنَا ضَامِنٌ لِمَا تُحَدِّثُ فِي نَوْمِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from ‘Awn b. ‘Abd Allah
entries.matn_en: that Abu al-Darda’, ؓ, said "Nothing prevents me from memorizing the Quran except that I fear I may not fulfill its rights." A man from the companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, said: "Sleeping as a scholar is better than sleeping as an ignorant one." Another man from the companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, said to him: "Learn it and act upon what is in it while you are awake, and I guarantee what you speak of in your sleep."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 207
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، أَتَى عَلِيًّا رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا خَيْرًا مِنْكَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: «هَلْ رَأَيْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم» قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «فَهَلْ رَأَيْتَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما» قَالَ: لَا، قَالَ: «لَوْ أَخْبَرْتَنِي أَنَّكَ رَأَيْتَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَرَبْتُ عُنُقَكَ وَلَوْ أَخْبَرْتَنِي أَنَّكَ رَأَيْتَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ لَأَوْجَعْتُكَ عُقُوبَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah
entries.matn_en: that a man came to Ali, ؓ, and said I have not seen anyone better than you. Ali said to him: Have you seen the Prophet, ﷺ? He said: No. Ali said: Have you seen Abu Bakr and Umar, ؓ? He said: No. Ali said: If you had told me that you had seen the Prophet, ﷺ, I would have struck your neck, and if you had told me that you had seen Abu Bakr and Umar, I would have punished you severely.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 207
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ دَخَلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما عَلَى عُمَرَ رضي الله عنه حِينَ أُصِيبَ فَقَالَ: «أَبْشِرْ، فَوَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كَانَ إِسْلَامُكَ عِزًّا، وَلَقَدْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُكَ فَتْحًا، وَوِلَايَتُكَ عَدْلًا، وَلَقَدْ صَحِبْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى تُوُفِّيَ وَهُوَ عَنْكَ رَاضٍ، ثُمَّ صَحِبْتَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَتُوُفِّيَ وَهُوَ عَنْكَ رَاضٍ، وَلَقَدْ وُلِّيتَ فَمَا اخْتَلَفَ فِي وِلَايَتِكَ اثْنَانِ» ، قَالَ عُمَرُ: أَتَشْهَدُ بِذَلِكَ قَالَ : فَكَعَّ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ رضي الله عنه: نَعَمْ نَشْهَدُ لَهُ بِذَلِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham,
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Abbas entered upon Umar when he was wounded and said: “Rejoice! By God, your Islam brought honor, your migration brought victory, and your rule was just. You accompanied the Messenger of God until he died pleased with you; then you accompanied Abu Bakr until he died pleased with you. You were given authority, and no two people disputed your leadership.” Umar asked, “Do you bear witness to that?” Ibn Abbas hesitated. Ali said: “Yes, we bear witness to that on his behalf.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 208
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَجُلًا، شَتَمَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، فَحَلُمَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه، وَالنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَاعِدٌ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رَدَّ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ: شَتَمَنِي فَلَمْ تَقُمْ، وَقُمْتَ حِينَ رَدَدْتُ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ مَلَكًا كَانَ يَرُدُّ عَنْكَ، فَلَمَّا رَدَدْتَ أَنْتَ ذَهَبَ فَقُمْتُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah, who said
entries.matn_en: It reached me that a man insulted Abu Bakr, ؓ, while the Prophet, ﷺ, was sitting, and Abu Bakr remained patient. Then Abu Bakr responded to him, so the Prophet, ﷺ, stood up. Abu Bakr said: He insulted me and you did not stand, but you stood when I responded to him. The Prophet, ﷺ, said: An angel was responding on your behalf, but when you responded yourself, the angel left, so I stood.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 208
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، مَرَّ بِرَجُلٍ وَهُوَ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ وَعُمَرُ يَقُومُ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَهُمْ يَأْكُلُونَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ: «كُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ» ، قَالَ: إِنَّهَا مَشْغُولَةٌ، ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِهِ الثَّانِيَةَ، فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِهِ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: شُغْلُ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ: قُطِعَتْ يَوْمَ مُؤْتَةَ، قَالَ: فَفَزِعَ عُمَرُ لِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ: «مَنْ يَغْسِلُ ثِيَابَكَ؟ مَنْ يَدْهِنُ رَأْسَكَ؟ مَنْ يَقُومُ عَلَيْكَ؟» قَالَ: فَعَدَّدَ عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ هَذَا، ثُمَّ أَمَرَ لَهُ بِجَارِيَةٍ وَرَاحِلَةٍ طَعَامٍ وَنَفَقَةٍ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ النَّاسُ: جَزَى اللَّهُ عُمَرَ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ خَيْرًا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ali b. al-Aqmar
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, passed by a man who was eating with his left hand while Umar was overseeing the people as they ate. Umar said to him, "Eat with your right hand, O servant of God." The man replied, "It is occupied." Umar passed by him a second time and said the same, then a third time and said the same. The man said, "What is it occupied with?" He replied, "It was cut off on the day of Mu'tah." Umar was startled by this and said, "Who washes your clothes? Who oils your head? Who takes care of you?" The man listed similar tasks. Then Umar ordered that a servant girl, a mount, food, and provisions be given to him. The people then said, "May God reward Umar well on behalf of his subjects."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 208
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي «أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، كَانَ يَأْتِي مَسْجِدَ قُبَاءٍ كُلَّ سَبْتٍ فَيَدْعُو بِسَعَفَةٍ فَيَكْنِسُهُ هُوَ بِنَفْسِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported to me from his father from Abu Hanifah who said
entries.matn_en: It reached me that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, used to come to the mosque of Quba every Saturday, bring a palm branch, and sweep it himself.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 208
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِأَبِي مُوسَى رضي الله عنه حِينَ حَكَّمَهُ: «خَلِّصْنِي مِنْهَا وَلَوْ بِعِرْقِ رَقَبَتِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لَنْ يَصُولَ بِهِمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا صَالَ بِالسَّهْمِ الْأَخْبَثِ، وَلَوَدِدْتُ أَنَّ مَعِي مَكَانَهُمْ أَلْفَ فَارِسٍ مِنْ بَنِي فِرَاسِ بْنِ غَنْمٍ، وَلَاجْتِمَاعُ هَؤُلَاءِ عَلَى بَاطِلِهِمْ أَشَدُّ مِنَ اجْتِمَاعِكُمْ عَلَى حَقِّكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Musa b. Abi Kathir, from Ali, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that Ali, ؓ, said to Abu Musa, ؓ, when he appointed him as arbitrator: “Relieve me of this [burden], even if it costs me my life. Whoever contends with them will have to use the vilest means. I wish I had a thousand horsemen from Banu Firas b. Ghanm in their place. Their unity in falsehood is stronger than your unity in the truth.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 208
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ خَطَبَ بِالْكُوفَةِ حِينَ اسْتُخْلِفَ عُثْمَانُ رضي الله عنه ، وَقَالَ «مَا أَلَوْنَا عَنْ أَعْلَاهَا ذِي فَوْقٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abdul-Malik b. Umayr, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he preached in Kufa when Uthman, ؓ, was appointed caliph, and said: “In choosing him, we did not fail to select the best among us—the foremost of the candidates.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 209
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ بَيَانِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ رضي الله عنه الْكُوفَةَ حِينَ اسْتَخْلَفُوا عُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنه، فَقَالَ: «مَا أَلَوْنَا عَنْ أَعْلَاهَا ذِي فَوْقٍ» وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ يَقُولُ: مَا بِالْعِرَاقِ مِثْلُ الْحَسَنِ الْبَصْرِيِّ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Bayan b. Bishr, from Qays b. Abi Hazim,
entries.matn_en: that Abdullah arrived in Kufa when Uthman, ؓ, had been chosen caliph, and said: “In choosing him, we did not fail to select the best among us—the foremost of the candidates.” Abu Hanifah said: “I heard Abu Jafar say, ‘There is no one in Iraq like al-Hasan al-Basri.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 209
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَتْ " فِيَّ سَبْعُ خِصَالٍ لَيْسَتْ فِي أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: تَزَوَّجَنِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكْرًا، وَلَمْ يَتَزَوَّجْ أَحَدًا مِنْ نِسَائِهِ بِكْرًا غَيْرِي، وَنَزَلَ جِبْرِيلُ إِلَيْهِ بِصُورَتِي قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَنِي، وَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ صُورَةَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ غَيْرِي، وَرَأَيْتُ جِبْرِيلَ وَلَمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ غَيْرِي، وَكُنْتُ مِنْ أَحِبِّهِنَّ إِلَيْهِ نَفْسًا وَوَالِدًا، وَكَانَ جِبْرِيلُ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْوَحْيِ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ فِي شِعَارِهِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَأْتِيهِ وَهُوَ مَعَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ غَيْرِي، وَنَزَلَ فِيَّ آيَاتٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ كَادَ يَهْلِكُ فِيهَا فِئَامٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَمَاتَ فِي يَوْمِي وَلَيْلَتِي وَبَيْنَ سَحْرِي وَنَحْرِي "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Awn b. Abdillah from Amir from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “I have seven qualities not shared by any of the Prophet’s other wives: The Prophet married me as a virgin, and none of his other wives was a virgin when he married her. Gabriel came to him in my image before he married me; he did not come in the image of any other wife. I saw Gabriel, and none of his other wives did. I was among the wives dearest to him, both in my own person and through my father. Gabriel would bring him revelation while I was beneath the same covering with him; he did not come to him while he was with any other wife. Verses of the Quran were revealed concerning me that nearly caused large groups of people to perish. He died on my day and night, between my chest and throat.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 210
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «هَوَّنَ عَلَيَّ مَرَضِي أَنِّي رَأَيْتُ عَائِشَةَ مَعِي فِي الْجَنَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "My illness was made easy for me when I saw Aisha with me in Paradise."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 210
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ غَمًّا وَكَرْبًا فَانْصَرِفْ، فَقَالَ لِلرَّسُولِ: مَا أَنَا بِالَّذِي أَنْصَرِفُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ، فَرَجَعَ الرَّسُولُ فَأَخْبَرَهَا بِذَلِكَ فَأَذِنَتْ لَهُ، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ: إِنِّي أَجِدُ غَمًّا وَكَرْبًا، وَأَنَا مُشْفِقَةٌ مِمَّا أَخَافُ أَنْ أَهْجُمَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ لَهَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ: أَبْشِرِي، " فَوَاللَّهِ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَكْرَمُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهُ جَمْرَةً مِنْ جَمْرِ جَهَنَّمَ، فَقَالَتْ: فَرَّجْتَ عَنِّي فَرَّجَ اللَّهُ عَنْكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Al-Haytham,
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Abbas (ؓ) sought permission to enter upon Aisha (ؓ). She sent a message to him: "I am feeling grief and distress, so turn away." He said to the messenger: "I will not turn away until I enter." The messenger returned and informed her of that, so she permitted him. She said to him: "I am feeling grief and distress, and I fear what I might suddenly encounter." Ibn Abbas said to her: "Rejoice, for by God, the Messenger of God is too honorable in the sight of God to be wedded to an ember from the embers of Hell." She said: "You have relieved me, may God relieve you."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 210
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ يُنْقَلُ فِي بُيُوتِ أَزْوَاجِهِ، فَشَقَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ، فَاسْتَأْذَنَهُنَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي بَيْتِ بَعْضِهِنَّ فَأَذِنَّ لَهُ، فَكَانَ فِي بَيْتِ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها حَتَّى قُبِضَ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, during his final illness from which he died, was being moved among the houses of his wives. This became difficult for him, so he sought their permission to stay in the house of one of them, and they permitted him. He remained in the house of Aisha, ؓ, until he passed away, ﷺ.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 210
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «مَا شَبِعَ آلُ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ خُبْزِ بُرٍّ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ مُتَتَابِعَاتٍ حَتَّى مَاتَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَمَا زَالَتِ الدُّنْيَا عَسِرَةً كَدِرَةً حَتَّى مَاتَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا مَاتَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم صُبَّتِ الدُّنْيَا عَلَيْنَا صَبًّا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she said: “The family of Muhammad, ﷺ, did not eat their fill of wheat bread for three consecutive days before Muhammad died. The world remained harsh and troubled until Muhammad died. When he died, the world’s bounty was poured out upon us.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 211
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ بَلَغَنِي عَنِ «ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه، أَنَّهُ كَانَ صَاحِبَ وَضُوءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَصِيرِهِ وَسِوَاكِهِ وَنَعْلَيْهِ وَعَصَاهُ، وَيَسْتُرُهُ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَ، وَيَمْشِي مَعَهُ فِي الْوَحْشَةِ، وَيُرَحِّلُ لَهُ إِذَا سَافَرَ، وَكَانَ مِنْ أَشَدِّ النَّاسِ بِهِ شَبَهًا إِذْا دَخَلَ وَخَرَجَ، وَكَانَ يُرْسِلُ أُمَّ عَبْدٍ إِلَيْهِ فَتُخْبِرُهُ بِذَلِكَ وَشَمَائِلِهِ فَيُشَبَّهُ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, who said
entries.matn_en: It reached me from Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, that he was the keeper of the Messenger of God’s, ﷺ, ablution water, his mat, his tooth-stick, his sandals, and his staff. He would screen him when he bathed, walk with him in desolate places, and prepare his mount when he traveled. He was one of the people who most resembled him in his entry and exit. Umm ‘Abd would be sent to him to inform him of that and his characteristics, so he would be likened to him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 211
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مَعْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ مَا كَذَبْتُ مُنْذُ أَسْلَمْتُ إِلَّا كَذِبَةً وَاحِدَةً، كُنْتُ أُرَحِّلُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَتَى بِرِحَالٍ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ فَسَأَلَنِي: أَيُّ الرِّحْلَةِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقُلْتُ: الطَّائِفِيَّةُ، وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا أُتِيَ بِهَا قَالَ: «مَنْ رَحَّلَ لَنَا هَذِهِ؟» قَالُوا: رَحَّالُكَ، فَقَالَ: «مُرُوا ابْنَ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ فَلْيُرَحِّلْ لَنَا» قَالَ: فَأُعِيدَتْ إِلَيَّ الرِّحْلَةُ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ma'n from his father from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said I have not lied since I embraced Islam except for one lie. I used to saddle the Prophet's camel, ﷺ. Some saddles from Ta'if were brought, and he asked me, "Which saddle does the Prophet, ﷺ, prefer?" I said, "The one from Ta'if," though the Messenger of God, ﷺ, disliked it. When it was brought to him, he said, "Who saddled this for us?" They said, "Your saddler." He said, "Tell Ibn Umm Abd to saddle for us." So the saddle was returned to me.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 211
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ صَحِبَ نَصْرَانِيًّا فِي طَرِيقٍ، فَذَهَبَ النَّصْرَانِيُّ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: «عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامُ» ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: لِمَ فَعَلْتَ؟ قَالَ: «لِحَقِّ الصُّحْبَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he accompanied a Christian on a journey. The Christian went away, so Abdullah said to him: "Peace be upon you." It was said to him: "Why did you do that?" He said: "For the right of companionship."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 211
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه صَحِبَ دِهْقَانًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ، فَلَمَّا فَارَقَهُ أَخَذَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ يُنَادِيهِ: «السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَوْ عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham
entries.matn_en: that Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ, accompanied a village chief from among the People of the Covenant. When he parted from him, Ibn Mas‘ud called out to him: "Peace be upon you" or "Upon you be peace."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 212
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هِنْدَ، عَنْ بَعْضِ، أَشْيَاخِهِمْ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَامِرًا، كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ فِي حَلْقَةٍ فِيهَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما، عَنْ مَغَازِي النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ: «إِنَّهُ لَيُحَدِّثُ حَدِيثًا كَأَنَّهُ شَهِدَ الْقَوْمَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated to me from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Hind from one of their elders
entries.matn_en: that ‘Amir used to narrate in a gathering where Ibn ‘Umar, ؓ, was present about the military campaigns of the Prophet, ﷺ. Ibn ‘Umar said , "He narrates as if he had witnessed the people himself."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 212
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " تَفَقَّهَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِتَّةُ رَهْطٍ: ثَلَاثَةٌ مِنْهُمْ يُلْقِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَثَلَاثَةٌ يُلْقِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، فَكَانَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ يُلْقِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ، وَكَانَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَأَبُو مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيُّ وَأُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ يُلْقِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from someone who narrated to him, from ‘Amir,
entries.matn_en: that he said Six individuals from the companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, were jurists. Three of them would consult one another, and three others would consult one another. Ibn Mas‘ud, ‘Umar b. al-Khattab, and Zayd b. Thabit would consult one another, while ‘Ali b. Abi Talib, Abu Musa al-Ash‘ari, and Ubayy b. Ka‘b would consult one another.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 212
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْبَلَ عَلَى الْعِبَادَةِ، فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ يَسْأَلُهُ، فَقَالَ مَا أَدْرِي أَوْ مَا لِي بِهَذَا عِلْمٌ، فَقَالَ: «لَوْ كَانَ أَصْحَابُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخَذُوا بِمَا أَخَذْتَ بِهِ ضَاعَ الْعِلْمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Al-Haytham,
entries.matn_en: that a man from the companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, devoted himself to worship. When the Prophet, ﷺ, passed away, a man came to him asking a question. He said , "I do not know," or "I have no knowledge of this." The man said, "If the companions of the Prophet, ﷺ, had taken what you have taken, knowledge would have been lost."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 212
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ «عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، قَدِمَ الشَّامَ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ رضي الله عنه، فَتَلَقَّاهُ، فَلَمَّا الْتَقَيَا اعْتَنَقَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham,
entries.matn_en: that when Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, arrived in Syria, Abu Ubaydah b. al-Jarrah, ؓ, went out to meet him. When they met, each embraced the other.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 212
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، دَخَلَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُهُ فِي شَكَاةٍ اشْتَكَاهَا، فَإِذَا هُوَ عَلَى عَبَاءَةٍ قَطَوَانِيَّةٍ وَمِرْفَقَةٍ مِنْ صُوفٍ وَحَشْوُهَا إِذْخِرٌ، فَقَالَ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، كِسْرَى وَقَيْصَرُ عَلَى الدِّيبَاجِ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى هَذَا، فَقَالَ: «يَا عُمَرُ أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَنَا الْآخِرَةُ» ، ثُمَّ إِنَّ عُمَرَ مَسَّهُ، فَإِذَا هُوَ شَدِيدُ الْحُمَّى، فَقَالَ: تُحَمُّ هَكَذَا وَأَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ أَشَدَّ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ بَلَاءً نَبِيُّهَا ثُمَّ الْخَيِّرُ فَالْخَيِّرُ مِنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَكَذَلِكَ كَانَتِ الْأَنْبِيَاءُ قَبْلَكُمْ وَالْأُمَمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, visited the Prophet, ﷺ, during an illness. He found him on a Qatwani cloak, with a wool cushion stuffed with idhkhir grass beneath his head. Umar said: “May my father be sacrificed for you, Messenger of God! Chosroes and Caesar recline on brocade, while you lie on this.” The Prophet said: “Umar, are you not content that they have this world and we have the Hereafter?” Umar touched him and found that he had a severe fever. Umar said: “You suffer such fever while you are God’s Messenger?” The Prophet replied: “The most severely tested of this community are its prophets, then the best, then the next best. The prophets before you and their communities were likewise tested.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 213
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «عَلَى أَبْوَابِ السُّلْطَانِ مِثْلُ مَبَارِكِ الْإِبِلِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ، مَنْ تَعَرَّضَ لَهَا تَعَرَّضَتْ لَهُ لَنْ تُصِيبُوا مِنْ دُنْيَاهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا أَصَابُوا مِنْ دِينِكُمْ أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah b. Qays,
entries.matn_en: who said "At the gates of the ruler are the resting places of camels of tribulations. Whoever exposes himself to them will be exposed to them. You will never attain anything from their worldly life except that they will take from your religion something better than it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 213
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي غَسَّانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رضي الله عنه، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ، الْإِمْرَةُ أَمَانَةٌ، وَهِيَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ خِزْيٌ وَنَدَامَةٌ، إِلَّا مَنْ أَخَذَهَا بِحَقِّهَا وَأَدَّى الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Ghassan, from al-Hasan, from Abu Dharr, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, said "O Abu Dharr, leadership is a trust, and on the Day of Resurrection it will be a disgrace and regret, except for one who takes it rightfully and fulfills what is due upon him in it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 213
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، قَالَ: «لَوْلَا أَنْ أَضَعَ وَجْهِي لِلَّهِ، أَوْ يَخْرُجَ مِنِّي نَسَمَةٌ تُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ، أَوْ أَجْلِسَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ يَتَخَيَّرُونَ الْكَلَامَ كَمَا نَتَخَيَّرُ جَيِّدَ التَّمْرِ مَا بَالَيْتُ لَوْ مُتُّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah who said
entries.matn_en: It reached me that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, said: "Were it not that I humble my face for God, or that a breath praising God leaves me, or that I sit with people who carefully choose their words as we choose the best dates, I would not care if I died."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 213
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَأَنْ يُجَاوِرَنِي فِي دَارِيَ شَيْطَانٌ لَا يَضُرُّنِي أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ تُجَاوِرَنِيَ امْرَأَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said “That a devil should live next to me in my house and not harm me is more beloved to me than that a woman should live next to me.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 214
entries.matn_ar: ثُمَّ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ خَيْرًا وَلَّى أَمَرَهُمْ حُلَمَاءَهُمْ، وَجَعَلْ فَيْئَهُمْ عِنْدَ سُمَحَائِهِمْ، وَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ شَرًّا وَلَّى أَمْرَهُمْ شِرَارَهُمْ، وَجَعَلَ فَيْئَهُمْ عِنْدَ بُخَلَائِهِمْ»
entries.matn_en: Then he reported to him from al-Hasan, from the Prophet, ﷺ, who said: “When God intends good for a people, He places their affairs in the hands of their most forbearing and allocates their public revenues to their most generous. When God intends evil for a people, He places their affairs in the hands of their worst and their revenues in the hands of their most miserly.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 214
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «أُغَيْلِمَةُ جَارِي إِنْ أُجِيبُوا لَمْ يَفْهَمُوا، وَإِنْ وُكِّلُوا وُكِّلُوا إِلَى غَيٍّ شَدِيدٍ، لَوْلَا مَا أَخَذَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْعُلَمَاءِ مَا أَجَبْتُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from al-Hasan,
entries.matn_en: who said: “The young people among my neighbors—if I answer them, they do not understand; and if they are left to themselves, they are left to serious error. Were it not for the duty God has laid upon scholars, I would answer only a few.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 214
entries.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: «خَيْرُ شَبَابِكُمُ الَّذِينَ يَتَشَبَّهُونَ بِشُيُوخِكُمْ، وَشَرُّ شُيُوخِكُمُ الَّذِينَ يَتَشَبَّهُونَ بِشَبَابِكُمْ، وَشَرُّ رِجَالِكُمُ الَّذِينَ يَتَشَبَّهُونَ بِنِسَائِكُمْ، وَشَرُّ نِسَائِكُمُ الَّذِينَ يَتَشَبَّهُونَ بِرِجَالِكُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hanifah said
entries.matn_en: It has reached me that the Prophet, ﷺ, said: "The best of your youth are those who emulate your elders, and the worst of your elders are those who emulate your youth. The worst of your men are those who emulate your women, and the worst of your women are those who emulate your men."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 214
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه، "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه، رَأَى مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خِفَّةً، فَاسْتَأْذَنَهُ إِلَى ابْنَةِ خَارِجَةَ، وَكَانَتْ فِي حَوَائِطِ الْأَنْصَارِ، وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ رَاحَةَ الْمَوْتِ وَلَا يَشْعُرُ، فَأَذِنَ لَهُ، ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ، فَأَصْبَحَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه فَجَعَلَ يَرَى النَّاسَ يَتَرَامَسُونَ فَأَمَرَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ غُلَامًا يَتَسَمَّعُ ثُمَّ يُخْبِرُهُ، فَقَالَ: سَمِعْتُهُمْ يَقُولُونَ: مَاتَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَأَسْنَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ظَهْرَهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ: وَاقْطَعَ ظَهْرَاهُ، قَالَ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْمَسْجِدَ حَتَّى ظَنُّوا أَنَّهُ لَا يَبْلُغُ، قَالَ: فَأَرْجَفَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ، فَقَالُوا: لَوْ كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيًّا لَمْ يَمُتْ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: لَا أَسْمَعُ أَحَدًا يَقُولُ: مَاتَ مُحَمَّدٌ، إِلَّا ضَرَبْتُهُ بِالسَّيْفِ، فَكَفُّوا لِذَلِكَ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه وَالنَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُسَجًّى كَشَفَ الثَّوْبَ وَجَعَلَ يَلْثِمُهُ، وَيَقُولُ : بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي، مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُذِيقَكَ الْمَوْتَ مَرَّتَيْنِ، أَنْتَ أَكْرَمُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ خَرَجَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، فَقَالَ: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ مَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ مُحَمَّدًا فَقَدْ مَاتَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَمَنْ كَانَ يَعْبُدُ رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنَّ رَبَّ مُحَمَّدٍ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، ثُمَّ قَرَأَ {وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِ الرُّسُلُ، أَفَإِنْ مَاتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ انْقَلَبْتُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِكُمْ وَمَنْ يَنْقَلِبْ عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَنْ يَضُرَّ اللَّهَ شَيْئًا وَسَيَجْزِي اللَّهُ الشَّاكِرِينَ} [آل عمران: 144] قَالَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه: وَاللَّهِ لَكَأَنَّا لَمْ نَقْرَأْهَا قَبْلَهَا قَطُّ، فَقَالَ النَّاسُ مِثْلَ مَقَالَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ مِنْ كَلَامِهِ وَقِرَاءَتِهِ، قَالَ: وَمَاتَ لَيْلَةَ الْإِثْنَيْنِ فَمَكَثَ لَيْلَتَئِذٍ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَيْلَةَ الثُّلَاثَاءِ وَدُفِنَ يَوْمَ الثُّلَاثَاءِ، قَالَ: وَكَانَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَأَوْسُ بْنُ خَوْلِيٍّ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ رضي الله عنهم يَصُبَّانِ الْمَاءَ، وَعَلِيٌّ وَالْفَضْلُ رضي الله عنهما يُغَسِّلَانِهِ " وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: بَلَغَنِي أَنَّهُمْ صَلَّوْا عَلَيْهِ أَفْوَاجًا بِغَيْرِ إِمَامٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Yazid b. Abd al-Rahman, from Anas b. Malik, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that Abu Bakr, ؓ, noticed the Prophet, ﷺ, was in a lightened state. He sought his permission to visit the daughter of Kharijah, who was in the orchards of the Ansar. This was the rest before death, though he was unaware. The Prophet permitted him, then passed away that very night. Abu Bakr awoke the next morning to find people in commotion. He ordered a servant to listen and report back. The servant said, "I heard them saying, 'Muhammad, ﷺ, has died.'" Abu Bakr leaned against a wall, exclaiming, "May my back be severed!" When he reached the mosque, they thought he would not make it. The hypocrites began spreading doubt, saying, "If Muhammad were a prophet, he would not have died." Umar said , "I will strike with my sword anyone who says Muhammad has died." They fell silent. When Abu Bakr arrived and the Prophet, ﷺ, was laid out, he uncovered his face, kissed him, and said, "May my father and mother be ransomed for you. God would not make you taste death twice. You are too noble for that in God’s sight." Then Abu Bakr went out and said, "O people, whoever worshipped Muhammad, Muhammad has died. But whoever worshipped the Lord of Muhammad, the Lord of Muhammad lives and does not die." Then he recited, "Muhammad is but a messenger; messengers have passed away before him. If he dies or is killed, will you turn back on your heels? Whoever turns back on his heels will not harm God at all, and God will reward the grateful." Umar said, "By God, it was as if we had never read this verse before." The people echoed Abu Bakr’s words and recitation. The Prophet died on Monday night, remained that night and the following day and Tuesday night, and was buried on Tuesday. Usamah b. Zayd andAws b. Khawli al-Ansari, ؓ, poured the water, while Ali and al-Fadl, ؓ, washed him. Abu Hanifah said, "It reached me that they prayed over him in groups without an imam."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 215
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعُمَرَ رضي الله عنه وَهُوَ مُسَجًّى: «مَا أَحَدٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ أَنْ أَلْقَى اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بِمِثْلِ صَحِيفَتِهِ مِنْ هَذَا الْمُسَجَّى»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali, from Ali b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said to Umar, ؓ, while he was shrouded: "There is no one whose record I would rather meet God Almighty with than this shrouded one."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 215
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هِنْدَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " كَانَ جَالِسًا إِلَى أُسْطُوَانَةٍ وَرَجُلٌ خَلْفَهُ يَقَعُ فِيهِ، فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ عَامِرٌ فَقَالَ [البحر الطويل] هَنِيئًا مَرِيئًا غَيْرَ دَاءٍ مُخَامِرٍ … لِعَزَّةَ مِنْ أَعْرَاضِنَا مَا اسْتَحَلَّتِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Hind, from ‘Amir,
entries.matn_en: that he was sitting by a pillar when a man behind him was backbiting him. ‘Amir turned to him and said May it be wholesome and easy to digest, not a lingering sickness… For the honor of our reputations, what has she made lawful?

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 215
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ لَعِبَ بِالشِّطْرَنْجِ فَهُوَ كَالَّذِي يَتَوَضَّأُ بِلَحْمِ الْخِنْزِيرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abd al-Karim, who attributed this report to the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “Whoever plays chess is like one who performs ablution with the flesh of swine.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 216
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ النَّرْدَ وَالشِّطْرَنْجَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he used to disapprove of backgammon and chess.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 216
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «اتَّقُوا هَاتَيْنِ الْكَعْبَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ تُزْجَرَانِ زَجْرًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from someone who reported to him from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “Beware of these two gaming knucklebones [dice], which are thrown forcefully.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 216
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، وَالْهَيْثَمِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه مَرَّ بِعُثْمَانَ رضي الله عنه حِدْثَانَ تُوُفِّيَتْ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَحْتَهُ وَهُوَ حَزِينٌ فَقَالَ مَا يُحْزِنُكَ؟ فَقَالَ: لَا أَحْزَنُ وَقَدِ انْقَطَعَ الصِّهْرُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم؟ فَقَالَ: هَلْ لَكَ أَنْ أُزَوِّجَكَ حَفْصَةَ فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ: نَعَمْ، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: حَتَّى أَذْكُرَ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ عُمَرُ الْقِصَّةَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعُمَرَ: «أَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى صِهْرٍ خَيْرٍ لَكَ مِنْ عُثْمَانَ، وَأَدُلُّ عُثْمَانَ عَلَى صِهْرٍ خَيْرٍ لَهُ مِنْكَ؟» ، قَالَ: بَلَى، قَالَ: «تُزَوِّجُنِي حَفْصَةَ، وَأُزَوِّجُ عُثْمَانَ ابْنَتِي» ، قَالَ: فَفَعَلَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Musa b. Abi Kathir and Al-Haytham
entries.matn_en: that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, passed by Uthman, ؓ, who was grieving shortly after the Prophet’s daughter married to him had died. Umar asked, “What grieves you?” Uthman said, “Should I not grieve, when the marriage tie between me and the Messenger of God has been severed?” Umar asked, “Would you like me to marry you to Hafsah?” Uthman said yes. Umar said, “Let me mention it to the Messenger of God.” Umar told him what had happened, and the Prophet said: “Shall I guide you to a marriage tie better for you than the one with Uthman, and guide Uthman to one better for him than the one with you?” Umar said, “Yes.” The Prophet said: “You marry me to Hafsah, and I will marry Uthman to my daughter.” The Messenger of God then did so.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 216
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ، عَنِ الْأَغَرِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنه عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ مَرَّ بِقَوْمٍ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَقَالَ «أَنْتُمُ الْقَوْمُ الَّذِينَ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَصْبِرَ نَفْسِي مَعَهُمْ، وَمَا جَلَسَ عِدَّتُكُمْ مِنَ النَّاسِ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ إِلَّا حَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا، وَغَشِيَتْهُمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عِنْدَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Ali b. al-Aqmar from al-Agharr from Ali, ؓ, from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, passed by a group remembering God and said: “You are the people with whom I have been commanded to remain patiently. Whenever a group of people sit remembering God, the angels surround them with their wings, mercy envelops them, and God mentions them among those who are with Him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 217
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ رِيَاضَ الْجَنَّةِ فَارْتَعُوا، أَمَا إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِمَجَالِسِ الْقُصَّاصِ، وَلَكِنَّهَا مَجَالِسُ أَهْلِ الْفِقْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said When you see the gardens of Paradise, graze therein. Indeed, they are not the gatherings of storytellers, but rather the gatherings of the people of jurisprudence.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 217
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَالَ: «لَوْ وَلَّيْتُهَا عُثْمَانَ لَحَمَلَ آلَ أَبِي مُعَيْطٍ عَلَى رِقَابِ النَّاسِ، وَاللَّهِ لَوْ فَعَلْتُ لَفَعَلَ، وَلَوْ فَعَلَ لَأَوْشَكُوا أَنْ يَسِيرُوا إِلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَجُزُّوا رَأْسَهُ» ، فَقَالُوا: عَلِيٌّ؟ قَالَ: رَجُلٌ قُعْدُدٌ، قَالُوا: طَلْحَةُ؟ قَالَ: ذَاكَ رَجُلٌ فِيهِ بَأْوٌ، قَالُوا: الزُّبَيْرُ؟ قَالَ: لَيْسَ هُنَاكَ، قَالُوا: سَعْدٌ؟ قَالَ: صَاحِبُ فَرَسٍ وَقَوْسٍ، فَقَالُوا: عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ؟ قَالَ: ذَاكَ فِيهِ إِمْسَاكٌ شَدِيدٌ، وَلَا يَصْلُحُ لِهَذَا الْأَمْرِ إِلَّا مُعْطٍ فِي غَيْرِ سَرَفٍ، وَمُمْسِكٌ فِي غَيْرِ تَقْتِيرٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah who said
entries.matn_en: that it had reached him that Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, said: “If I had appointed Uthman, he would have placed the family of Abu Muayt on the people’s shoulders. By God, if I had done so, he would have done it; and if he did, they would soon march against him and cut off his head.” They asked, “What about Ali?” Umar said, “He is a weak, unimpressive man.” They asked, “Talhah?” He said, “That man is conceited.” They asked, “Al-Zubayr?” He said, “He is not suited to it.” They asked, “Sa'd?” He said, “He is a horseman and archer.” They asked, “Abd al-Rahman b. Awf?” He said, “He is very tight-fisted. This office suits only someone who gives without extravagance and withholds without being miserly.”

sections.title_en: Chapter on Blood Money

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 218
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ أَبِي يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْقَتْلِ عَلَى ثَلَاثَةِ أَوْجُهٍ: «قَتْلُ عَمْدٍ، وَهُوَ مَا تَعَمَّدْتَ ضَرْبَهُ بِالسِّلَاحِ فَفِيهِ الْقِصَاصُ، وَقَتْلُ خَطَإٍ وَهُوَ الشَّيْءُ تُرِيدُهُ فَتُصِيبُ غَيْرَهُ بِسِلَاحٍ فَالدِّيَةُ فِيهِ عَلَى الْعَاقِلَةِ، وَشِبْهُ الْعَمْدِ مَا تَعَمَّدْتَ ضَرْبَهُ بِغَيْرِ سِلَاحٍ فَفِيهِ الدِّيَةُ مُغَلَّظَةٌ عَلَى الْعَاقِلَةِ إِذَا أَتَى ذَلِكَ عَلَى النَّفْسِ ، وَشِبْهُ الْعَمْدِ فِي الْجِرَاحَاتِ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ تَعَمَّدْتَ ضَرْبَهُ بِسِلَاحٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فِيهِ الْقِصَاصَ فَفِيهِ الدِّيَةُ مُغَلَّظَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf b. Abi Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding killing that it occurs in three forms: Intentional killing is when you deliberately strike someone with a weapon, and in this case, retaliation (qisas) is required. Unintentional killing is when you intend to strike something but strike someone else with a weapon, and in this case, the blood money (diyah) is upon the clan (aqilah). Semi-intentional killing is when you deliberately strike someone without a weapon, and in this case, the blood money is increased and is upon the clan if it results in death. In cases of wounds, semi-intentional applies to anything where you deliberately strike someone with or without a weapon, but retaliation is not possible, so the blood money is increased.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 218
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا يَبْلُغُ بِالْعَبْدِ دِيَةُ الْحُرِّ، وَذَلِكَ لَا تَجِدُ عَبْدًا أَبَدًا إِلَّا وَفِي الْأَحْرَارِ خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “A slave’s blood-wit does not reach the amount of a free person’s, because you will never find a slave for whom there is not someone among the free who is better than him.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 218
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، حَلَقَ لِحْيَةَ رَجُلٍ فَلَمْ تَنْبُتْ فَقَضَى عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا بِالدِّيَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ali b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that a man shaved another man’s beard and it did not grow back, so he ruled that the full blood money (diyah) be paid for it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 218
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْخَطَإِ مِثْلَ قَوْلِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه، وَقَالَ " فِي شِبْهِ الْعَمْدِ: ثَلَاثَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ حِقَّةً، وَثَلَاثَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ جَذَعَةً، وَأَرْبَعَةٌ وَثَلَاثُونَ ثَنِيَّةً إِلَى بَازِلِ عَامِهَا كُلُّهَا خَلِفَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ali b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said: “For quasi-intentional homicide, [the compensation is] thirty-three hiqqah camels (females entering their fourth year), thirty-three jadha'ah camels (females entering their fifth year), and thirty-four thaniyyah camels (females entering their sixth year) through the bazil stage; all are pregnant.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 218
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي " دِيَةِ الْخَطَإِ أَخْمَاسًا: عِشْرِينَ جَذَعَةً، وَعِشْرِينَ حِقَّةً، وَعِشْرِينَ بَنَاتِ لَبُونٍ، وَعِشْرِينَ بَنَاتِ مَخَاضٍ، وَعِشْرِينَ بَنِي مَخَاضٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas‘ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding the blood-wit for accidental homicide, divided into five groups: twenty jadha'ah camels (females entering their fifth year), twenty hiqqah camels (females entering their fourth year), twenty bint labun camels (females entering their third year), twenty bint makhad camels (females entering their second year), and twenty b. makhad camels (males entering their second year).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 219
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي " شِبْهِ الْعَمْدِ أَرْبَعًا: خَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ جَذَعَةً، وَخَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ حِقَّةً، وَعِشْرُونَ بَنَاتِ مَخَاضٍ، وَخَمْسٌ وَعِشْرُونَ بَنَاتِ لَبُونٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding quasi-intentional homicide: four groups—twenty-five jadha'ah camels (females entering their fifth year), twenty-five hiqqah camels (females entering their fourth year), twenty bint makhad camels (females entering their second year), and twenty-five bint labun camels (females entering their third year).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 219
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ شُرَيْحًا، قَالَ فِي الْأَصَابِعِ: «أَصَابِعُ الْيَدِ وَالرِّجْلِ سَوَاءٌ فِي كُلِّ أُصْبُعٍ الْعُشْرُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that Shurayh said regarding the fingers: "The fingers of the hand and the foot are equal; for each finger, a tenth."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 219
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «السِّنِّ نِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ، وَكَذَلِكَ الْمُوضِحَةِ، وَفِي الْمُنَقِّلَةِ الْعُشْرُ وَنِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ، وَفِي الْجَائِفَةِ ثُلُثُ الدِّيَةِ، وَفِي الْآمَّةِ ثُلُثُ الدِّيَةِ، فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْعَقْلُ فَفِيهَا الدِّيَةُ كَامِلَةٌ، وَفِي الْأَنْفِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الْمَارِنِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الذَّكَرِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الْحَشَفَةِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي اللِّسَانِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الْعَيْنَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي الْوَاحِدَةِ النِّصْفُ، وَكَذَلِكَ الْيَدَيْنِ وَالرِّجْلَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ، وَفِي الْأُذُنَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ، وَفِي إِحْدَاهُمَا النِّصْفُ، وَفِي الْحَاجِبَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding blood money: For a tooth, half of a tenth. Likewise for a wound exposing the bone. For a displaced bone, a tenth and a half of a tenth. For a penetrating wound, a third of the blood money. For a wound reaching the skull, a third of the blood money. If the intellect is lost, the full blood money is due. For the nose, the full blood money. For the nasal septum, the full blood money. For the penis, the full blood money. For the glans, the full blood money. For the testicles, the full blood money. For the tongue, the full blood money. For both eyes, the full blood money, and for one eye, half. Likewise for both hands and both feet, half the blood money for each. For both ears, the full blood money, and for one ear, half. For both eyebrows, the full blood money.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 220
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «قَالَ فِي دِيَةِ الرَّجُلِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ مِثْلُ دِيَةِ الْحُرِّ الْمُسْلِمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding the blood-money of a non-Muslim subject: "It is the same as the blood-money of a free Muslim."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 220
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «ثَدْيِ الْمَرْأَةِ نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ، وَفِي كِلَيْهِمَا الدِّيَةُ، وَكَذَلِكَ حَلَمَتُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said regarding a woman’s breast: “One breast carries half the blood-wit; both breasts carry the full blood-wit. The same applies to her nipples.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 220
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «لِسَانِ الْأَخْرَسِ، وَذَكَرِ الْخَصِيِّ، وَالْعَيْنِ الْقَاتِمَةِ الذَّاهِبَةِ بَصَرُهَا، وَالْيَدِ الشَّلَّاءِ، وَالرِّجْلِ الْعَرْجَاءِ، وَالسِّنِّ السَّوْدَاءِ، فِي هَذَا كُلِّهِ حُكُومَةُ عَدْلٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “For the tongue of a mute person, the genitals of a eunuch, an eye clouded and blind, a paralyzed hand, a lame leg, or a blackened tooth, the compensation is an equitable assessment [by the judge].”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 220
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، وَعُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي «دِيَةِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ دِيَةُ الْحُرِّ الْمُسْلِمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Bakr from al-Zuhri from Abu Bakr and Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that they said regarding the blood money of the People of the Covenant: "It is the blood money of a free Muslim."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 220
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «رَجُلٍ قَطَعَ يَدَ رَجُلٍ فَاقْتَصَّ مِنْهُ فَمَاتَ الْمُقْتَصُّ مِنْهُ، أَنَّ دِيَتَهُ عَلَى عَاقِلَةِ الْمُقْتَصِّ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said regarding a man who cut off another man’s hand and then the victim took retaliation by cutting off the offender’s hand, but the offender died: the blood money for him is upon the clan of the one who took retaliation.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 221
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا تَجُوزُ شَهَادَةُ الْمُكَاتَبِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said "The testimony of a slave under contract of manumission is not valid."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 221
entries.isnad_ar: : قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «الْعَبْدِ يُقْتَلُ خَطَأً عَلَى الْعَاقِلَةِ وَمَا كَانَ دُونَ النَّفْسِ فَهُوَ فِي مَالِ الْجَانِي»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding a slave killed accidentally: “[The blood-wit] is borne by the offender’s 'aqilah (agnatic kin group); any injury short of death is paid from the offender’s own property.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 221
entries.isnad_ar: يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «لَا تَعْقِلُ الْعَاقِلَةُ عَبْدًا وَلَا عَمْدًا وَلَا صُلْحًا وَلَا اعْتِرَافًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Amir
entries.matn_en: who said: “The 'aqilah (agnatic kin group liable for accidental blood-wit) does not bear compensation for a slave, intentional killing, a settlement, or an admission.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 221
entries.isnad_ar: : قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا تَعْقِلُ الْعَاقِلَةُ الصُّلْحَ وَلَا الْعَمْدَ وَلَا الِاعْتِرَافَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “The 'aqilah (agnatic kin group liable for accidental blood-wit) does not bear a settlement, intentional killing, or an admission.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 221
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا تَعْقِلُ الْعَاقِلَةُ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا قُتِلَ خَطَأً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “The 'aqilah (agnatic kin group liable for accidental blood-wit) does not bear compensation when a slave is killed accidentally.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 221
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا تَعْقِلُ الْعَاقِلَةُ إِلَّا خَمْسَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ فَصَاعِدًا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said: “The 'aqilah (agnatic kin group liable for accidental blood-wit) bears liability only when the amount is five hundred dirhams or more.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 221
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «فَرَضَ الدِّيَةَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْوَرِقِ عَشَرَةَ آلَافِ دِرْهَمٍ، وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الذَّهَبِ أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ، وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الْإِبِلِ مِائَةً مِنَ الْإِبِلِ، وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الْبَقَرِ مِائَتَيْ بَقَرَةٍ، وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الْحُلَلِ مِائَتَيْ حُلَّةٍ، وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الْغَنَمِ أَلْفَيْ شَاةٍ، وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الدِّيوَانِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah, from someone who reported to him, from 'Amir, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: “He fixed the blood-wit at ten thousand dirhams for those who pay in silver, one thousand dinars for those who pay in gold, one hundred camels for those who pay in camels, two hundred head of cattle, two hundred suits of garments, or two thousand sheep; all of these rates applied to those enrolled in the diwan (the state register).”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 221
entries.isnad_ar: : قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ قَتِيلًا وُجِدَ بِالْيَمَنِ بَيْنَ وَدَاعَةَ وَخَيْوَانَ، فَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَنْ «قِيسُوهُ، فَإِلَى أَيِّ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ كَانَ أَقْرَبَ أَقْسَمَ مِنْهُمْ خَمْسُونَ رَجُلًا مَا قَتَلْنَا، وَلَا عَلِمْنَا قَاتِلًا، ثُمَّ يَضْمَنُونَ الدِّيَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that a slain person was found in Yemen between Wada'ah and Khaywan. 'Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, wrote: “Measure the distance between them. The people of whichever village he was nearer to shall provide fifty men to swear: ‘We did not kill him, and we know no killer.’ They must then pay the blood-wit.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 222
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «الْأَعْمَى يَفْقَأُ عَيْنَ الصَّحِيحِ، أَنَّ عَلَيْهِ الدِّيَةَ فِي مَالِهِ إِذَا فَقَأَهَا عَمْدًا، وَإِذَا فَقَأَهَا خَطَأً كَانَتِ الدِّيَةُ عَلَى الْعَاقِلَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who ruled concerning a blind man who destroys the sound eye of a sighted person: “If he does so intentionally, he owes the blood-wit from his own property; if unintentionally, the 'aqilah (agnatic kin group liable for accidental blood-wit) bears it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 222
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الدِّيَةُ فِي ثَلَاثِ سِنِينَ، وَالنِّصْفُ فِي سَنَتَيْنِ، وَالثُّلُثُ فِي سَنَةٍ، وَمَا كَانَ أَقَلَّ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ فَفِي سَنَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The full blood-wit is payable over three years; half is payable over two years, and one third—or any amount less than one third—over one year.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 222
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «الرَّجُلِ يُعْتِقُ نِصْفَ عَبْدِهِ يَسْعَى فِي النِّصْفِ الْبَاقِي، وَإِنْ قَتَلَ قَتِيلًا خَطَأً عَقَلَتِ الْعَاقِلَةُ عَنْهُ نِصْفَ الدِّيَةِ، وَيَسْعَى الْعَبْدُ فِي نِصْفِ الْقِيمَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
entries.matn_en: concerning a man who emancipates half of his slave: “The slave must work to pay for the remaining half. If he commits an unintentional homicide, the 'aqilah (agnatic kin group liable for accidental blood-wit) bears half the blood-wit on his behalf, and the slave must work to pay half his value.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 222
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ الْحَارِثِ حَفَرَ بِئْرًا عَلَى بَابِ دَارِ أُسَامَةَ، يَجْتَمِعُ فِيهَا مَاءُ الْمَطَرِ، فَوَقَعَ فِيهَا فَرَسٌ فَعَطِبَ، فَخَاصَمُوهُ إِلَى شُرَيْحٍ فَضَمِنَهُ، وَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا أَضْمَنُكَ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Amir
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, from 'Amir, that 'Amr b. al-Harith dug a well at the entrance to Usamah’s house to collect rainwater. A horse fell into it and was injured. They brought the case before Shurayh, who held him liable. He said: “I will hold you liable only once.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 222
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «الْعَبْدِ إِذَا فُقِئَتْ عَيْنُهُ فَنِصْفُ قِيمَتِهِ، وَإِنْ فُقِئَتْ عَيْنَاهُ فَإِنْ دَفَعَهُ سَيِّدُهُ أَخَذَ قِيمَتَهُ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَمْسَكَهُ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَيْءٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said
