entries.matn_en: concerning a slave whose one eye is put out: “Half his value is due. If both his eyes are put out, his master may surrender him and receive his full value, or keep him, in which case he receives nothing.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 223
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «كُلُّ مَا فِي الْحُرِّ فِيهِ الدِّيَةُ فَفِي الْعَبْدِ الْقِيمَةُ، وَكُلُّ مَا فِي الْحُرِّ نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ، فَهُوَ فِي الْعَبْدِ نِصْفُ الْقِيمَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said: “For an injury to a free person that entails the full blood-wit, the corresponding liability for a slave is his full value; where it entails half the blood-wit, the corresponding liability is half the slave’s value.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 223
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ فِيهِ مِنْهُ اثْنَانِ، فَفِيهِمَا قِيمَتُهُ، وَفِي أَحَدِهِمَا نِصْفُ قِيمَتِهِ، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فِيهِ مِنْهُ وَاحِدٌ، فَفِيهِ قِيمَتُهُ، وَجِرَاحَتُهُ مِنْ قِيمَتِهِ عَلَى قَدْرِ جِرَاحَةِ الْحُرِّ مِنْ دِيَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “For any bodily part of a slave of which there are two, injury to both entails his full value, and injury to one entails half his value. For any bodily part of which there is only one, injury to it entails his full value. Compensation for his wounds is assessed in proportion to the compensation for a free person’s wounds relative to that person’s blood-wit.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 223
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا جَنَى الْمَمْلُوكُ دَفَعَهُ الْمَوْلَى أَوْ فَدَاهُ بِجَمِيعِ الْجِنَايَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When an enslaved person commits an offense, his master must either surrender him or ransom him for the full amount of the offense.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 223
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «الْعَبْدِ يَجْنِي جِنَايَةَ قَتْلٍ أَوْ خَطَإٍ، ثُمَّ يُعْتِقُهُ مَوْلَاهُ، وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ ذَلِكَ أَوْ يَبِيعُهُ أَوْ يَهَبُهُ أَنَّ عَلَى مَوْلَاهُ الدِّيَةَ» ، وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: فَإِذَا فَعَلَ وَهُوَ. . . . . . . . .
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said concerning a slave who commits a homicide or other offense and is then emancipated, sold, or given away by his master, who knows of the offense: “The blood-wit is owed by the master.” Abu Hanifah added: “If he does that while he is…” [The Arabic source breaks off here.]

sections.title_en: Chapter on Beverages

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 223
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ حَمَّادٌ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَهُوَ يَأْكُلُ فَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ، فَدَعَا لِي بِنَبِيذٍ فَلَمَّا رَأَى إِبْطَائِي عَنْهُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ أَنَّهُ «دَخَلَ عَلَى ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه وَهُوَ يَأْكُلُ، فَأَكَلَ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ أُتُوا بِنَبِيذٍ تَنْبِذُهُ أُمُّ وَلَدِهِ سِيرِينَ فِي جَرٍّ أَخْضَرَ، فَشَرِبَ مِنْهُ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَعَلْقَمَةُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim. Hammad said: “I visited Ibrahim while he was eating and ate with him. He called for nabidh for me; when he saw me hesitate, he told me from 'Alqamah that 'Alqamah visited Ibn Mas'ud while he was eating and ate with him. Then they were brought nabidh that Sirin, Ibn Mas'ud’s umm walad (enslaved woman who bore him a child), had fermented in a green earthenware jar. Ibn Mas'ud and 'Alqamah drank from it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 224
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُزَاحِمِ بْنِ زُفَرَ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «أَرَانِي أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ الْجَرَّ الْأَخْضَرَ الَّتِي كَانَ يُنْبَذُ فِيهَا لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Muzahim b. Zufar from al-Dahhak
entries.matn_en: who said Abu Ubaydah showed me the green earthenware jar in which drink used to be prepared for Abdullah b. Mas'ud.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 224
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِنَّ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ جَزُورًا، وَلِآلِ عُمَرَ مِنْهَا الْعُنُقُ، وَلَا يَقْطَعُ هَذَا اللَّحْمَ فِي بُطُونِنَا إِلَّا النَّبِيذُ الشَّدِيدُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ishaq from Amr b. Maymun from Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Amr b. Maymun, from 'Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, who said: “The Muslims have a camel slaughtered each day, and 'Umar’s family receives its neck. Only strong nabidh helps this meat go down in our stomachs.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 224
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ بِوَاسِطِ الْقَصَبِ، فَكَانَ يُرْسِلُ إِلَى السُّوقِ فَيَشْتَرِي لَهُ النَّبِيذَ مِنَ الْخَوَابِي»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad b. Abi Sulayman from Anas b. Malik, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he used to stay with Abu Bakr b. Abi Musa al-Ash'ari in Wasit al-Qasab, and he would send someone to the market to buy him nabidh from the large jars.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 224
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِالنَّبِيذِ يُنْبَذُ فِي سِقَايَةٍ مُزَفَّتَةٍ دَاخِلُهَا وَخَارِجُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Amir
entries.matn_en: that he said There is no harm in nabidh prepared in a coated waterskin, both its inside and outside.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 225
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ رضي الله عنه، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ " كُنَّا نَهَيْنَاكُمْ عَنْ ثَلَاثٍ: عَنْ زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ فَزُورُوهَا، فَقَدْ أُذِنَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِ أُمِّهِ، وَلَا تَقُولُوا هُجْرًا، وَنَهَيْتُكُمْ أَنْ تُمْسِكُوا لُحُومَ الْأَضَاحِي فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ، فَأَمْسِكُوا وَتَزَوَّدُوا، فَإِنَّمَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ لِيَتَّسِعَ بِهِ غَنِيُّكُمْ عَلَى فَقِيرِكُمْ، وَنَهَيْتُكُمْ أَنْ تَشْرَبُوا فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ، فَاشْرَبُوا فِيمَا بَدَا لَكُمْ مِنَ الظُّرُوفِ؛ فَإِنَّ الظُّرُوفَ لَا تُحِلُّ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُحَرِّمُهُ، وَلَا تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Alqamah b. Marthad, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from 'Alqamah b. Marthad, from Ibn Buraydah, from his father, from the Prophet, ﷺ, who said: “I had forbidden you three things: visiting graves—now visit them, for permission was granted to Muhammad to visit his mother’s grave, but do not say anything indecent; keeping sacrificial meat for more than three days—now keep it and take provisions, for I forbade it only so that your wealthy could make room for your poor; and drinking from gourds, pitch-coated vessels, and green jars. Now drink from any containers you wish, for containers make nothing lawful or unlawful. But do not drink anything intoxicating.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 225
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ بِقَوْمٍ يَزْفِنُونَ، فَقَالَ «مَا شَأْنُهُمْ؟» ، قَالُوا: شَرِبُوا مِنْ نَبِيذٍ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ، قَالَ: فَنَهَاهُمْ أَنْ يَشْرَبُوا فِي ذَلِكَ، ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِهِمْ رَاجِعًا، فَشَكَوْا إِلَيْهِ مَا يَجِدُونَ مِنَ التُّخْمَةِ، فَرَخَّصَ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَشْرَبُوا فِي ذَلِكَ، وَنَهَاهُمْ أَنْ يَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ishaq b. Thabit b. Ubayd, from his father, from Ali b. al-Husayn,
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ passed by a group of people dancing during the expedition of Tabuk. He asked, "What is the matter with them?" They said , "They drank from their nabidh in gourds, green jars, and lined vessels." So he forbade them from drinking in those. Then, on his return, he passed by them again, and they complained to him about the indigestion they suffered. So he permitted them to drink in those vessels but forbade them from drinking anything intoxicating.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 226
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه أَخَذَ رَجُلًا سَكْرَانَ، فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا، فَأَبَى إِلَّا ذَهَابَ عَقْلٍ، فَقَالَ «احْبِسُوهُ فَإِذَا صَحَا، فَاضْرِبُوهُ» ، ثُمَّ أَخَذَ فَضْلَ إِدَاوَتِهِ فَذَاقَهُ فَقَالَ: «أَوْهِ، هَذَا عَمِلَ بِالرِّجَالِ الْعَمَلَ» ، ثُمَّ صَبَّ فِيهِ مَاءً فَكَسَرَهُ، فَشَرِبَ وَسَقَى أَصْحَابَهُ، وَقَالَ: «هَكَذَا اصْنَعُوا بِشَرَابِكُمْ إِذَا غَلَبَكُمْ شَيْطَانُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that 'Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, caught a drunk man. He tried to find him an excuse, but the man insisted that he had lost his reason. 'Umar said: “Detain him, and when he is sober, flog him.” He then took the remainder of his waterskin’s drink and tasted it. “Ugh! This has really affected men,” he said. He poured water into it to dilute it, then drank and gave his companions to drink. He said: “Do this to your drink when its devil overcomes you.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 226
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا كَانَ يُكْرَهُ أَنْ يُجْمَعَ بَيْنَ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ فِي النَّبِيذِ، كَمَا يُكْرَهُ فِي شِدَّةِ الزَّمَانِ اللَّحْمُ وَالسَّمْنُ، وَأَنْ يَقْرِنَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ التَّمْرَتَيْنِ، فَأَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said: “Combining dates and raisins in nabidh used to be disapproved, just as meat and clarified butter were disapproved in times of hardship, and a man’s eating two dates together was disapproved. But nowadays there is no harm in it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 226
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ «ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لَهُ زَبِيبٌ فَلَمْ يَسْتَمْرِئْهُ، فَأَمَرَ الْجَارِيَةَ فَأَلْقَتْ فِيهِ عَجْوَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Nafi‘ from Ibn ‘Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that raisins would be soaked for him, but he did not find it palatable, so he ordered the servant girl to throw a dried date into it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 226
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ زِيَادٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَقَانِي ابْنُ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما شَرْبَةً فَمَا كِدْتُ أَهْتَدِي إِلَى أَهْلِي، فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الْغَدِ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ: «مَا زِدْنَاكَ عَلَى عَجْوَةٍ وَزَبِيبٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Ishaq from Uqbah b. Ziyad,
entries.matn_en: who said Ibn Umar, ؓ, gave me a drink, and I could barely find my way home. The next day, I returned to him and mentioned that to him, so he said: "We only added to you a pressed date and raisins."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 226
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لَهُ النَّجِيحُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that "Nabidh would be prepared for him."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 227
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ " قَوْلُ النَّاسِ: كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ، خَطَأٌ مِنْهُمْ، إِنَّمَا أَرَادُوا السُّكْرَ حَرَامٌ خَاصَّةً "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “People say, ‘Every intoxicant is forbidden.’ That is mistaken; what they meant was that intoxication itself is specifically forbidden.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 227
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه كَتَبَ إِلَى عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ رضي الله عنهما «إِنِّي أُتِيتُ بِشَرَابٍ مِنَ الشَّامِ قَدْ طُبِخَ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ ثُلُثَاهُ فِي النَّارِ، وَبَقِيَ ثُلُثُهُ، وَذَهَبَ حَرَامُهُ وَرِيحُ جُنُونِهِ، وَبَقِيَ حُلْوُهُ وَحَلَالُهُ، يُشْبِهُ طِلَاءَ الْإِبِلِ، فَمُرْ مَنْ قِبَلِكَ يَتَوَسَّعُوا بِهِ فِي أَشْرِبَتِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that 'Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, wrote to 'Ammar b. Yasir, ؓ: “I was brought a drink from Syria that had been boiled over a fire until two-thirds evaporated and one-third remained. Its forbidden, intoxicating part and the madness-inducing effect were gone; its sweetness and lawful portion remained. It resembles tila' (grape must boiled down). Tell those under your authority to use it freely in their drinks.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 227
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ شُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَشْرَبُ الطِّلَاءَ عَلَى النِّصْفِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Walid b. Shuraih from Anas b. Malik, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he used to drink al-tila’ mixed half and half.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 227
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا تَسْقُوا صِبْيَانَكُمُ الْخَمْرَ، وَلَا تُغَذُّوهُمْ بِهَا، فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَجْعَلْ شِفَاءَكُمْ فِيمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ، إِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُمْ عَلَى مَنْ سَقَاهُمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Ibn Mas'ud, ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Do not give your children wine to drink or feed it to them. God has not placed your cure in what He has forbidden you. The sin for giving it to them rests only on the one who gives it to them.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 227
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما وَسَأَلَهُ أَبُو كَثِيرٍ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ، فَقَالَ «قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ، حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّحُومُ فَحَرَّمُوا أَكْلَهَا، وَاسْتَحَلُّوا بَيْعَهَا، وَأَكْلَ ثَمَنِهَا، وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ الْخَمْرَ، فَحَرَامٌ بَيْعُهَا وَحَرَامٌ أَكْلُ ثَمَنِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad b. Qays, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I heard Ibn 'Umar, ؓ, when Abu Kathir asked him about selling wine. He said: ‘May God condemn the Jews! Fat was forbidden to them, so they refrained from eating it but permitted its sale and consumption of its price. God has forbidden wine; therefore, its sale is forbidden, and consuming its price is forbidden.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 228
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: فِي الْخَمْرِ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَقُلْ وَسَأَلَهُ أَبُو كَثِيرٍ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: regarding wine, similar to the narration of Muhammad b. Qays, except that he did not say: and Abu Kathir asked him.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 228
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَامِرٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُهْدِي لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلَّ عَامٍ رَاوِيَةً مِنْ خَمْرٍ، فَأَهْدَى لَهُ رَاوِيَةً فِي الْعَامِ الَّذِي حُرِّمَتْ فِيهِ الْخَمْرُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَ الْخَمْرَ، فَلَا حَاجَةَ لَنَا فِي خَمْرِكَ» ، فَقَالَ: خُذْهَا فَبِعْهَا، وَاسْتَعِنْ بِثَمَنِهَا، فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ الَّذِيَ حَرَّمَ شُرْبَهَا، حَرَّمَ بَيْعَهَا، وَأَكْلَ ثَمَنِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad b. Qays, from Abu Amir al-Thaqafi,
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad b. Qays, from Abu 'Amir al-Thaqafi, that he used to give the Prophet, ﷺ, a waterskin of wine each year. In the year wine was forbidden, he brought him one. The Messenger of God said: “God has forbidden wine; we have no need of it.” The man said: “Take it, sell it, and use the proceeds.” The Prophet said: “The One who forbade drinking it also forbade selling it and consuming its price.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 228
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادِ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى الْخَمْرَ بِعَيْنِهَا قَلِيلَهَا وَكَثِيرَهَا، وَالسُّكْرَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَرَابٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Abu Awn from Abdullah b. Shaddad b. al-Had from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu 'Awn, from 'Abd Allah b. Shaddad b. al-Had, from Ibn 'Abbas, ؓ, who said: “God Most High has forbidden wine itself, in both small and large quantities, and intoxication from every drink.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 228
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي «نَبِيذِ الزَّبِيبِ النَّقِيعِ الْمُعَتَّقِ إِذَا غَلَا هِيَ الْخَمْرُ اجْتَنِبْهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr,
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said regarding aged, steeped raisin nabidh: “If it ferments, it is wine; avoid it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 228
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ السَّكَرَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, that he disapproved of sakar (a fermented date drink).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 229
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَّهُ شَرِبَ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ali b. Abi Talib, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he drank while standing.

sections.title_en: Chapter on Wearing Silk and Gold

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 229
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه بَعَثَ جَيْشًا فَفُتِحَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَأَقْبَلُوا فَلَمَّا دَنَوْا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ خَرَجَ عُمَرُ رضي الله عنه يَسْتَقْبِلُهُمْ بِالنَّاسِ، فَلَمَّا بَلَغَهُمْ خُرُوجُ عُمَرَ بِالنَّاسِ إِلَيْهِمْ، لَبِسُوا مَا مَعَهُمْ مِنَ الْحَرِيرِ وَالدِّيبَاجِ، فَلَمَّا رَآهُمْ غَضِبَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَلْقُوا ثِيَابَ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَنْكُمْ» ، فَأَلْقَوْهَا وَاعْتَذَرُوا إِلَيْهِ، وَقَالُوا: لَبِسْنَاهَا لِنُرِيَكَ فَيْءَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي فَاءَ عَلَيْنَا، قَالَ فَسُرِّيَ عَنْ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: «ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ فِي الْعَلَمِ مِثْلَ الْإِصْبَعَيْنِ وَالثَّلَاثِ وَالْأَرْبَعِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that 'Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, sent out an army and granted them victory. As they returned and neared Medina, 'Umar went out with the people to welcome them. When they heard he was coming, they put on the silk and brocade they had brought. Seeing them, he grew angry and said: “Take off the garments of the people of the Fire.” They did so and apologized: “We wore them to show you the spoils God granted us.” 'Umar’s anger subsided, and he then allowed a decorative strip [of silk] two, three, or four fingers wide.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 229
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «غَابَ حُذَيْفَةُ رضي الله عنه غِيبَةً، ثُمَّ قَدِمَ وَقَدْ كُسِيَ بَنَاتُهُ وَبَنُوهُ قُمُصَ حَرِيرٍ، فَنَزَعَهَا عَنِ الذُّكُورِ وَتَرَكَهَا عَلَى الْإِنَاثِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Sulayman Abu Abdillah, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr,
entries.matn_en: who said Hudhayfah was absent for a time, then he returned to find his daughters and sons dressed in silk shirts. He removed them from the males but left them on the females.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 230
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَزَلْنَا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ بِالْمَدَائِنِ عَلَى دِهْقَانٍ فَأَتَاهُمْ بِطَعَامِهِ، فَأَكَلُوا، ثُمَّ دَعَا حُذَيْفَةُ بِشَرَابٍ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فِي إِنَاءِ فِضَّةٍ، فَرَمَى بِهِ وَجْهَهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنِّي نَزَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ الْعَامَ الْمَاضِي، فَأَتَانَا بِطَعَامِهِ، ثُمَّ دَعَوْتُ بِشَرَابِهِ فَأَتَانَا بِهِ فِي إِنَاءِ فِضَّةٍ، فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَانَا أَنْ نَشْرَبَ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ، وَأَنْ نَأْكُلَ فِيهَا، وَأَنْ نَلْبَسَ الْحَرِيرَ وَالدِّيبَاجَ، وَقَالَ: «هِيَ لِلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي الدُّنْيَا، وَلَكُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Farwah, from Abdur-Rahman b. Abi Layla, from Hudhayfah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Abu Farwah, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, from Hudhayfah, ؓ, who said: “We stayed with Hudhayfah in al-Mada'in, at the home of a local landowner. He brought them food, and they ate. Hudhayfah then asked for a drink, which was brought in a silver vessel. He flung it back at him and said: ‘Last year I stayed with him. He brought us food, and when I asked for his drink, he brought it in a silver vessel. I told him that the Prophet, ﷺ, forbade us to drink from or eat from gold and silver vessels, and to wear silk and brocade. He said: “They are for the polytheists in this world and for you in the Hereafter.”’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 230
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Mujahid, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, from Hudhayfah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: with a report to the same effect.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 230
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِالْحَرِيرِ وَالذَّهَبِ لِلنِّسَاءِ، وَكُرِهَ لِلرِّجَالِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said "There is no harm in silk and gold for women, but it is disapproved for men."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 230
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تُحَلِّي بَنَاتَ أَخِيهَا الذَّهَبَ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Amr b. Dinar from Aisha, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that she used to adorn her brother’s daughters with gold.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 230
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ أَهْلِ مِصْرَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ الْحَرِيرَ بِيَدٍ وَالذَّهَبَ بِيَدٍ فَقَالَ: «هَذَانِ مُحَرَّمَانِ عَلَى الذُّكُورِ مِنْ أُمَّتِي، حَلَالٌ لِإِنَاثِهِمْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Zayd b. Abi Unaysah, from a man of the people of Egypt,
entries.matn_en: who said One day the Messenger of God, ﷺ, came out holding silk in one hand and gold in the other, and he said: "These two are forbidden for the males of my community, but permissible for their females."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 231
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يُزَوِّجُ بَنَاتَهُ عَلَى أَلْفِ دِينَارٍ يُحَلِّيهِنَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بِأَرْبَعِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ، وَكَانَ يُحَلِّي بَنَاتَهُ الذَّهَبَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Amr b. Dinar from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he would marry off his daughters for a dowry of one thousand dinars, out of which he would adorn them with jewelry worth four hundred dinars, and he would adorn his daughters with gold.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 231
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ بَلَغَنِي عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، وَعِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ وَحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، وَابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَشُرَيْحٍ رضي الله عنهم «أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَلْبَسُونَ الْخَزَّ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It has reached me that 'Uthman b. 'Affan, 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf, 'Imran b. Husayn, 'Abd Allah b. Abi Awfa, Abu Hurayrah, Anas b. Malik, Husayn b. 'Ali, Ibn al-Zubayr, and Shurayh used to wear khazz (a fine fabric, often silk-and-wool blend).”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 231
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَلْبَسُ الْمُصَبَّغَ بِالْعُصْفُرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he used to wear clothes dyed with safflower.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 231
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ «كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَخْرُجُ فَيَؤُمُّنَا فِي مِلْحَفَةٍ حَمْرَاءَ مُشْبَعَةٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad
entries.matn_en: who said Ibrahim used to go out and lead us in prayer wearing a deep red wrap.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 231
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَلْبَسُ قَلَنْسُوَةَ الثَّعَالِبِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that he used to wear a fox-fur cap.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 231
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " كَانَ نَقْشُ خَاتَمِهِ: اللَّهُ وَلِيُّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَنَاصِرُهُ، مِنْ حَدِيدِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: that the engraving on his ring was: "God is the Protector of Ibrahim and his Helper," made of iron.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 232
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " كَانَ نَقْشُ خَاتَمِهِ: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ibrahim b. Muhammad b. al-Muntashir, from his father, from Masruq,
entries.matn_en: that the inscription on his ring was: “In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 232
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ، وَالْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ رضي الله عنهم كَانَا يَلْبَسَانِ خَاتَمَيْنِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فِي فَصِّ أَحَدِهِمَا صُورَةُ لَبْوَتَيْنِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham,
entries.matn_en: that 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf and al-Bara' b. 'Azib, ؓ, each wore a gold ring; one of the two rings had an image of two lionesses on its bezel.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 232
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ " كَانَ نَقْشُ خَاتَمِهِ: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Husayn from Mujahid from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the engraving on his ring was: "Abdullah b. Umar."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 232
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه: «ذَكَاةُ كُلِّ مَسْكٍ دِبَاغُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said that 'Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, said: “The purification of every hide is its tanning.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 232
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَا أَصْلَحْتَ بِهِ الْجِلْدَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَمْنَعُهُ مِنَ الْفَسَادِ فَهُوَ لَهُ دِبَاغٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said Whatever you use to treat the hide that prevents it from decay is tanning for it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 232
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «ذَكَاةُ كُلِّ جَلْدٍ دِبَاغُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “The tanning of every hide is its purification.”

sections.title_en: On dyeing the hair, trimming the beard, and shortening the mustache.
sections.title_ar: فِي الْخِضَابِ وَالْأَخْذِ مِنَ اللِّحْيَةِ وَالشَّارِبِ

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 232
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ «
entries.matn_ar: أَخْرَجَتْ لَنَا أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ رضي الله عنها مُشَاقَةً مِنْ شَعْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَخْضُوبَةً بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَالْكَتَمِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Uthman b. Abdillah b. Mawhab who said
entries.matn_en: Umm Salamah, ؓ, brought out for us a small bundle of the hair of the Messenger of God, ﷺ, dyed with henna and katam.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 233
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «أَبْصَرْتُ رَأْسَ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ رضي الله عنهما وَلِحْيَتَهُ مَخْضُوبَتَيْنِ بِالْوَسْمَةِ وَقَدْ نَصَلَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Muhammad b. Qays, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I saw the head and beard of al-Husayn b. 'Ali, ؓ, dyed with wasmah, and the dye had faded.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 233
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سُئِلَ عَنْ خِضَابِ الْوَسْمَةِ، فَقَالَ: «بَقْلَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: who said He was asked about dyeing with wasmah, so he said, "It is a good herb."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 233
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «رَأَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، وَكَأَنَّ لِحْيَتَهُ ضِرَامُ عَرْفَجٍ، يَعْنِي تَلَأْلَأُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Yazid al-Rishk from Anas b. Malik, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: who said I saw Abu Bakr, and his beard seemed like the flame of ‘arfaj, meaning it glistened.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 233
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ طَلْحَةَ مَخْضُوبَ اللِّحْيَةِ بِالْوَسْمَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father,
entries.matn_en: and Abu Hanifah said: “I saw Musa b. Talhah with his beard dyed with wasmah (a plant dye).

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 234
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حُجَيَّةَ، عَنْ ابْنِ بُرَيْدةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ رضي الله عنه قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ أَحْسَنَ مَا غَيَّرْتُمْ بِهِ الشَّيْبَ الْحِنَّاءُ وَالْكَتَمُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hujayyah, from Ibn Buraydah, from Abu al-Aswad, from Abu Dharr, ؓ, who said
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God, ﷺ, said, "The best things with which you may change gray hair are henna and katam."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 234
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَقَالَ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ: «
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ عَامِرًا مَخْضُوبُ اللِّحْيَةِ بِالْحِنَّاءِ، وَرَأَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِلْحَفَةً حَمْرَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, and Abu Hanifah said "
entries.matn_en: I saw 'Amir with his beard dyed with henna, and I saw him wearing a red cloak."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 234
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلِحْيَتُهُ قَدِ انْتَشَرَتْ فَقَالَ «لَوْ أَخَذْتُمْ» وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى نَوَاحِي لِحْيَتِهِ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Abu Quhafah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he was brought to the Prophet, ﷺ, while his beard had grown long and spread out. The Prophet said , "If you would trim," and he gestured with his hand toward the sides of his beard.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 234
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Nafi’, from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he "used to trim his beard."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 234
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَقْبِضُ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ، فَيَأْخُذُ مِنْهَا مَا جَاوَزَ الْقَبْضَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ibn Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he would grasp his beard and then trim what exceeded his fist.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Nafi‘ from Ibn ‘Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he would trim his beard.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ، مَا لَمْ يَتَشَبَّهُ بِأَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said There is no harm in a man trimming his beard, so long as he does not imitate the people of polytheism.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الشَّارِبَيْنِ: «إِنَّمَا يُكْرَهُ مِنْهُ التَّشَبُّهُ بِأَهْلِ الْكُفْرِ، فَأَمَّا مَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said regarding the moustache: “What is disapproved of it is only resembling the unbelievers; apart from that, there is no harm in it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ اكْتَوَى وَاسْتَرْقَى مِنَ الْحُمَةِ، وَكَانَ يَأْخُذُ مِنْ لِحْيَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he underwent cauterization, sought a charm (ruqyah) for a venomous bite or sting, and used to trim his beard.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَسْمَاءَ ابْنَةَ عُمَيْسٍ رضي الله عنها قَالَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: أَلَا أَسْتَرْقِي لِابْنِ أَخِيكَ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ؟ قَالَ: «بَلَى، فَلَوْ أَنَّ شَيْئًا سَبَقَ الْقَدَرَ لَسَبَقَتْهُ الْعَيْنُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Ubaydullah b. Abi Ziyad, from Abu Najih, from Abdullah b. Umar, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that Asma bint Umays, ؓ, said to the Prophet, ﷺ: "Shall I not seek ruqyah for your nephew from the evil eye?" He said: "Yes, for if anything were to precede destiny, the evil eye would precede it."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 235
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي الله عنه
entries.matn_ar: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَا وَضَعَ اللَّهُ دَاءً إِلَّا وَضَعَ لَهُ دَوَاءً، إِلَّا السَّامَ وَالْهَرَمَ، فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِأَلْبَانِ الْبَقَرِ فَإِنَّهَا تُخْلَطُ مِنْ كُلِّ الشَّجَرِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Qays b. Muslim, from Tariq b. Shihab, from Abdullah b. Mas'ud, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that the Prophet, ﷺ, said God has not sent down any disease except that He has also sent down its cure, except for death and old age. So take to the milk of cows, for it is a mixture from every tree.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 236
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهَا سَأَلَتْهَا امْرَأَةٌ عَنِ الْحَفِّ؟ فَقَالَتْ «أَمِيطِي الْأَذَى عَنْ وَجْهِكِ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from 'A'ishah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that a woman asked her about plucking facial hair. She replied: “Remove the unwanted hair from your face.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 236
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ، وَالْمُوتَصِلَةَ، وَالْوَاشِمَةَ، وَالْمُوتَشِمَةَ، وَالْوَاشِرَةَ، وَالْمُوتَشِرَةَ، وَالْوَاصِمَةَ، وَالْمُوتَصِمَةَ، وَآكِلَ الرِّبَا، وَمُطْعِمَهُ، وَشَاهِدَهُ، وَكَاتِبَهُ، وَالْمُحَلِّلَ، وَالْمُحَلَّلَ لَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from the Prophet, ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “God has cursed the woman who attaches hair extensions and the woman who has them attached; the woman who tattoos and the woman who has herself tattooed; the woman who files her teeth and the woman who has them filed; the woman who marks herself and the woman who has herself marked; the one who consumes usury, the one who pays it, its witnesses and its recorder; and the one who makes a woman lawful for her former husband [through an intervening marriage], and the man for whose sake this is done.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 237
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ أُمِّ ثَوْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِالْوَصْلِ إِذَا كَانَ صُوفًا، إِنَّمَا يُكْرَهُ الشَّعْرُ» .
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Umm Thawr from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said "There is no harm in joining (hair) if it is wool; what is disliked is the hair."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 237
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ. . . . . . .
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah… [The Arabic
entries.matn_en: report itself is truncated here.]

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 237
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما "
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ لُحُومَ الْخَيْلِ، وَيَقْرَأُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ {وَالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا} [النحل: 8] "
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from al-Haytham from Ikrimah from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he used to dislike the meat of horses and would recite this verse: "And [He created] the horses, mules, and donkeys for you to ride." (An-Nahl: 8)

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 237
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْحَوْتَكِيَّةِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا، سَأَلَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه عَنِ الْأَرْنَبِ؟ فَقَالَ لَوْلَا أَنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ شَيْئًا أَوِ أَنْقُصْ لَحَدَّثْتُكُمْ، وَلَكِنِّي مُرْسِلٌ إِلَى بَعْضِ مَنْ شَهِدَ الْحَدِيثَ، قَالَ: فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ رضي الله عنهما فَقَالَ: حَدِّثْنَا حَدِيثَ الْأَرْنَبِ يَوْمَ كُنَّا بِقَاعِ كَذَا وَكَذَا، قَالَ: فَقَالَ: أَتَى رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأَرْنَبٍ فَأَمَرَ بِأَكْلِهَا فَقَالَ: إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ دَمًا، قَالَ: «لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ» ، وَقَالَ: «فَكُلْ» ، قَالَ: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، قَالَ: «صَوْمُ مَاذَا؟» قَالَ: مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ، قَالَ: «أَفَلَا جَعَلْتَهُنَّ الْبِيضَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Musa b. Talhah, from Ibn al-Hawtakiyyah,
entries.matn_en: that a man asked 'Umar b. al-Khattab, ؓ, about rabbit. 'Umar said: “Were I not afraid of adding something to the report or omitting something from it, I would tell you. Instead, I will send for someone who witnessed it.” He sent for 'Ammar b. Yasir, ؓ, and asked him to recount the rabbit report from the day they were at such-and-such a plain. 'Ammar said: “A man brought a rabbit to the Prophet, ﷺ. He told them to eat it. The man said, ‘I saw blood.’ He replied, ‘That is nothing,’ and said, ‘Eat.’ The man said, ‘I am fasting.’ He asked, ‘What kind of fast?’ The man replied, ‘Three days each month.’ He said, ‘Why did you not make them the White Days?’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 238
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رضي الله عنها
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ أُهْدِيَ لَهَا ضَبٌّ فَسَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِهِ فَقَالَ «إِنِّي أَكْرَهُهُ» ، فَجَاءَتْهَا سَائِلَةٌ، فَأَرَادَتْ أَنْ تُطْعِمَهَا إِيَّاهُ، فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أَتُطْعِمِينَهَا مَا لَا تَأْكُلِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from 'A'ishah, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that a desert monitor lizard (dabb) was given to her. She asked the Prophet, ﷺ, whether it could be eaten, and he said: “I dislike it.” A woman who came begging visited her, and 'A'ishah wanted to give it to her. The Prophet said: “Would you feed her something you yourself do not eat?”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 238
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «كَانَتِ الْعَقِيقَةُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ الْإِسْلَامُ رُفِضَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said The 'Aqiqah was practiced in the pre-Islamic era, but when Islam came, it was abandoned.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 238
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ، «
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ الْعَقِيقَةَ كَانَتْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ الْأَضْحَى رُفِضَتْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from a man from Muhammad b. al-Hanafiyyah: "
entries.matn_en: The 'Aqiqah was practiced in the pre-Islamic era, but when the Udhiyah (sacrifice of Eid al-Adha) came, it was abandoned."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 238
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا أُحِبُّ الْعَقَاقَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Zayd b. Aslam, from the Prophet, ﷺ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I do not approve of the 'aqiqah sacrifices.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 239
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِإِخْصَاءِ الدَّابَّةِ إِذَا طُلِبَ بِذَلِكَ صَلَاحُهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said "There is no harm in castrating an animal if it is sought for its betterment."

sections.title_en: On slaughtered animals and cheese.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 239
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «كُلُّ طَعَامِ الْمَجُوسِ كُلْهُ مَا خَلَا الذَّبَائِحَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said All the food of the Magians is lawful except their slaughtered animals.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 239
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا ذَبَحَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَأَهَلُّوا لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَأَنْتَ تَسْمَعُ، فَلَا تَأْكُلْ، وَإِنْ لَمْ تَشْهَدْهُمْ فَكُلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that he said When the People of the Book slaughter and invoke other than God the Exalted while you hear it, do not eat. But if you did not witness it, then eat.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 239
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ:
entries.matn_ar: إِذَا كَانَ عَالِمًا «وَنَهَانَا مِنَ الصَّيْدِ عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ، وَكُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ، وَأَنْ تُوطَأَ حَبَالَى الْفَيْءِ حَتَّى يَضَعْنَ، وَأَنْ نَأْكُلَ لُحُومَ الْحُمُرِ الْأَهْلِيَّةِ» .
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from al-Haytham, who said:
entries.matn_en: “When he was informed, he forbade us from eating any predatory animal with fangs or any bird with talons; from having intercourse with pregnant captive women from the war booty until they give birth; and from eating domestic donkey meat.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 240
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: مِثْلَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father from Abu Hanifah from Makhul from the Prophet, ﷺ,
entries.matn_en: likewise.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 240
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَتَاهُ عَبْدٌ أَسْوَدُ فَقَالَ: إِنِّي فِي غَنَمٍ لِأَهْلِي، وَأَنَا بِسَبِيلٍ مِنَ الطَّرِيقِ، وَإِنِّي أُسْأَلُ فَأَسْقِي بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ أَهْلِي، قَالَ: «لَا» ، قَالَ: فَإِنِّي أَرْمِي فَأُصْمِي وَأُنْمِي قَالَ: «كُلْ مَا أَصْمَيْتَ، وَدَعْ مَا أَنْمَيْتَ، وَالْإِصْمَاءُ مَا رَأَيْتَهُ، وَالْإِنْمَاءُ مَا تَوَارَى عَنْكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, ؓ, who said:
entries.matn_en: “A dark-skinned enslaved man came to him and said: ‘I tend my family’s sheep beside the road. People ask me for water, and I give it to them without my family’s permission.’ He said, ‘No.’ The man then asked: ‘When I shoot game, some I kill outright and some I wound but it escapes—what should I do?’ He replied: ‘Eat what you kill outright, and leave what escapes wounded. “Killed outright” is what you see [fall]; “escapes wounded” is what disappears from your sight.’”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 240
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِقُدُورٍ تَغْلِي مِنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْأَهْلِيَّةِ فَقَالَ «أَكْفِئُوهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father from Abu Hanifah from Hammad from Ibrahim
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God, ﷺ, passed by pots boiling with the meat of domestic donkeys and said , "Spill them out."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 241
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا خَرَقَ الْمِعْرَاضُ، فَكُلْ، وَإِذَا لَمْ يَخْرِقْ فَلَا تَأْكُلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If the mi'rad (a broad-headed hunting shaft) pierces the game, eat it; if it does not pierce it, do not eat it.”

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 241
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا قَطَعْتَ الصَّيْدَ نِصْفَيْنِ فَكُلْهُ كُلَّهُ، وَإِذَا كَانَ مِمَّا يَلِي الرَّأْسَ أَكْثَرَ فَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِي الرَّأْسَ، وَدَعِ الْآخَرَ، وَإِذَا قَطَعْتَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا فَكُلْهُ كُلَّهُ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ الشَّيْءِ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ مُتَعَلِّقًا بِجِلْدِهِ فَتَأْكُلُهُ كُلَّهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said If you cut the game into two halves, eat all of it. If the portion near the head is larger, eat from what is near the head and leave the other. If you cut off something from it, eat all of it except that piece—unless it remains attached to its skin, in which case you may eat all of it.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 241
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رضي الله عنهما
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «كُلْ مَا أَمْسَكَ الْكَلْبُ إِذَا كَانَ عَالِمًا، وَلَا تَأْكُلْ مِمَّا أَكَلَ، وَكُلْ مَا أَمْسَكَ الْبَازِيُّ، وَإِنْ أَكَلَ فَإِنَّ تَعْلِيمَ الْبَازِيِّ أَنْ تَدْعُوَهُ فَيُجِيبُكَ، وَلَا تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَضْرِبَهُ فَيَدَعَ الْأَكْلَ كَمَا تَضْرِبُ الْكَلْبَ فَيَدَعُ الْأَكْلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf reported from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he said Eat what the dog catches if it is trained, but do not eat from what it has eaten. Eat what the falcon catches, even if it has eaten some, for the training of a falcon is that you call it and it responds to you, and you cannot strike it to make it leave the food as you strike a dog to make it leave the food.

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 241
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ رضي الله عنه،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كَلْبِ الصَّيْدِ إِذَا أُرْسِلَ عَلَى الصَّيْدِ فَقَتَلَهُ وَسَمَّى عَلَيْهِ، قَالَ «كُلْ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim, from Adi b. Hatim, ؓ,
entries.matn_en: that he asked the Messenger of God, ﷺ, about a hunting dog that is sent after prey, kills it, and the name of God was mentioned over it. He said "Eat."

entries.label: Entry
entries.citation: Kitāb al-Āthār of Abū Yūsuf · Vol. 1, p. 241
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا أَكَلَ الْكَلْبُ فَلَا تَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ، إِنَّمَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، وَيُضْرَبُ فَيَتْرُكَ الْأَكْلَ، وَإِذَا قَتَلَ الْبَازِيُّ، وَأَكَلَ فَكُلْ، لِأَنَّكَ لَا تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَضْرِبَهُ حَتَّى يَتْرُكَ الْأَكْلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Yusuf narrated from his father, from Abu Hanifah, from Hammad, from Ibrahim,
entries.matn_en: who said: “If a dog eats from the prey, do not eat it, for it caught it for itself. The dog can be struck so that it stops eating. But if a falcon kills prey and eats from it, you may eat it, since you cannot strike the falcon and make it stop eating.”
